source_text: in the beginning elohim bara hashomayim the heavens and haaretz the earth.
target_text: uru-uru tèka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: and the earth was tohu vavohu without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. and the ruach elohim was hovering upon the face of the waters.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, aa'i-aa'i dhae mèci mèka. dhu abhu, èi. aa maroga aatu-aatu saguru nare ne. ka roh lamatua lela ètu dedha èi èèna.

source_text: and elohim said, let there be light: and there was light.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka, hud'i ku dènge saraa. ropa peka nare sèmi ne'e, ka saraa j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and elohim saw the light, that it was tov good; and elohim divided the ohr light from the choshech darkness.
target_text: ropa nèdhi saraa ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. hèia na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga, sèna ka èci-èci ka dènge taa na.

source_text: and elohim called the light yom day, and the darkness he called lailah night. and the erev evening and the boker morning were yom echadday one, the first day.
target_text: ka pangare saraa ne ‘mèu', aa maroga na ‘mèda'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èci kèna.

source_text: and elohim said, let there be a raki'a expanse, dome, firmament in the midst of the mayim waters, and let it divide the mayim from the mayim. and elohim made the raki'a, and divided the waters under the raki'a from the waters which were above the raki'a; and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, na peka, hud'i dènge ku era talele, sèna ka hag'e eele èi. nèti èèna ka, èi re dedha, aa abhu kahèi èi re haha. ropa peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia èi b'agi dènge mi dua.

source_text: and elohim called the raki'a shomayim heaven. and the erev and the boker were yom sheni day two, the second day.
target_text: ka na pangare èi re dedha na, ‘liru'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka dua kèna.

source_text: and elohim said, let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the yabashah dry land appear; and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, èi re haha hud'i pakaboko ku mi ca era, sèna ka abhu rai kamango. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka rai mango.

source_text: and elohim called the yabashah eretz earth; and the mikveh gathering together of the waters called he seas; and elohim saw that it was tov.
target_text: ka era rai mango, na pangare na ‘rai-dedha'; aa era èi dhu kaboko èèna, na pangare na ‘dhasi'. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and elohim said, let the earth bring forth vegetation, the herb yielding zera seed, and the fruit tree yielding pri fruit after its kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth; and it was so.
target_text: ka ama lamatua lii hari, peka na, rai hud'i pamamuri ku rupa-rupa ana aaj'u. sèna ka abhu aj'u dhu hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru. sèna ka aj'u-aj'u se, hua-hela madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka ana aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and the earth brought forth vegetation, and herb yielding zera seed after its kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after its kind; and elohim saw that it was tov good.
target_text: ètu dedha-rai, ana aaj'u se hua-hela ka madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and the erev and the boker were yom shlishi day three, the third day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka tèlu kèna.

source_text: and elohim said, let there be lights in the raki'a of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for otot signs, and for mo'adim seasons, and for yamim days, and shanim years; and let them be for lights in the raki'a of the heaven to give light upon the earth; and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, aku nèngu na, re bèka dedha, hud'i abhu ku mèdha dhu saraa, ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. hud'i abhu mèdha dhu pasaraa re mèu, aa abhu kahèi dhu pasaraa re mèda. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, j'aj'i tadha, ho sèna ka bisa ige lod'o, hèru, dènge tèu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, mèdha dhu heo aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and elohim made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night; he made the kokhavim stars also.
target_text: ka na tao ka mèdha kapai dua dhu pasaraa rai-haha. dhu kapai risi, pasaraa re mèu; aa dhu ako ana iiki, pasaraa re mèda. aa na tao hua-hètu kahèi.

source_text: and elohim set them in the raki'a of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
target_text: na tèke mèdha dhu saraa sèra ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka loti mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness; and elohim saw that it was tov.
target_text: ka mèdha se, pasaraa ka re mèu, aa pasaraa re mèda. dènge j'ara ne'e, na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and the erev and the boker were yom revi'i day four, the fourth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka èpa kèna.

source_text: and elohim said, let the waters bring forth an abundance of living creatures, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open raki'a of heaven.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua padhai lii hari, peka na, hud'i abhu ku ae-ae dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. dènge hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa manu-bhui dhu lela ètu dedha rai-haha ne.

source_text: and elohim created great sea creatures, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth in abundance, after their kind, and every winged fowl after its kind; and elohim saw that it was tov.
target_text: ka na tao ka i'a aa'i-aa'i dènge badha kapai dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. na paj'aj'i kahèi manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and elohim blessed them, saying, be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, peka na, i'a se, hud'i laa bèba-kacanga sèna ka papènu èi ètu mia-mia. aa manu-bhui, asa tabha kahèi.

source_text: and the erev and the boker were yom chamishi day five, the fifth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka lèmi kèna.

source_text: and g-d said, let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind; and it was so. and g-d made the beast of the earth after its kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind; and g-d saw that it was tov.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, na, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa badha dhu mamuri ètu rai-dedha. sèmi: badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, èci-èci ka dènge rupa na. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, badha aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and g-d said, let us make man in our tzelem, after our demut: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon ha'aretz the earth.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, hua iia, mai ta paj'aj'i dhèu, madhutu rupa èdhi. hud'i laa ra leru dènge ator i'a aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, badha-manu dhu ani, dènge badha leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so g-d created humankind in his own tzelem, in the tzelem elohim image of g-d created he him; zachar male and nekevah female created he them.
target_text: hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha ne madhutu rupa na. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and g-d blessed them, and g-d said unto them, be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bèba-kacanga ku, sèna ka pea papènu rai-haha ne, ho mi ator ne. ja'a hia miu koasa, sèna ka mi ator i'a, manu-bhui, dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and g-d said, hinei, i have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of kol ha'aretz all the earth, and every etz tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food.
target_text: mi nanene paie-iie! ja'a hia miu rupa-rupa nganga'a ètu rai-haha ne'e. sèmi: ana aaj'u dhu dènge hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru.

source_text: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, i have given every green herb for food; and it was so.
target_text: ja'a hia rupa-rupa ana aaj'u kahèi sèna ka j'aj'i nganga'a badha. nganga'a hia badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, nganga'a badha sèra aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and g-d saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was tov me'od very good. and the erev and the boker were yom shishi day six, the sixth day.
target_text: ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èna kèna.

source_text: thus hashomayim and ha'aretz were finished, and all the tza'va of them.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and on yom hashevi'i elohim finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the yom hashevi'i from all his work which he had made.
target_text: ropa na sab'a èle, asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu. hèia na ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: vayevarech elohim et yom hashevi'i, and set it apart as kodesh: because that in it shavat he had rested from all his work which bara elohim g-d created and made.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, na tao lod'o ka pidhu ne, lod'o dhu kapai risi nèti lod'o dhu leo sèra. na tao sèmi èèna, lula na pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a na, ka ètu d'ara lod'o ka pidhu na, na ae.

source_text: these are the toledot of hashomayim and of ha'aretz when they were created, in the yom that hashem elohim made eretz v'shomayim,
target_text: d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. lod'o ama lamatua heka paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha èèna,

source_text: and every plant of the sadeh was not yet in ha'aretz, and every herb of the sadeh had not yet yitzmach sprung up; for hashem elohim had not caused it to rain upon ha'aretz, and there was not an adam man la'avod to till, to work haadamah the ground. but there went up a mist from ha'aretz, and watered the whole face of the adamah.
target_text: dhae abhu mèka ana aaj'u, lula na papuru mèka èj'i. taa èèna, dhoka sèb'u èi di, mai nèti d'ara rai ho pabasa rai re dedha. aa abhu mèka dhèu rai-haha dhu tao oka-tedhe.

source_text: and hashem elohim formed the adam of the aphar min haadamah, and breathed into his nostrils the nishmat chayyim; and the adam became a nefesh chayyah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. hèia na tiu a'ae na asa d'ara sahènga dhèu na, ka na mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and hashem elohim planted a gan garden eastward in eden; and there he put the adam whom he had formed.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua bhoke oka cue ètu rai eden, re bèka dhimu. hèia na hia dhèu ne pea ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and out of the adamah made hashem elohim to spring up kol etz every tree that is pleasing to the sight, and tov for food; the etz hachayyim tree of life also in the midst of the gan garden, and the etz hada'as tov v'rah.
target_text: ètu d'ara oka èèna, na pamamuri rupa-rupa aj'u dhu be'a, dhu dhèu bisa ra'a. aa na pamamuri kahèi aj'u dua kapua ètu talora aae oka èèna. ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci, na mamuri taa-taa. aa ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci hari, ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and a nahar river flowed out of eden to water the gan garden; and from there it divided, and became four headwaters.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu loko èci dhu hae nèti d'ara oka èèna. loko èèna, èpa kacanga.

source_text: the shem of the first is pishon; that is it which winds through the kol eretz chavilah, where there is zahav;
target_text: kacanga ka èci na, ngara na pison. nèngu ka dhu hae pale-lème rai hawila dhu abhu hualaa ae-ae.

source_text: and the zahav of that land is tov; there is the gemstone bedolach and the even gemstone hashoham.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, abhu poe-pai, aj'u dhu raa na hèu mèngi, dènge hadhu kale'e.

source_text: and the shem of the second nahar is gichon; the same is it that winds through kol eretz kush.
target_text: kacanga ka dua, ngara na gihon. kacanga ne, hae pale-lème rai kus.

source_text: and the shem of the third nahar is chiddekel tigris: that is it which goeth toward the east of assyria. and the fourth nahar is euphrates.
target_text: kacanga ka tèlu, ngara na tigris. kacanga ne'e ka, j'aj'i mi too rai asyur re ca bèka dhimu. kacanga ka èpa, ngara na efrat.

source_text: and hashem elohim took the adam and put him in the gan eden la'avod to till, to work it and to be shomer over it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua hia dhèu pea ètu d'ara eden, ho na ladhe-leru oka èèna.

source_text: and hashem elohim commanded the adam, saying, of every etz of the gan thou mayest freely eat;
target_text: hèia na hia paredha mi dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne, èu bisa mu'a.

source_text: but of the etz hada'as tov v'rah, thou shalt not eat of it; for in the yom that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
target_text: te ngaa èci dhu èu bisa boe mu'a. nuka hua nèti aj'u dhu ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe. ladhe mu'a, èu madhe dènge.

source_text: and hashem elohim said, it is not tov that the adam should be alone; i will make him an ezer a helper suitable for him.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu haru lii na, aku nèngu na, babe'a na aad'o, ladhe dhèu ne mamuri mesa na. de ja'a neo paj'aj'i hia ne, anga ca dhèu dhu pamèci dènge ne.

source_text: and out of the adamah hashem elohim formed every beast of the sadeh, and every oph hashomayim; and brought them unto the adam to see what he would name them; and whatsoever the adam named kol nefesh chayyah, that was shmo. and the adam gave shemot to all behemah, and to the oph hashomayim, and to every beast of the sadeh; but for adam there was not found an ezer for him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na tao rupa-rupa badha dènge manu-bhui. hèia na pangèd'u si asa dhèu ne, sèna ka na pangare si. ka dhèu ne pangare badha se dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra, èci-èci ka dènge ngara ra. te ngaa dhèu ne abhu mèka anga dhu pamèci dènge nèngu.

source_text: and hashem elohim caused a tardemah deep sleep to fall upon the adam, and he slept; and he took from one of his tzalelot sides, ribs, and closed up the basar in the place thereof;
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pabhèj'i luu dhèu ne'e. ropa na bhèj'i, ama lamatua nare rui karasa na calaa, ka na pakateme hari nu'a deo na.

source_text: and the tzela rib, which hashem elohim had taken from the adam, made he an isha, and brought her unto the adam.
target_text: nèti rui ne, na paj'aj'i bhèni ca dhèu. hèia na pangèd'u bhèni ne mi dhèu èèna.

source_text: and the adam said, this is now etzem of my etzem, and basar of my basar; she shall be called isha, because she was taken out of ish.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi bhèni ne, ka dhèu na peka, aku nèngu na, waaa! ne'e ne ku! sèmi ne'e ku, heka pamèci dènge ja'a kèna! rui na, sama èci èèna ka dènge rui ja'a. aa isi na, sama kahèi dènge isi ja'a. lula nèngu ne, j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone, nèti èèna ka ja'a pangare ne, ‘dhèu bhèni'.

source_text: therefore shall an ish leave his av and his em, and shall cleave unto his isha: and they shall be basar echad.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, lula dua ra, j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: and they were both arummim naked ones, the adam and his isha, and were not ashamed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dua ra dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ra makae boe.

source_text: now the nachash was more arum cunning, crafty, wiley than any beast of the sadeh which hashem elohim had made. and he said unto the isha, really? hath elohim said, ye shall not eat of kol etz hagan?
target_text: nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, mege ka dhu mèu risi kapod'e-kabèli. ca lod'o, mege karèi bhèni na, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? ama lamatua kai miu baku mi'a hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne'e.

source_text: and the isha said unto the nachash, we may eat of the p'ri etz hagan; but of the p'ri haetz which is in the middle of the gan garden, elohim hath said, ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
target_text: ka bhèni na b'ala, aad'o! ji'i bisa nga'a! dhodhoka aj'u ca kapua ètu talora oka ne, ama lamatua kai, baku nga'a hua na. na peka na, ji'i baku nga'a, aa baku g'ag'e hua èèna kahèi, te aad'o na, ji'i madhe!

source_text: and the nachash said unto the isha, ye shall not surely die;
target_text: te ngaa mege na dhaa, aku nèngu na, waa! sèmi boe èèna! miu se madhe boe!

source_text: for elohim doth know that in the yom ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be like elohim, knowing tov and rah.
target_text: ama lamatua mema kai tare'a sèmi èèna, lula dhu ne'a le, ladhe mi'e hua aaj'u èèna, miu j'aj'i d'èlu-mèu sèmi nèngu. ho èèna na me'a mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and when the isha saw that haetz was tov for food, and that it was delight to the eyes, and haetz to be coveted to make one have seichel, she took of the p'ri thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her ish with her; and he did eat.
target_text: aa bhèni ne ladhe na aj'u ne be'a titu kèna, dènge hua na ele boe kee. na ngee, ladhe ja'a ku'a hua aj'u ne'e, ja'a d'èlu-mèu. hèia puu nare ka hua aj'u èèna, ka na'e. na'e nare, nèti hia dhèu èmu na, ka na'a kahèi.

source_text: and the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were eirummim naked ones; and they sewed aleh te'enah fig leaves together, and made themselves khagorot loin covering girdles.
target_text: ra'a rare ka, heka re'a na rèngu dhu pake boe mèdha dhu hutu ua rèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra lui rèu aj'u ho pa'abhe era makae rèngu.

source_text: and they heard the kol of hashem elohim walking in the gan in the cool of the day; and haadam and his isha hid from the presence of hashem elohim amongst the etz hagan.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, dua ra tadèngi lii core haga ama lamatua ètu d'ara oka èèna. ka dua ra rai lasi lu'u asa ca bèka aj'u, sèna ka lamatua baku nèdhi si.

source_text: and hashem elohim called unto haadam, and said unto him, where art thou?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua paroa mi dhèu mone èèna, aku nèngu na, adam! èu ètu mia?

source_text: and he said, i heard thy voice in the gan garden, and i was afraid, because i was eirom naked; and so i hid.
target_text: hèia mone na dhaa, ja'a tadèngi lii lamatua ètu ne'e. te ngaa ja'a makae, lula ja'a pake boe mèdha ètu ua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a rai pahuni iisi.

source_text: and he said, who told thee that thou wast eirom naked? hast thou eaten of haetz, which i commanded thee that thou not eat thereof?
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, cee ka dhu peka, na èu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake? de tasamia? tatu èu mu'a le hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai na, sina ma?

source_text: and haadam said, the isha whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of haetz, and i did eat.
target_text: ka na b'ala, peka na, bhèni dhu èu hia ho pa'anga dènge ja'a èèna, ka dhu hia ja'a ku'a!

source_text: and hashem elohim said unto the isha, what is this that thou hast done? and the isha said, the nachash beguiled me, and i did eat.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu ad'u madha j'ara èèna? ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te mege ne ka dhu ag'o ja'a! nèti èèna ka, ja'a ku'a.

source_text: and hashem elohim said unto the nachash, because thou hast done this, thou art arur cursed above kol habehemah, and above every beast of the sadeh; upon thy gakhon belly shalt thou go, and aphar shalt thou eat all the days of thy life;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua dhoo mege èèna, aku nèngu na, ja'a huku èu, lula tatao èu. nèti badha aa'i-aa'i, dhoka èu di dhu abhu huku sèmi ne'e. mulai nèti deo ne'e toke èu madhe, èu dhoka rod'o dènge kakara, aa mu'a ètu rai di.

source_text: and i will put eivah between thee and haisha, and between thy zera and her zera; he shall crush thy rosh, and thou shalt strike his akev heel.
target_text: ja'a tao sèna ka, èu loe boe pamusu dènge bhèni ne. aa ana-èpu miu dua mi sèmi èèna kahèi. ana-èpu èu, èèna na kadhi hui tèdhu dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu nèti ana-èpu bhèni ne, èèna na dhedhe palaho kètu èu.

source_text: unto haisha he said, i will greatly multiply thy itzavon labor pain and thy childbearing; in pain thou shalt bring forth banim; and thy teshukah longing, desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni ne, èèna na, ja'a pasusa tabha èu, ropa èu dènge babia; lod'o mora iisi, èu asa tabha j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara èu d'èi taruu dhèu èmu èu, aa nèngu ka dhu ator èu.

source_text: and unto adam he said, because thou paid heed unto the voice of thy isha, and hast eaten of haetz, of which i commanded thee, saying, thou shalt not eat of it, arurah cursed is haadamah because of thee; in itzavonpain, suffering shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge mone ne, èu madhutu boe lii paredha ja'a, te ngaa èu nanene dhoka lii dhèu èmu èu di, ka èu mu'a hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai èèna. nèti èèna ka, èu abhu huku kahèi. aa rai lèke huku kahèi. nèti deo ne'e, toke d'ai èu madhe, hud'i èu kabèli rai, heka èu abhu nganga'a kèna. dènge sab'a bia sèmi ne'e ka, èu heka mamuri kèna.

source_text: kotz also and dardar shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the esev of the sadeh;
target_text: masi ka èu sèle rupa-rupa hini èèna ka, te ngaa dhu muri mai dhodhoka dhudhu-sete di.

source_text: in the sweat of thy brow shalt thou eat lechem, till thou return unto haadamah; for out of it wast thou taken; for aphar thou art, and unto aphar shalt thou return.
target_text: hud'i èu èi kabhèsu haa ku, heka rai hia èu nganga'a kèna. èu hud'i sab'a bia sèmi èèna ku, toke d'ai lod'o èu madhe. èu ne, ja'a paj'aj'i nèti rai. de ladhe èu madhe, èu j'aj'i hari rai.

source_text: and haadam called the shem of his isha chavah eve; because she was the em kol chai.
target_text: èle èèna ka, adam pangare dhèu èmu na ‘hawa' dhu sasoa na ‘dhu mamuri', te nèngu ka j'aj'i ina nèti dhèu dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: unto adam also and to his isha did hashem elohim make kesonos ohr, and clothed them.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua tao mèdha-papake nèti ka'uri badha, ka papake dua ra.

source_text: and hashem elohim said, see, haadam is become like one of us, knowing tov v'rah; and now, lest he put forth his yad, and take also of haetz hachayyim, and eat, and chai l'olam live forever;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka, limuri ne, dhèu re'a le, mia dhu be'a dènge mia dhu karehe, sèmi èdhi kahèi. de mage dhoka, rèngu ra'a hua aj'u dhu èci hari na, dhu hia mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: therefore hashem elohim sent him forth from the gan eden, to work haadamah from which place he was taken.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na babèga eele si nèti d'ara oka eden èèna, ho lasi asa era leo, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge sab'e oka-tedhe. lula dhèu j'aj'i nèti rai, de mamuri kahèi nèti rai.

source_text: so he drove out haadam; and he placed mikedem at the east of the gan eden hakeruvim, and a flaming cherev which was ever-turning, to be shomer over the derech etz hachayyim.
target_text: babège nare si, ka lamatua paredha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, dhu dènge èla, ho lasi j'aga oka èèna re ca bèka dhimu. rèngu dènge samala dhu heo ha'a-ha'a, dhu seru la'e-mai. lamatua pua si bèdho eele j'ara la'e sa d'ara, te nèngu d'èi boe dhèu puu rare hua aj'u dhu hia ra mamuri taa-taa èèna.

source_text: and haadam knew chavah eve his isha; and she conceived, and bore kayin cain, and said, kaniti i have acquired ish with hashem.
target_text: hèia adam j'unu dènge dhèu èmu na, hawa. ka bhèni ne dènge babia. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a abhu le ana mone ca dhèu, lula ama lamatua soru nare le ja'a. ka na pangare ana ne, kaen dhu sasoa na ‘abhu'.

source_text: and again she bore his ach hevel abel. and hevel was a ro'eh tzon, but kayin was an oved adamah tiller of soil.
target_text: hèia hawa nara iisi hari ana mone èci. ka na pangare ne habel. dua ra kapai ka, habel j'aj'i dhèu madhenge badha. aa a'a na kaen, sab'a oka-tedhe.

source_text: and in ketz yamim it came to pass, that kayin brought of the p'ri haadamah a minchah unto hashem.
target_text: ca lod'o, kaen nèti isi rai na cahag'e, ka hia lamatua.

source_text: and hevel, he also brought of the bechorot of his tzon and of the chelev thereof. and hashem regarded with favor, respect unto hevel and to his minchah:
target_text: habel nèti ana-ana uuru kahib'i-kalèbho na. na roro kahib'i-kalèbho se, ka nèti sisi dhu be'a hia lamatua. d'ara ama lamatua karej'e ropa ladhe nèdhi korban nèti habel ne.

source_text: but unto kayin and to his minchah he had not regard. and kayin was very angry, and his countenance fell.
target_text: te ngaa na d'èi boe korban unu kaen. hèia kaen nasa bia, ka rèhu na mare boe.

source_text: and hashem said unto kayin, why art thou angry? and why is thy countenance fallen?
target_text: ka lamatua lii dènge kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! nga tao ka èu nasa sèmi èèna, ka rèhu èu mare boe?

source_text: if thou doest right, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not right, chattat is lurking at the petach. and unto thee shall be its teshukah desire, and thou must rule over it.
target_text: ladhe tatao èu be'a, na ja'a sèmi èu dènge hua iia. de mu pangee uuru ku! ladhe èu tao bhelu, na bhabhelu èèna na'e hari èu, sama sèmi meo neo pacèli maraho. de sèmi èu neo tao bhabhelu, be'a risi core eele ka!

source_text: and kayin talked with hevel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the sadeh, that kayin rose up against hevel his brother, and killed him.
target_text: ca tèka, kaen gale habel, na peka na, mai lati ngad'o oka, we. ropa dua ra d'ai d'ara oka, kaen kalabhe pamadhe ari na.

source_text: and hashem said unto kayin, where is hevel thy brother? and he said, i know not; am i shomer achi my brotherʼs keeper?
target_text: ka lamatua karèi kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! ari mu ka mia? hèia kaen dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ke'a boe na ètu mia! èu ngee na, ja'a dhèu kèpe haga na, do?

source_text: and he said, what hast thou done? the voice of thy brotherʼs dahm crieth unto me from haadamah.
target_text: ka lamatua b'ala, nga tao ka èu bhelu sèmi èèna? baku pangee na, èu pahuni more le raa ari èu ètu d'ara rai, te ja'a dhu kèdhi aa'i-aa'i le!

source_text: and now art thou arur cursed from haadamah, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brotherʼs dahm from thy hand;
target_text: de lii dhoo lèke le mi dedha èu. lod'o èu pamadhe ari èu, rai sakid'o nare raa na. de limuri ne, rai bisa heka nèti mamuri mi èu.

source_text: when thou tillest haadamah, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her ko'ach strength; na restless fugitive vanad and a wanderer, nomad shalt thou be in ha'aretz.
target_text: de ladhe èu sab'a oka-tedhe, rai ne hia heka èu ngaa-ngaa. nèti deo ne'e, èu lu'u sa haa-sa dhimu, sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era paleo-palu'u.

source_text: and kayin said unto hashem, my avon iniquity, punishment for guilt is greater than i can bear.
target_text: te ngaa kaen b'ala lamatua, aku nèngu na, haii! ama lamatua, ee! lamatua dhoo ja'a bia titu kèna, de ja'a pasae mèke boe nga.

source_text: see, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the adamah; and from thy face shall i be hidden and i shall be a na restless fugitive vanad and a wanderer, nomad in ha'aretz; and it shall come to pass, that whoever findeth me shall kill me.
target_text: lula lamatua bège eele ja'a nèti era ne'e, ja'a kaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. ja'a kako lole-laa asa mia-mia. de ladhe paraga dènge dhèu, èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and hashem said unto him, therefore whoever killeth kayin, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. and hashem placed an ot mark upon kayin, so that none finding him should kill him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, aad'o sèmi èèna! dhèu cee dhu pamadhe èu, èèna na ja'a huku ne, babia na pidhu hari risi nèti èu. hèia lamatua tao tadha mi kaen, sèna ka dhèu re'a ho baku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and kayin went out from the presence of hashem, and dwelt in eretz nod, east of eden.
target_text: hèia kaen tèke eele dènge era èèna. la'e pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, asa era èci, ètu bèka dhimu oka eden. era ne'e, ngara na nod dhu sasoa na, ‘lole-laa'. ka na pea ètu era èèna.

source_text: and kayin knew his isha; and she conceived, and bore chanokh enoch; and he built an ir city, and called the shem of the ir, after the shem beno, chanokh enoch.
target_text: hèia kaen leo-èmu, ka dhèu èmu na dènge babia. ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na henok. hèia kaen patitu rae cue, ngara na henok, madhutu ngara ana na.

source_text: and unto chanokh enoch was born irad; and irad fathered mechuyael; and mechuyael fathered metushael; and metushael fathered lamech.
target_text: ka henok matana irad. hèia irad matana mehuyael. mehuyael matana metusael. aa ana metusael, lamek.

source_text: and lamech took unto him two nashim; the shem of the one was adah, and the shem of the second tzilah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek, dhèu dua. èci ngara na ada, aa ca dhèu hari, ngara na sila.

source_text: and adah bore yaval; he was the av of such as dwell in ohel, and have mikneh.
target_text: ana ada, ngara na yabal. ana-èpu na, j'aj'i dhèu piara badha. mamuri ra ètu boe ca era, aa ra pea dhoka ètu d'ara paleo di.

source_text: and his brotherʼs shem was yuval; he was the av of all such as play kinnor harp and ugav flute.
target_text: ari yabal, ngara na yubal. ana-èpu yubal, j'aj'i dhèu gai sasadhu, dènge tiu sakino.

source_text: and tzilah, she also bore tuval-kayin, a forger of every cutting tool of nechoshet and barzel; and the achot of tuval-kayin was na'amah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek èci hari, sila, nara iisi tubal kaen. ana-èpu na j'aj'i tuka bèsi, ka ra tuku mèdha ae-ae tao nèti bèsi, dènge tabaga. ana hèni tubal kaen, ngara na na'ama.

source_text: and lamech said unto his wives, adah and tzilah, hear my voice; ye wives of lamech, give heed to my speech; for i have slain an ish for my wounding, and a yeled for my chabburah.
target_text: ca tèka, lamek padedha iisi na ètu madha dhèu èmu dua ra, peka na, mi nanene, ee! deo na, ana mone ngèru èci neo game ja'a. te ngaa ja'a dhadhedhe ne, toke madhe.

source_text: if kayin cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly lamech seventy and seven times over.
target_text: dhèu dhu pamadhe kaen, abhu huku pidhu hari. te ngaa cee ka dhu neo b'ala ho pamadhe ja'a, abhu huku pidhu nguru pidhu hari.

source_text: and adam knew his isha again; and she bore a ben, and called shmo shet; for elohim, said she, hath appointed me another zera in place of hevel, whom kayin killed.
target_text: ka hawa nara iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu. hèia ra pangare ne, set dhu sasoa na, ‘hia', lula aku hawa na, ama lamatua hia ja'a ana ne, sèna ka gati madha habel, dhu kaen pamadhe ne.

source_text: and to shet, to him also there was born a ben; and he called shmo enosh; then began men to call upon the shem of hashem.
target_text: pe d'ai nèbhu ku, set abhu ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na enos. tèu èèna, dhèu mulai manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the sefer toldot adam. in the yom that barah elohim adam, in the demut elohim he made him; zachar and nekevah he created them; and blessed them, and called the shem of them adam, in the yom when they were created.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, na tao si sama sèmi rupa nèngu. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. ka na pangare si ‘dhèu rai-haha', aa na hia si berkat. dhèu dhu uru, ngara na adam. ana-èpu adam, nuka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: and adam lived a hundred and thirty shanah and fathered in his own demut and after his tzelem image and called shmo shet:
target_text: lod'o adam d'ai ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, dhu rèhu na nare adam. ka pangare na, set.

source_text: and the days of adam after he had fathered shet were shemoneh me'ot shanah; and he fathered banim and banot:
target_text: ka adam mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèu, hèia na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days that adam lived were nine hundred and thirty shanah: and he died.
target_text: umur adam ceo ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and shet lived a hundred and five shanah, and fathered enosh;
target_text: lod'o set d'ai ca ngasu lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na enos.

source_text: and shet lived after he fathered enosh eight hundred and seven shanah, and fathered banim and banot:
target_text: ka set mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of shet were nine hundred and twelve shanah; and he died.
target_text: umur set ceo ngasu canguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and enosh lived ninety shanah, and fathered kenan;
target_text: lod'o enos mamuri d'ai ceo nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na kenan.

source_text: and enosh lived after he fathered kenan eight hundred and fifteen shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ka enos mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu canguru lèmi tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of enosh were nine hundred and five shanim; and he died.
target_text: umur enos ceo ngasu lèmi tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and kenan lived seventy shanah and fathered mahalal'el;
target_text: lod'o kenan d'ai pidhu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na mahalalel.

source_text: and kenan lived after he fathered mahalal'el eight hundred and forty shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ka kenan mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu èpa nguru tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of kenan were nine hundred and ten shanim; and he died.
target_text: umur kenan ceo ngasu canguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and mahalal'el lived sixty and five shanah, and fathered yered;
target_text: lod'o mahalalel d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na yared.

source_text: and mahalal'el lived after he fathered yered eight hundred and thirty shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ka mahalalel mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of mahalal'el were eight hundred ninety and five shanah; and he died.
target_text: umur mahalalel aru ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and yered lived a hundred sixty and two shanah, and he fathered chanokh enoch:
target_text: lod'o yared d'ai cangasu èna nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na henok.

source_text: and yered lived after he fathered chanokh enoch eight hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ka yared mamuri d'ai aru ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of yered were nine hundred sixty and two shanah; and he died.
target_text: umur yared ceo ngasu èna nguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and chanokh lived sixty and five shanah, and fathered metushelach;
target_text: ropa henok mamuri d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na metusalak.

source_text: and chanokh walked with haelohim after he fathered metushelach three hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ele èèna, henok mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua d'ai tèlu ngasu tèu. ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of chanokh were three hundred sixty and five shanah; and chanokh walked with haelohim; and he was not; for elohim took him.
target_text: na mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. hèia lod'o na d'ai tèlu ngasu èna nguru lèmi tèu, ka na ele, lula ama lamatua paca'e ne sa dedha.

source_text: and metushelach lived a hundred eighty and seven shanah, and fathered lamech.
target_text: lod'o metusalak d'ai cangasu aru nguru pidhu tèu, na matana ana mone èci, ngara na lamek.

source_text: and metushelach lived after he fathered lamech seven hundred eighty and two shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: èle èèna ka, metusalak mamuri hari d'ai pidhu ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of metushelach were nine hundred sixty and nine shanah; and he died.
target_text: umur metusalak ceo ngasu èna nguru ceo tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and lamech lived a hundred eighty and two shanah and fathered ben;
target_text: lod'o lamek mamuri d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and he called shmo noach, saying, zeh yenachamenu this shall comfort us in our work and toil of our hands, because of the adamah which hashem hath cursed.
target_text: lamek pangare ne noh dhu sasoa na ‘pakarej'e d'ara', lula na peka na, ana ne, èèna na pakarej'e d'ara èdhi nèti sasab'a dhu bia, ètu rai dhu ama lamatua dhoo le.

source_text: and lamech lived after he fathered noach five hundred ninety and five shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
target_text: ka lamek mamuri taruu d'ai lèmi ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, aa na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven shanah; and he died.
target_text: umur lamek pidhu ngasu pidhu nguru pidhu tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and noach was five hundred years old; and noach fathered shem, cham, and yephet.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na matana ana mone dhèu tèlu, sem, yafet dènge ham.

source_text: and it came to pass, when haadam began to multiply on the face of ha'adamah, and banot were born unto them,
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu rai-haha, asa bèba-kacanga. ka ra papala-palème rai-haha. dhèu se matana kahèi ana-ana bhèni.

source_text: that the bnei haelohim saw the banot haadam that they were tovot; and they took them nashim of all which they chose.
target_text: ana-ana mone nèti lamatua ladhe rèdhi ana bhèni nèti dhèu rai-haha se, bhèni iia hua. ka lasi todhe rare ana bhèni mia dhu ra d'èi.

source_text: and hashem said, my ruach hakodesh shall not always strive with adam, for that he also is basar: yet his yamim shall be a hundred and twenty shanah.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a roca le dènge tatao dhèu dhu lèke-lèke boe se. roh ja'a dhu pamamuri rèngu sa, d'èi heka hia ra mamuri manèro. hud'i rèngu madhe ku. de èèna na, mamuri rèngu se dhoka d'ai ca ngasu dua nguru tèu di.

source_text: hanefilim were on ha'aretz in those yamim; and also after that, when the bnei haelohim came in unto the banot haadam, and they bore children to them, the same became gibborim which were of old, men of renown.
target_text: taa èèna, dènge taa-tebho dhu limuri nèti èèna hari, abhu le dhèu raksasa ètu rai-haha ne. ropa ana mone nèti lamatua leo rare ana bhèni dhèu rai-haha se, ka rara iisi dhèu kapai, nuka: kapala musu, dhèu re'a madhutu lii lolo uru-uru sèra.

source_text: and hashem saw that the wickedness of haadam was great in ha'aretz and that every yetzer inclination of the machshevot thoughts of his lev was only rah evil continually.
target_text: taa èèna, lamatua ladhe nèdhi bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha dhu seli-kolane. d'ara rèngu pangee dhoka bhabhelu di.

source_text: and hashem relented that he had made haadam on ha'aretz, and he was grieved in his lev.
target_text: ka lamatua manyasa, lula na paj'aj'i le rèngu se ho pea ètu rai-haha ne. tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu papèd'a d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and hashem said, i will wipe out haadam whom i have created from the face of ha'adamah; both adam, and behemah, and the remes and the oph hashomayim; for i relent that i have made them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na peka na, dènge tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, ja'a huku pamadhe dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu paj'aj'i kore si le. manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, ja'a palaho aa'i si kahèi. te ja'a manyasa, nèti ja'a ka paj'aj'i si.

source_text: but noach found chen grace, unmerited favor in the eyes of hashem.
target_text: te ngaa noh di dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: these are the toldot of noach; noach was an ish tzaddik and tamim among those of his time, and noachʼs halachah was with haelohim. and noach fathered three banim: shem, cham, and yephet.
target_text: lii lolo noh sèmi ne'e ka: ana mone na, dhèu tèlu, nuka sem, yafet dènge ham. noh mamuri dènge mola, koe-kapengo boe. taa èèna, nèngu di dhu mamuri mola. d'ara na dhodhoka ètu ama lamatua.

source_text: ha'aretz also was corrupt before haelohim, and ha'aretz was filled with chamas. and elohim looked upon ha'aretz, and, hinei, it was corrupt; for kol basar had corrupted his derech upon ha'aretz.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo se, ama lamatua ladhe ra bhelu aa'i mèu-mèu. ètu mia-mia èèna ka, j'ara mamuri dhèu se ele iie aa'i. ama lamatua nèdhi dhodhoka bhabhelu di, ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and elohim said unto noach, the ketz end of kol basar is come before me; for ha'aretz is filled with chamas because of them; and, hineni, i will destroy them with ha'aretz.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge noh, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi dhoka bhabhelu dhèu di, dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pama'ète kore le, sèna ka ja'a palaho aa'i rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: make thee a tevah ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the tevah ark, and shalt coat it within and without with tar.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, noh! èu tao kapa aae cue, dhu tao nèti aj'u adhu. re d'ara roa na, èu bagi mi kama-kama. aa re d'ara dènge li'u kapa, èu lame dènge èi dama.

source_text: and this is how thou shalt build it: the length of the tevah ark shall be three hundred cubits, the width of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
target_text: mu sab'e kapa na, madhera na ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèlu meter; bhabhèla na dua nguru dua meter; dènge katitu na canguru tèlu meter.

source_text: a roof shalt thou make to the tevah ark, and thou shalt finish it to a cubit from the top; and the petach of the tevah ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third decks shalt thou make it.
target_text: èu tao èmu ètu dedha kapa na. te ngaa paconga ca laa ai nèti kadidhi re dedha. èu bagi kapa ne mi tèlu tad'a. aa re karasa na, tao babèdho èci.

source_text: and, hineni, i, even i, do bring a mabbul of waters upon ha'aretz, to destroy kol basar, wherein is the ruach chayyim, from under shomayim; and everything that is in ha'aretz shall perish.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bèli-camèd'a, ja'a papuru èi aae lala, ho pacène eele rai-haha ne, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: and then with thee will i establish my brit covenant; and thou shalt come into the tevah ark, thou, and thy banim, and thy isha, and the nashim of thy banim with thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. èèna na, èu maso d'ara kapa èèna, mèti dènge dhèu èmu èu, ana-ana èu, dènge dhèu èmu ana-ana èu.

source_text: and of every living thing of kol basar, two of every kind shalt thou bring into the tevah ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be zachar and nekevah. of birds after their kind, and of behemah after their kind, of every remes of ha'adamah after its kind, two of every kind shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
target_text: badha aa'i-aa'i ra, èu hag'e more ca pasa-ca pasa, eo mèti asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri dènge èu kahèi. sèmi: badha ani, manu-bhui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: and take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for ochel for thee, and for them.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti dènge nganga'a-nganginu, pala miu dènge pala badha sèra hèi.

source_text: thus did noach; according to all that elohim commanded him, so did he.
target_text: ka noh sab'e madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and hashem said unto noach, come thou and all thy bais into the tevah ark; for thee have i found tzaddik before me in dor hazeh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka dènge noh, ja'a ladhe le palème, te ngaa abhu dhoka èu di dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge bhèni-ana niki èu, lami ka asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: of every behemah hatehorah thou shalt take to thee by sevens; the male and his mate; and of behemah that are not tehorah by two, the male and his mate. of also oph hashomayim by sevens, the zachar and the nekevah; to keep zera alive upon the face of kol ha'aretz.
target_text: mèti dènge badha-badha dhu bisa mi'a, aa bisa hia ja'a kahèi, de mèti pidhu-pidhu pasa asa d'ara kapa. mèti kahèi rupa-rupa manu-bhui pidhu-pidhu pasa. te ngaa badha dhu leo, mèti dhoka ca pasa-ca pasa di. sèna ka badha dènge manu-bhui se, j'aj'i hini, ho baku ma'ète.

source_text: for shivah yamim from now, and i will cause it to rain upon ha'aretz arba'im yom and arba'im lailah; and every living creature that i have made will i wipe out from off the p'nei ha'adamah.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie, oo! di pidhu lod'o ka, ja'a papuru èj'i aae mai dhu bhoka boe ca lod'o sa, toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. dènge sèmi ne'e, ja'a pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai, dhu ja'a paj'aj'i kore le.

source_text: and noach did according unto all that hashem commanded him.
target_text: ka noh tao aa'i sèmi lii paredha lamatua.

source_text: and noach was shesh me'ot shanah when the mabbul waters were upon ha'aretz.
target_text: lod'o èi aae lala, umur noh èna ngasu tèu.

source_text: and noach entered in, and his banim, and his isha, and nashim of his banim with him, into the tevah ark, because of the waters of the mabbul.
target_text: noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana niki na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana ra di, lasi asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: of behemah hatehorah, and of behemah that are not tehorah, and of haoph, and of every thing that creepeth upon ha'adamah, there went in shnayim shnayim unto noach into the tevah ark, the zachar and the nekevah, as elohim had commanded noach.
target_text: madhutu lii paredha lamatua, ka noh pamaso manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, èci-èci ka dènge pasa na, nèti dhu bisa ra'a, dènge dhu bisa boe ra'a.

source_text: and it came to pass after shivat hayamim, that the waters of the mabbul were upon ha'aretz.
target_text: ropa èle pidhu lod'o, cag'ag'a laa èi aae lala, ka rai-haha ne, mulai cène.

source_text: in the six hundredth year of noachʼs life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of shomayim were opened.
target_text: lèke dènge umur noh èna ngasu tèu, risi dua hèru, canguru pidhu lod'o, ka mulai èi aae lala. lod'o èèna, sèmi babèdho liru dhu bhoke eele sa, ka èi na tao sabhori mai. aa èi madha-èi madha ètu rai-haha sabhoka, ka sèmi tao sabhuu sa dedha.

source_text: and the geshem was upon ha'aretz arba'im yom and arba'im lailah.
target_text: ka èj'i bhori mai loe boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda.

source_text: on that very yom entered noach, and shem, and cham, and yephet, the bnei noach, and noachʼs isha, and the three nashim of his banim with them, into the tevah ark;
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana mone na dhèu tèlu: sem, yafet dènge ham, dènge dhèu èmu ra, maso lasi asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: they, and every beast after its kind, and kol habehemah after their kind, and every remes that crawls upon ha'aretz after its kind, and kol haoph after its kind, every bird of every sort.
target_text: lasi palere dènge badha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, manu-bhui, dènge badha-badha leo dhu dènge èla sèra.

source_text: and they went in unto noach into the tevah ark, shnayim shnayim of kol habasar, wherein is the ruach chayyim. and they that went in, went in zachar and nekevah of kol basar, as elohim had commanded him; then hashem shut him in.
target_text: ca pasa-ca pasa nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, lasi asa d'ara kapa palere dènge noh, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ropa aa'i-aa'i ra d'ai d'ara kapa, lamatua bèdho babèdho kapa èèna.

source_text: and the mabbul was arba'im yom upon ha'aretz; and the waters increased, and lifted up the tevah ark, and it rose above ha'aretz. and the waters rose, and were increased greatly upon ha'aretz; and the tevah ark floated upon the face of the waters. and the waters rose exceedingly upon ha'aretz; and all the high hills, that were under kol hashomayim, were covered.
target_text: èj'i aae puru ma'ète boe d'ai èpa nguru lod'o. hèia kapa èèna taleb'o. èi ca'e loe boe toke hutu nare kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae.

source_text: fifteen cubits upward did the waters rise; and the harim were covered.
target_text: èi ca'e taruu, ka marèma na seli èpa rèpa risi nèti kolo ledhe sèra.

source_text: and kol basar perished that moved upon ha'aretz, both of oph, and of behemah, and of beast, and of every swarming thing that swarms upon ha'aretz, and kol haadam; all in whose nostrils was the ruach chayyim, of all that was in the dry land, perished. and every living creature was wiped out which was upon the p'nei haadamah, both adam, and behemah, and the remes, and the oph hashomayim; and they were wiped out from ha'aretz: and noach only remained alive, and they that were with him in the tevah ark.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai sèra, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. nuka: dhèu, badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. ate dhoka noh dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa.

source_text: and the waters flooded upon ha'aretz a hundred and fifty days.
target_text: èi na, kura boe toke ca ngasu lèmi nguru lod'o.

source_text: and elohim remembered noach, and every living thing, and all the behemah that was with him in the tevah ark; and elohim made a ruach to pass over ha'aretz, and the waters subsided;
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe noh si dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa. hèia na hia ngèlu g'oro, ka èi na kura ka noo-noo.

source_text: the ma'ayanot springs also of the tehom and the floodgates of shomayim were stopped, and the geshem from shomayim was restrained;
target_text: na katange èi madha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa na taha èj'i kahèi.

source_text: and the waters receded from on ha'aretz continually; and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
target_text: ka èi kura noo-noo ka. d'ai cangasu lèmi nguru lod'o, èi marèma heka.

source_text: and the tevah ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of ararat.
target_text: lèke dènge hèru ka pidhu, risi canguru pidhu lod'o, kapa eta ètu kolo ledhe aae èci, ngara na ararat.

source_text: and the waters decreased continually until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the rashei heharim seen.
target_text: èi kura taruu toke lod'o ka èci, hèru ka canguru, ka kolo-kolo ledhe cèu noo-noo.

source_text: and it came to pass at the end of arba'im yom, that noach opened the chalon window of the tevah ark which he had made;
target_text: risi nèti èpa nguru lod'o, hèia noh bhoke jendela èci.

source_text: and he sent forth the orev raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off ha'aretz.
target_text: ka na patalale lakaa ci'u. manu-bhui ne lela la'e-mai, toke èi puru. ka na lèpa heka asa kapa.

source_text: also he sent forth a yonah dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the adamah;
target_text: hèia noh patabuli hari, koro j'aha ci'u, sèna ka neo ne'a èi na puru le, do dhae.

source_text: but the yonah found no manoach place of rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the tevah, for the waters were on the p'nei kol ha'aretz; then he reached forth his yad, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the tevah ark.
target_text: te ngaa, lula èi hutu nare dedha-rai era, ka koro ne abhu boe era tèka. ka lèpa hari asa kapa. hèia noh j'ole ai na, kèpe nare, ka na pamaso hari asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: and he waited yet another shivat yamim; and again he sent forth the yonah out of the tevah ark;
target_text: ka noh tatae hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patabuli hari koro j'aha deo na.

source_text: and the yonah returned to him in the erev; and, hinei, in her beak was a zayit olive leaf freshly plucked; so noach had da'as that the mayim were abated from off ha'aretz.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia sa, koro ne lèpa hari la'e asa noh, tutu nèti dènge rèu saitun ca rèu dhu heka tutu nare kèna. nèti èèna ka, noh heka ne'a kèna, èi na dhu puru le tare'a di.

source_text: and he waited yet another shivat yamim; and sent forth the yonah; which returned not unto him again.
target_text: ka na mate hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patalale hari koro j'aha ca hari ni. te ngaa ca tèka ne, koro ne lèpa heka.

source_text: and it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the mayim were dried up from off ha'aretz; and noach removed the mikhseh covering of the tevah ark, and looked, and, hinei, the surface of the adamah was dry.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai èna ngasu ca tèu, lèke lod'o ka èci hèru èci, èi mèti aa'i le. hèia noh bhoke jendela, ka na ladhe palème, nèdhi rai dhu mango le.

source_text: and in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was ha'aretz dry.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka dua, lod'o ka dua nguru pidhu, dedha-rai ne dhu mango meto le.

source_text: and elohim spoke unto noach, saying,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge noh,

source_text: go forth of the tevah ark, thou, and thy isha, and thy banim, and the nashim of thy banim with thee.
target_text: noh! aa'i-aa'i mi puru ka nèti dedha kapa èèna.

source_text: bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of kol basar, both of bird, and of behemah, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon ha'aretz; that they may multiply abundantly on ha'aretz, and be fruitful, and increase upon ha'aretz.
target_text: papuru aa'i badha-manu sèra! nuka: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. hud'i si, sèna ka ra bèba, papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and noach went forth, and his banim, and his isha, and the nashim of his banim with him; every animal, every remes, and every bird, and whatsoever creepeth upon ha'aretz, after their kinds, went forth out of the tevah ark.
target_text: èle èèna ka, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana-ana na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana na sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra puru nèti dedha kapa èèna. badha se, aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua ka madhutu anga ra èci-èci.

source_text: and noach built a mizbe'ach unto hashem; and took of every behemah hatehorah, and of kol haoph hatahor, and offered olot burnt offerings on the mizbe'ach.
target_text: hèia noh pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban hia lamatua. nèti badha-badha dhu bisa ra'a sèra, noh nare ci'u-ci'u, ka na roro, tunu ètu dedha mei deo na, ho j'aj'i mi tadha makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and hashem smelled a re'ach hannichoach; and hashem said in his lev, i will not again curse the adamah any more ba'avur because of haadam; for the yetzer of the lev haadam is rah from his ne'urim youth, childhood; neither will i again strike any more every thing living, as i have done.
target_text: ropa lamatua sangèd'u nare hèu gèmu korban deo na, d'ara na karej'e. ka na ngee na, nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a huku heka rai-haha ne, lula bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu. masi ka rèngu dhoka ngee bhabhelu di, ja'a pa'ele iie heka ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, sèmi dhu ja'a heka tao kore èèna.

source_text: while ha'aretz remaineth, zera seedtime and katzir harvest, and kor cold and chom heat, and kayitz summer and choref winter, and yom and lailah, shall not cease.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha ne era, hèru dènge tèu, kako madhutu atora. sèmi: hèru sèla dènge hèru puu-g'ètu, hèru pacuhi dènge hèru sagoro, hèru hadhu dènge hèru èj'i lai, mèu dènge mèda.

source_text: vayevarech elohim et noach and his banim, and said unto them, be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish ha'aretz.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pala-bagi berkat mi noh dènge ana-ana na, peka na, miu matana pa'ae-ae, sèna ka papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of ha'aretz, and upon every bird of the air, upon all that moveth upon ha'adamah, and upon all the dagim of the yam; into your yad are they delivered.
target_text: ladhe èèna na, badha hui, manu-bhui dènge i'a aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge miu. miu ka dhu ator si.

source_text: every remes that liveth shall be food for you; even as the yarok esev green plant have i given you all.
target_text: sisi badha aa'i-aa'i, miu bisa mi'a, sèmi dhu mi'a hua-hela, dènge rèu ana aaj'u se. aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a hia miu.

source_text: but basar with the nefesh thereof, which is the dahm thereof, shall ye not eat.
target_text: dhoka sisi dhu dènge raa era, miu madha mèu mi'a, lula samanga badha ètu raa na.

source_text: and surely your dahm of your nefeshot will i require; at the hand of every beast will i require it, and at the yad haadam; at the hand of every manʼs brother will i require the nefesh haadam. shofech dahm one who sheddeth manʼs blood, by man shall his dahm be shed; for in the tzelem elohim made he man.
target_text: ja'a paj'aj'i dhèu madhutu raropa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, baku pamadhe dhèu. ladhe abhu dhèu, do badha, dhu pamadhe dhèu, na, pamadhe ne kahèi. ne'e, lii paredha nèti ja'a.

source_text: and you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly on ha'aretz, and multiply therein.
target_text: miu se hud'i matana pa'ae-ae ku, sèna ka papènu hari rai-haha ne.

source_text: and elohim spoke unto noach, and to his banim with him, saying,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na,

source_text: and i, hineni, i establish my brit covenant with you, and with your zera after you;
target_text: de ne'e ne, ja'a pajaji dènge miu, toke d'ai lai ana lai èpu.

source_text: and with kol nefesh that is with you, of the bird, of the behemah, and of every animal of ha'aretz with you; from kol yotzei hatevah all that go out of the ark, to every creature of ha'aretz.
target_text: lii pajaji ne, lèke kahèi mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, dènge manu-bhui. peka ka laa, lèke aa'i-aa'i dhu kalua palere-lere dènge miu nèti dedha kapa.

source_text: and i will establish my brit covenant with you, neither shall kol basar yikaret be cut off, violently killed any more by the waters of the mabbul; neither shall there be any more mabbul l'shacheit to destroy ha'aretz.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a hia heka èi aae lala, ho pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, aa dènge pa'ele iie rai-haha ne.

source_text: and elohim said, this is the ot sign of the brit covenant which i make between me and you and every nefesh chayyah living creature that is with you, for dorot olam perpetual generations; i do set my keshet bow in the anan cloud, and it shall be for an ot brit between me and ha'aretz.
target_text: ja'a pasa saroo ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha pasanèd'e lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe dènge miu, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, aa dènge rai-haha ne.

source_text: and it shall come to pass, when i bring an anan over ha'aretz, that the keshet be'anan rainbow shall be seen; and i will remember my brit, which is between me and you and kol nefesh chayyah of kol basar; and the waters shall no more become a mabbul flood l'shacheit to destroy kol basar. and the keshet shall be in the anan; and i will look upon it, that i may remember the brit olam between elohim and kol nefesh chayyah of kol basar that is upon ha'aretz. and elohim said unto noach, this is the ot habrit, which i have established between me and kol basar that is upon ha'aretz.
target_text: ladhe abhu ra'i-liru, ho saroo cèu, èèna na pasanèd'e ja'a nèti lii pajaji èèna. na peka na, èi aae pa'ele iie heka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri. dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe, pa'èki tèke le dènge miu, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: and the bnei noach, that went forth of the tevah, were shem, and cham, and yephet; and cham is the av of kena'an canaan.
target_text: ana-ana noh dhu puru nèti dedha kapa, sem, yafet dènge ham ham èèna, ama kana'an.

source_text: shloshah three are the bnei noach; and of them was the kol ha'aretz populated.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i nèti ana noh dhèu tèlu sèra.

source_text: and noach began to be an ish ha'adamah a man of the soil, and he planted a kerem vineyard;
target_text: noh èèna, dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. nèngu ka dhu uru j'ara tao oka anggor.

source_text: and he drank of the yayin, and became shikker intoxicated; and he lay uncovered inside his ohel.
target_text: ca tèka, na ninu èi anggor, ka na mahu titu kèna. hèia na puru eele mèdha-papake nèti ua na. ka na j'unu lega-loli dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu d'ara paleo na.

source_text: and cham, the av of kena'an, saw the erom nakedness of his av, and told his two achim on the outside.
target_text: ropa ham ladhe nèdhi era makae ama na, ka rai li'u la'e, lolo dènge a'a na, sem dènge yafet.

source_text: and shem and yephet took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and walked backward, and covered the erom of their av; and their faces were turned the other way, and they saw not the erom of their av.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: and noach awoke from his yayin, and had da'as of what his ben katan had done unto him.
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: and he said, arur cursed be kena'an; an eved of avadim shall he be unto his achim.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: and he said, baruch hashem elohei shem; and kena'an shall be his eved.
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: elohim shall enlarge yephet, and he shall dwell in the tents of shem; and kena'an shall be his eved.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: and noach lived after the mabbul three hundred and fifty years.
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: and all the days of noach were nine hundred and fifty years; and he died.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: now these are the toldot of the bnei noach: shem, cham, and yephet; and unto them were banim born after the mabbul flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: the bnei yephet: gomer, and magog, and madai, and yavan, and tuval, and meshech, and tiras. and the bnei gomer: ashkenaz, and riphat, and togarmah. and the bnei yavan: elishah, and tarshish, kittim, and dodanim. by these were the coastlands of the goyim divided in their lands; every one after his leshon, after their mishpechot, in their goyim.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: and the bnei cham: cush, and mitzrayim, and put, and kena'an.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: and the bnei cush: seva, and chavilah, and savtah, and ra'amah, and savtecha; and the bnei raamah: sheva, and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: and cush fathered nimrod; he began to be a gibbor in ha'aretz.
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: he was a gibbor, a hunter before hashem; therefore it is said, like nimrod the gibbor, the hunter before hashem.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the beginning of his kingdom was bavel, and erech, and akkad, and calneh, in eretz shinar.
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: out of that land he went forth to ashur, and built nineveh, and rechovot-ir, and kelach,
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: and resen between nineveh and kelach; the same is hair hagedolah.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: and mitzrayim fathered ludim, and anamim, and lehavim, and naphtuchim,
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: and patrusim, and casluchim, out of whom came pelishtim philistines, and caphtorim.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and kena'an fathered tzidon his bechor, and chet,
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: and the yevusi, and the emori, and the girgashi,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: and the chivi, and the arki, and the sini,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: and the arvadi, and the tzemari, and the chamati; and afterward were the mishpechot hakena'ani spread abroad.
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: and the boundary of the kena'ani was from tzidon, as thou comest to gerar, unto azah gaza; as thou goest, unto sodom, and amora gomorrah, and admah, and tzevoyim, even unto lesha.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: these are the bnei cham, after their mishpechot, after their leshonot, in their territories, and in their goyim.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: also unto shem avi kol bnei ever, and the older brother of yephet, even to him were offspring born.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: the bnei shem: eilam, and ashur, and arpachshad, and lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: and bnei aram: utz, and chul, and geter, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: and arpachshad fathered shelach; and shelach fathered ever.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: and unto ever were born two banim: the shem of one was peleg; for in his days was ha'aretz divided; and his brotherʼs shem was yoktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: and yoktan fathered almodad, and sheleph, and chatzarmavet, and yerach,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: and hadoram, and uzal, and diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: and oval, and avimael, and sheva,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: and ophir, and chavilah, and yovav; all these were the bnei yoktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: and their moshav dwelling was from mesha, as thou goest unto sephar har hakedem.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these are the bnei shem, after their mishpechot, according to their leshonot, in their territories, after their goyim.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: these are the mishpechot of the bnei noach, after their toldot, in their goyim; and by these were the goyim divided/separated in ha'aretz after the mabbul.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the kol haaretz was of one language and of devarim achadim common words.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: and it came to pass, as they migrated from the east, that they found a plain in eretz shinar; and they dwelt there.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and they said one to another, come, let us make brick, and bake them thoroughly. and they had brick for even stone, and bitumen had they for mortar. and they said, come, let us build us an ir and a migdal, whose rosh top may reach unto shomayim; and let us make us a shem, otherwise we shall be scattered abroad upon the face of kol haaretz.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: and hashem came down to see the ir and the migdal, which bnei haadam built.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: and hashem said, see, the am is echad and they have all one language; and this they begin to do; and now nothing will be impossible for them, which they have proposed to do.
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: come, let us go down, and there confuse their sefat, that they may not understand one anotherʼs language.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: so hashem scattered them abroad from there upon the face of kol ha'aretz; and they left off building the ir.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: therefore is the shem of it called bavel; because hashem did there confuse the language of kol ha'aretz; and from there did hashem scatter them abroad upon the face of kol ha'aretz.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: these are the toldot of shem: shem was a hundred years old, and fathered arpachshad two years after the mabbul;
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: and shem lived after he fathered arpachshad five hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and arpachshad lived five and thirty shanah, and fathered shelach;
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: and arpachshad lived after he fathered shelach four hundred and three shanim, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and shelach lived thirty shanah, and fathered ever;
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: and shelach lived after he fathered ever four hundred and three shanah, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and ever lived four and thirty shanah, and fathered peleg;
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: and ever lived after he fathered peleg four hundred and thirty shanah, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and peleg lived thirty shanah, and fathered reu;
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: and peleg lived after he fathered reu two hundred and nine shanim, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and reu lived two and thirty shanah, and fathered serug;
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: and reu lived after he fathered serug two hundred and seven shanim, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and serug lived thirty shanah, and fathered nachor;
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: and serug lived after he fathered nachor two hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and nachor lived nine and twenty shanah, and fathered terach;
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: and nachor lived after he fathered terach a hundred and nineteen shanah, and fathered banim and banot.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and terach lived seventy shanah, and fathered avram, nachor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: now these are the toldot terach: terach fathered avram, nachor, and haran; and haran fathered lot.
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: and haran died before his av terach in the land of his birth, in ur kasdim.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: and avram and nachor took them nashim: the shem eshet avram was sarai; and the shem eshet nachor was milcah, the bat haran avi milcah, and avi yiskah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: but sarai was barren; she had no child.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: and terach took avram bno, and ben bno lot ben haran, and sarai his shnur, eshet avram bno; and they went forth with them from ur kasdim, to go into eretz kena'an; and they came unto charan haran, and dwelt there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of terach were two hundred and five shanim; and terach died in charan haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: now hashem had said unto avram, get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from the bais avicha, unto ha'aretz that i will show thee;
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: so that i will make of thee a goy gadol great nation, so that i will bless thee, and make thy shem great; and so thou shalt be a brocha blessing;
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and i will bless the one blessing you, and curse him that curses you; and kol mishpochot haadamah shall be blessed through you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: so avram departed as hashem had told him; and lot went with him; and avram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of charan. and avram took sarai his isha, and lot his brotherʼs son, and all their possessions that they had amassed, and the nefesh that they had gotten in charan; and they went forth to go into the land of kena'an; and they arrived in the land of kena'an.
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: and avram passed through the land unto the makom shechem, unto elon moreh. and the kena'ani was then in ha'aretz.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and hashem appeared unto avram, and said, unto thy zera will i give ha'aretz hazot: and there built he a mizbe'ach unto hashem, who appeared unto him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and he removed from there unto the harah mikedem beit-el, and pitched his tent, having beit-el on the west, and ai on the east; and there he built a mizbe'ach unto hashem, and called upon the shem of hashem.
