target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and avram journeyed, going on still toward the negev.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: and there was a ra'av in the land; and avram went down into mitzrayim to sojourn there; for the ra'av was severe in ha'aretz.
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he was about to enter into mitzrayim, that he said unto sarai his isha, hinei now, i know that thou art an isha yafeh to look upon;
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: therefore it shall come to pass, when the egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, this is his isha; and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu masir rèdhi èu bhèni iia sèmi ne'e, mage dhoka ra pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a dhèu èmu-kamali èu. dènge sèmi èèna, ra parame rare èu.

source_text: say, now, thou art my achot; that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my nefesh shall live on account of thee.
target_text: de be'a risi, èu peka dènge ra, na ja'a ne, ana mone èu. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu pamadhe boe ja'a, aa ra be'a-be'a dènge ja'a, lula èu ne.

source_text: and it came to pass, that, when avram was come into mitzrayim, the egyptians beheld the isha that she was yafeh me'od.
target_text: ropa abram si d'ai masir, dhèu ètu èèna, ladhe laa na, sarai ne bhèni iia titu kèna.

source_text: the sarim of pharaoh also saw her, and commended her before pharaoh; and the isha was taken into bais pharaoh.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and he treated avram well for her sake: and he acquired sheep and oxen, and male donkeys, and avadim, and shfachot, and female donkeys, and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and hashem plagued pharaoh and his bais with nega'im gedolim because of sarai eshet avram.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: and pharaoh summoned avram and said, what is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy isha?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why saidst thou, she is my achot? so i might have taken her to me to wife; now therefore, hinei, thy wife, take her, and go!
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: and pharaoh commanded his anashim concerning him; and they sent him away, and his isha, and all that he had.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: and avram went up out of mitzrayim, he, and his isha, and all that he had, and lot with him, into the negev.
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: and avram was very rich in cattle, in kesef, and in zahav.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he went on his journeys from the negev even to beit-el, unto the makom where his ohel had been at the beginning, between beit-el and ai;
target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: unto the makom of the mizbe'ach, which he had built there at the first; and there avram called on the shem of hashem.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: and lot also, which walked with avram, had tzon, and herds, and ohalim.
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: and ha'aretz was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together; for their rechush was rav, so that they could not dwell together. and there was a riv between the ro'im of the herd of avram and the ro'im of the herd of lot; and the kena'ani and the perizzi dwelt then in ha'aretz.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and avram said unto lot, let there be no merivah now between me and thee, and between my ro'im and thy ro'im; for we are achim.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: is not the kol ha'aretz before thee? separate thyself, now, from me; if thou wilt take the left hand, then i will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then i will go to the left.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: and lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of yarden, that it was well watered everywhere, before hashem destroyed sodom and amora, even as the gan hashem, like eretz mitzrayim, as you go to tzoar.
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: then lot chose for him all the plain of yarden; and lot journeyed mikedem east; and they separated themselves the one from his brother.
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: avram dwelled in eretz kena'an, and lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his ohel toward sodom.
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: but the men of sodom were ra'im and chatta'im before hashem exceedingly.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: and hashem said unto avram, after that lot was separated from him, lift up now thine eyes, and look from the makom where thou art northward, and southward and eastward, and westward:
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: for kol ha'aretz which thou seest, to thee will i give it, and to thy zera ad olam forever.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and i will make thy zera as the dust of ha'aretz; so that if a man can number the aphar of ha'aretz, then shall thy zera also be numbered.
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: arise, walk through ha'aretz in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for i will give it unto thee.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: then avram moved his ohel, and came and dwelt in elonei mamre, which is in chevron, and built there a mizbe'ach unto hashem.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass in the yamim of amraphel melech shinar, aryoch melech ellasar, kedorlaomer melech eilam, and tidal melech goyim;
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: that these made milchamah with bera melech sodom, and with birsha melech amora gomorrah, shinav melech admah, and shemever melech tzevoyim, and the melech of bela, which is tzoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: all these were joined together in the valley of siddim which is the yam hamelach.
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: twelve shanah they served kedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: and in the fourteenth year came kedorlaomer, and the melachim that were with him, and they defeated the repha'im in ashterot karnayim, and the zuzim in ham, and the emim in shaveh-kiryatayim,
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: and the chori in their mt se'ir, as far as eil-paran, which is near the midbar.
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: and they turned, and came to ein mishpat, which is kadesh, and conquered all the country of the amaleki, and also the emori, that dwelt in chatzetzon-tamar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: and there went out the melech sodom, and the melech amora gomorrah, and the melech admah, and the melech tzevoyim, and the melech bela that is, tzoar; and they joined in milchamah with them in the valley of siddim; with kedorlaomer melech eilam, and with tidal melech goyim, and amraphel melech shinar, and aryoch melech ellasar; four melachim against five.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: and the valley of siddim was full of tar pits; and the melech sodom and amora gomorrah they fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: and they took all the possessions of sodom and amora gomorrah, and all their ochel, and went their way.
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and they took lot, avramʼs brotherʼs son, who dwelt in sodom, and his possessions, and departed.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and there came one that had escaped, and told avram haivri; for he dwelt in elonei mamre the emori, brother of eshcol, and brother of aner; and these were ba'alei brit avram.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: and when avram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained men, born in his own bais, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them as far as dan.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: and he divided himself against them, he and his avadim, by lailah, and routed them, and pursued them as far as chovah, which is on the left hand north of damascus.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: and he recovered all the possessions, and also brought again his brother lot, and his possessions, and the nashim also, and the people.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: and the melech sodom went out to meet him after his return from the defeat of kedorlaomer, and of the melachim that were with him, at the valley of shaveh, which is the valley of the king.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: and malki-tzedek melech shalem brought forth lechem and yayin and he was the kohen of el elyon.
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: and he blessed him, and said, baruch avram by el elyon, possessor of shomayim va'aretz; and baruch el elyon, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. and he gave him ma'aser tithe of all.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: and the melech sodom said unto avram, give me the nefesh and keep the possessions for thyself.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: and avram said to the melech sodom, i have lifted up mine hand unto hashem, el elyon possessor of shomayim va'aretz,
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: that i will not take from a thread even to the thong of a sandal, and that i will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, i have made avram rich;
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the chelek of the anashim which went with me, aner, eshcol, and mamre; let them take their chelek.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: after these things the devar hashem came unto avram in a makhazeh, saying, fear not, avram; i am thy mogen, and thy exceeding great sachar reward.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: and avram said, adonoi hashem, what wilt thou give me, since i go childless, and the ben meshek of my bais is this eli'ezer of damesek damascus? and avram said, see, to me thou hast given no zera; and, hinei, one born in my bais is my yoresh heir.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and, hinei, the devar hashem came unto him saying, this shall not be thy yoresh; but he that shall come forth out of thine own body shall be thy yoresh.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: and he brought him forth outside, and said, look now toward shomayim, and count the kokhavim, if thou be able to number them; and he said unto him, so shall thy zera be.
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: and he believed in hashem; and he credited emunah faith to him as tzedakah righteousness.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: and he said unto him, i am hashem who brought thee out of ur kasdim, to give thee ha'aretz hazot to be the yoresh of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: and he said, adonoi hashem, how can i have da'as that i will be its yoresh?
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: and he said unto him, bring me a heifer meshuleshet, and a she goat meshuleshet, and a ram meshulash, and a dove, and a pigeon.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: and he brought unto him all these, and divided them in two, and laid each half one opposite another; but the birds divided he not.
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and when the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, avram drove them away.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: and when the shemesh was going down, a tardemah fell upon avram; and, hinei, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and hashem said unto avram, know of a surety that thy zera shall be a ger in a land not their own, and will serve them; and they will mistreat them arba me'ot shanah; and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will i judge; and afterward shall they come out with rechush gadol great substance. and thou shalt go to thy avot in shalom; thou shalt be buried at a good old age.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: but in the fourth generation they shall come back here again; for the avon iniquity of the emori amorite is not yet full.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: and it came to pass, that, when the shemesh went down, and it was dark, hinei a smoking fire-pot, and a blazing torch passed between those pieces.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: and the malach hashem found her by a spring of mayim in the midbar, near the spring on the road to shur.

source_text: and he said, hagar, saraiʼs shifchah, from where camest thou? and where wilt thou go? and she said, i flee from the face of my gevirah sarai.

source_text: and when avram was ninety and nine shanah, hashem appeared to avram, and said unto him, i am el shaddai; walk before me, and be thou tamim blameless.

source_text: and i will confirm my brit covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

source_text: as for me, hinei, my brit covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be an av of many goyim. neither shall thy shem any more be called avram, but thy shem shall be avraham; for av hamon goyim father of a multitude of goyim have i made thee.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu sèmi ne'e ka: èèna na, èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. nèti èèna ka, èu pake ia ka ngara èu abram dhu sasoa na ‘ama dhu dhèu tadhe', te ngaa abraham dhu sasoa na ‘bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae'.

source_text: and i will make thee exceeding fruitful, and i will make goyim of thee, and melechim shall come out of thee.
target_text: ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu ae-ae. ja'a paj'aj'i si suku ae-ae. aa ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae nèti rèngu sèra.

source_text: and i will establish my brit covenant between me and thee and thy zera after thee in their dorot for a brit olam, to be elohim unto thee, and to thy zera after thee.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu, aa dènge ana-èpu èu sèra. lii pajaji ne ma'ète boe toke taa-taa, lula ja'a ne'e ka ama lamatua nèti èu dènge ana-èpu mu.

source_text: and i will give unto thee, and to thy zera after thee, the eretz wherein thou art now a ger, kol eretz kena'an, for an achuzzah possession olam everlasting; and i will be their elohim.

source_text: and elohim said unto avraham, thou shalt be shomer over my brit therefore, thou, and thy zera after thee in the dorot. this is my brit covenant, which ye shall be shomer over, between me and you and thy zera after thee; every zachar among you shall be circumcised.
target_text: te ngaa èu dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, hud'i kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji ne, dènge d'ara kateme ku. dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ra, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: and ye shall circumcise the basar of your arelah; and it shall be an ot brit sign of the covenant between me and you. and he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every zachar in your dorot, he that is born in the bais, or bought with kesef of any foreigner, which is not of thy zera. he that is born in thy bais, and he that is bought with thy kesef, must be circumcised; and my brit shall be in your basar for a brit olam.
target_text: ne'e ne, mone aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna, mulai nèti umur aru lod'o. a'ari èu, dhèu-dhèu sab'a èu, dènge ènu dhu èu hèli more nèti rai leo, aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i suna si. suna na j'aj'i tadha mi ngi'u miu, dhu pa'èki èdhi taa-taa.

source_text: and the arel uncircumcised zachar whose basar of his arelah foreskin is not circumcised, that nefesh shall be cut off from his people; my brit hefer he broke.
target_text: mone mia dhu suna boe, rèngu sèra maso boe ètu d'ara lii pajaji ja'a ne, aa rèngu sèra j'aj'i boe dhèu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: and elohim said unto avraham, as for sarai thy isha, thou shalt not call her shem sarai, but sarah princess shall her shem be.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu paroa ia ka ngara dhèu èmu mu sarai, te ngaa sara.

source_text: and i will bless her, and give thee ben also of her; yes, will bless her, and she shall give rise to goyim; melechim of peoples shall be from her.
target_text: èèna na ja'a hia mamèngi ae-ae mi sara, sèna ka nara iisi hia èu, ana mone ca dhèu. tare'a! bèli-camèd'a, sara j'aj'i bèi nèti suku ae-ae. aa èèna na, ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae-ae nèti ana-èpu nèngu.

source_text: then avraham fell upon his face, and yitzchak laughed, and said in his lev, shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred shanah? and shall sarah, that is ninety shanah, bear?

source_text: and avraham said unto haelohim, o that yishmael might live before thee!

source_text: and elohim said, sarah thy isha shall bear thee ben indeed; and thou shalt call shmo yitzchak; and i will establish my brit covenant with him for a brit olam, and with his zera after him.

source_text: and as for yishmael, i have heard thee; hinei, i have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve nasi'im princes, rulers shall he father, and i will make him a goy gadol great nation.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi le ngaa dhu èu manèngi kahèi, hia ismael. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia berkat mi nèngu kahèi, aa hia ana-èpu na tabha ae. bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu ismael ne, j'aj'i mi canguru dua kapala suku. aa ana-èpu na suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: but my brit covenant will i establish with yitzchak, which sarah shall bear unto thee at mo'ed hazeh this set time next year.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, lii pajaji ja'a ne, lèke dhoka mi ana mu isak di. tèu mai ni, hèru sèmi ne'e kahèi, sara nara iisi le.

source_text: and he left off speaking with him, and elohim went up from avraham.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, ka ama lamatua tèke eele abraham.

source_text: and avraham took yishmael bno, and all that were born in his bais, and all that were bought with his kesef, every zachar among the men of avrahamʼs bais; and circumcised the basar of their arelah in the very same day, as elohim had said unto him. and avraham was ninety shanah and nine, when he was circumcised in the basar of his arelah. and yishmael bno was thirteen shanah, when he was circumcised in the basar of his arelah foreskin. in the very same day was avraham circumcised, and yishmael bno. and all the men of his bais, born in the bais, and bought with kesef of the foreigner, were circumcised with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, abraham tao dènge ka, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ka na suna. na suna ana na, ismael, dènge dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge ne. lod'o èèna, umur abraham ceo nguru ceo tèu le, aa ismael canguru tèlu tèu.

source_text: and hashem appeared unto him in the terebinth trees of mamre; and he sat in the entrance of the ohel tent in the heat of the day;

source_text: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, hinei, shloshah anashim three men stood by him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the entrance of the ohel, and prostrated himself on the ground,

source_text: and said, adonoi, if now i have found chen favor in thy sight, pass not on by, please, from thy servant;

source_text: and i will bring a morsel of bread, and refresh ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on; because for this purpose are ye come to your servant. and they said, so do, as thou hast said.

source_text: and he took curds, and cholov milk, and the calf which he had prepared, and set it before them; and he stood by them under haetz, and they did eat.
target_text: hèia la'e nare susu, keju dènge sisi dhu heka nasu èèna, nèti hia tamu sèra ra'a. abraham titu taruu ètu mamaho aj'u, ho na lalau si.

source_text: and they said unto him, where is sarah thy wife? and he said, hinei, in the ohel.
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, dhèu èmu mu sara, ka mia? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, nuka d'ara paleo èèna.

source_text: and he said, i will certainly return unto thee at this time next year; and, hinei, sarah thy wife shall have ben son. and sarah heard it in the entrance of the ohel, which was behind him.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se padhai lii, aku nèngu na, pe d'ai tèu mai nèi, ja'a lèpa hari mai. lod'o èèna, dhèu èmu èu sara nare iisi le ana mone ca dhèu. ropa rèngu padhai lii èèna, sara nanene nèti kabodho babèdho.

source_text: now avraham and sarah were zekenim old ones and well stricken in age; and in childbearing it ceased to be with sarah after the manner of women.

source_text: therefore sarah laughed titzchak, sounds like yitzchak within herself, saying, after i am grown old shall i have pleasure, adoni being old also?

source_text: and hashem said unto avraham, why did sarah laugh, saying, shall i which am old of a surety bear a child?

source_text: is any thing too hard for hashem? at the time appointed i will return unto thee, in due season, and sarah shall have ben son.

source_text: then sarah denied, saying, i laughed not; for she was afraid. and he said, oh yes but thou didst laugh.

source_text: seeing that avraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and kol goyei ha'aretz all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

source_text: for i know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall be shomer over the derech hashem, to do tzedakah and mishpat; that hashem may bring upon avraham that which he hath spoken promised of him.

source_text: and hashem said, because the outcry of sodom and amora is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

source_text: i will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the crying out for punishment of it, which is come unto me; and if not, i will have da'as.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a puru madha ku mai, sèna ka kèdhi unu ku, ngaa dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, pe ja'a ke'a unu ku.

source_text: and the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward sodom; but avraham stood yet before hashem.
