source_text: suppose there be fifty tzaddikim within the city; wilt thou also destroy and not nasa spare the place lema'an for the sake of the fifty tzaddikim that are therein?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a ètu d'ara kota èèna, ama pamadhe si hèi? do, ama palaho heka kota sèra, lula rèngu se'e, do?

source_text: that be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the tzaddik with the rasha; and that the tzaddik should be as the rasha, that be far from thee: shall not hashofet kol ha'aretz the judge of all the earth do mishpat right?
target_text: ama baku tao sèmi èèna! mage dhoka, dhèu be'a sèra madhe hèi, lula ama neo pamadhe dhèu bhelu sèra. ama ka dhu pama'ète lii ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. de ama ku unu mu dhu me'a j'ara èèna adil boe.

source_text: and hashem said, if i find in sodom fifty tzaddikim within the city, then i will spare all the place for their sakes.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu be'a lèmi nguru dhèu ètu kota sodom, ja'a huku boe kota èèna, lula rèngu.

source_text: and avraham answered and said, hinei now, i, which am but aphar and ashes, have taken upon me to speak unto hashem;
target_text: hèia abraham padhai lii hari, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a manèngi abho, lula ja'a neo padhai lii hari ciki. ja'a ne dhoka dhèu goa di, dhu ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: suppose there shall lack five of the fifty tzaddikim; wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? and he said, if i find there forty and five, i will not destroy it.
target_text: sèmi d'ai boe dhèu lèmi nguru dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka èpa nguru lèmi di, tasamia? kura dhoka dhèu lèmi di, na ama neo palaho eele kota èèna, do? ka lamatua b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a abhu dhèu be'a èpa nguru lèmi, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and he spoke unto him yet again, and said, suppose there shall be forty found there. and he said, i will not do it for fortyʼs sake.
target_text: ka abraham pamako hari, na, sèmi abhu dhoka èpa nguru dhèu be'a di, tasamia, ama? ka na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu èpa nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he said unto him, oh let not hashem be angry, and i will speak; suppose there shall thirty be found there. and he said, i will not do it, if i find thirty there.
target_text: abraham pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ama baku nasa. te abhu dhoka tèlu nguru dhèu be'a di, na tasamia? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu tèlu nguru dhèu be'a, ja'a huku boe si.

source_text: and he said, hinei now, i have taken upon me to speak unto hashem: suppose there shall be twenty found there. and he said, i will not destroy it for twentyʼs sake.
target_text: hèia abraham peka hari, ama mage nasa ladhe ja'a karèi hari ciki. sèmi abhu dhoka dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, na tasamia? ka na dhaa hari, aku nèngu na, sèmi abhu dhèu dua nguru di dhu be'a, ja'a palaho eele boe kota èèna.

source_text: and he said, oh let not hashem be angry, and i will speak yet but this once: suppose asarah ten, i. e. , a minyan shall be found there. and he said, i will not destroy it for the sake of haasarah the ten.
target_text: ka abraham katange lii padhai na, aa na karèi, peka na, ama! ja'a padhai lii hari ca tèka, te ngaa baku nasa dènge ja'a. tasamia, ladhe abhu dhoka canguru dhèu di dhu be'a? hèia na dhaa, ladhe ja'a abhu canguru dhèu dhu be'a ètu era èèna, ja'a palaho boe kota èèna.

source_text: and hashem went his way, as soon as he had left communing with avraham; and avraham returned unto his makom.
target_text: padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, lamatua la'e dènge ka, aa abraham lèpa kahèi.

source_text: and there came two malachim to sodom at erev; and lot sat in the sha'ar sodom; and lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
target_text: ètu d'ara lamatua dhu padhue-padhai era dènge abraham, ana pajuu na dhèu dua, lasi le asa kota sodom. d'ai nèi, lod'o oe cèna kèna. ka lot dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a tedhe kota. ropa nèdhi dhèu dua se, la'e soru nare si. ka na patitu kètu urutuu, aa pacud'u kètu ètu madha ra.

source_text: and he said, hinei, adonai my masters, turn in, now, into the bais avdechem, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. and they said, lo; but we will abide the night in the rekhov.
target_text: ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, mai lati dhuli ku èmu ja'a la. sèna ka ama si rase haga, aa j'unu ètu èmu ja'a. pe bèli mad'ae, heka ama si kako hari kèna. ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, makasi. te ngaa repo ia ka. hud'i laa ji'i j'unu ètu d'ara lapa.

source_text: and he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his bais; and he made them a mishteh meal, feast, and did bake matzot, and they did eat.
target_text: te ngaa lot pamako si loe boe, ka lasi manubha asa èmu na. ka lot si tunu roti, lalau mei, ka ra'a-rinu pa'èci.

source_text: but before they lay down, the men of the ir, even the anshei sodom, surrounded the bais, from na'ar to zeken, all the people from every quarter of the city;
target_text: dhu dua ra lasi mèka j'unu, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone sodom aa'i-aa'i, ana mone ngèru toke d'ai mone heka, mai reo rare èmu lot.

source_text: and they called unto lot, and said unto him, where are the anashim which came in to thee halailah this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them carnally.
target_text: dhèu se'e pa'oo-parodha, peka mi lot, aku rèngu na, he, lot! mone dua deo sa, ètu mia? bhabhodho si mai, sèna ka ji'i j'unu dènge ra!

source_text: and lot went outside unto them, and shut the delet after him,
target_text: hèia lot li'u la'e, ka na bèdho hari èmu.

source_text: and said, now, achai my brethren, do not so wickedly.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! baku miu tao bhelu mi tamu ja'a se.

source_text: hinei now, i have two banot which have not known man; now let me bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes; only unto these anashim do nothing; for therefore came they under the tzel shadow of my korah beam, roof.
target_text: mi nanene ku ja'a laa! ana bhèni ja'a, dhèu dua. dua ra dhu pa'èci mèka dènge dhèu mone. ja'a hia miu. mere, ho mi tao tasamia èèna ka, sad'i madhutu dad'èi miu. sad'i miu baku tao karehe mi tamu ja'a dhèu dua se. lula madhutu ad'a èdhi, ja'a ka dhu hud'i j'aga si.

source_text: and they said, stand back. and they said again, this one fellow came in to sojourn as a ger alien, and he will now play the shofet; now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. and they pressed strongly upon the man, even lot, and came near to break down the delet.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu sodom se pa'oo ma'ète boe, aku rèngu na, èu ne, baku patabha! te èu ne, dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai ji'i ne! de èu dènge boe hak ho kai ji'i. hua iia, èu pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e. te, ladhe lamu boe, ji'i tao èu bia risi nèti dhèu dua se'e! ka ra tule eele lot, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra rai lasi j'èje babèdho èmu.

source_text: but the anashim put forth their yad, and pulled lot into the bais to them, and shut the delet.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dua se soro kacui-aai ra, ère pamaso lot, ka ra patèke èmu nèti d'ara.

source_text: and they struck the men that were at the petach of the bais with blindness, both katan and gadol; so that they wearied themselves to find the petach.
target_text: dua ra tao pabèdhu ana madha dhèu sodom aa'i-aa'i ra, ka rèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ra gogo tenge babèdho, te ngaa abhu boe.

source_text: and the anashim said unto lot, hast thou here any one else? choson son-in-law, and thy banim, and thy banot, and whatsoever thou hast in the ir, bring them out of this makom place; for we are the mashchitim ones destroying this makom place, because the cry of them is so gedolah before the face of hashem; and hashem hath sent us to destroy it.
target_text: hèia tamu dhèu dua se, peka dènge lot, aku rèngu na, lamatua ne'a le, bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu sodom se. nèti èèna ka, na paleha ji'i dua mi mai, sèna ka palaho eele kota ne. de èu dhu dènge a'ari leo dhu ètu d'ara kota ne, do aad'o? ladhe dènge ana mone, do ana bhèni, do dhèu èmu ana èu, do, sad'i cee èèna ka, lamu more si, ho rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne lai-lai!

source_text: and lot went out, and spoke unto his chosonim, which were pledged to marry his banot, and said, up, get you out of makom hazeh; for hashem is mashchit destroying the ir city. but he seemed as one that metzachek joked unto his chosonim.
target_text: hèia lot la'e paraga dènge ana mone dhèu dua, dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni na. ka na peka, dua mi nanene paie! rai ka nèti d'ara kota ne, te lamatua neo palaho eele ne! te ngaa ra pangee na, lot padhai lii paleko di.

source_text: and when the shachar came, then the malachim urged lot, saying, arise, take thy isha, and thy two banot, which are here or thou be swept away in the avon hair.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae era, ana pajuu lamatua dhèu dua se, pakaseti lot si, ho lasi karohe asa era kaj'èu. ra peka na, lami ka! ère mèti dhèu èmu mu, dènge ana bhèni èu dhèu dua sèra, ho rai ka. tèke eele kota ne'e! mage dhoka miu madhe aa'i palere-lere dènge kota ne.

source_text: and while he lingered hesitating, the anashim laid hold upon his yad, and upon the yad of his isha, and upon the yad of his two banot; hashem being merciful unto him; and they brought him out and set him outside the ir.
target_text: te ngaa lot neka-neka era, masi ka lamatua neo hia ne mamuri. nèti èèna ka, tamu dhèu dua se nuni lot, dhèu èmu na, dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua sèra, rèti asa li'u kota.

source_text: and it came to pass, when they had brought them forth outside, that he said, flee and escape for thy nefesh; look not back behind thee, neither stop thou anywhere in all the plain; flee and escape to the mountain, lest thou be swept away.
target_text: hèia ca dhèu nèti tamu dhèu dua sèra paredha si, peka na, rai palasa, sèna ka abhu sod'a! mage mi kabib'a kabodho! baku ae ètu d'ara mamoo! rai taruu, asa ledhe nèi, sèna ka miu baku madhe!

source_text: and lot said unto them, oh, not so, adonoi my l-rd:
target_text: te ngaa lot peka, aku nèngu na, iraa ee! baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: hinei now, thy eved hath found chen in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy chesed, which thou hast showed unto me in sparing my nefesh; and i cannot flee to escape to the mountain, lest some ra'ah overtake me, and i die;
target_text: mema ama si pamamuri le ji'i se. te ngaa ledhe nèi kaj'èu bia nèti ne'e! mage dhoka ji'i d'ai mèka nèi, j'aj'èra dhu magee nare le ji'i èèna, ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: hinei now, this ir is near to run unto, and it is a little one; oh, let me flee to escape there, is it not mitzar small? , and my nefesh shall live.
target_text: ama ladhe ku laa. rae iiki cue dhu kaj'èu boe nèti era ne'e. rae nèi dhu kolongara aad'o. ladhe ama d'èi, ji'i la'a pasoru iisi asa nèi!

source_text: and he said unto him, hinei, i have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that i will not overthrow the ir, for the which thou hast spoken.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! lami ka! te èèna na, ja'a palaho boe rae nèi.

source_text: haste thee, flee to escape there; for i cannot do anything till thou arrive there. therefore the shem of the ir was called tzoar.
target_text: de rai karohe ka, lami asa nèi! te ja'a tao mèka ngaa-ngaa, ladhe miu d'ai mèka era nèi. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu pangare rae ne soar, dhu sasoa na ‘ana iiki-iiki'.

source_text: the shemesh rose over ha'aretz when lot entered tzoar.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea, lot si d'ai soar.

source_text: then hashem rained upon sodom and upon amora gofrit and eish from hashem out of shomayim;
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: and he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and tzemach what grew upon haadamah.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: but his isha, from behind him, looked back, and she became a netziv melach pillar of salt.
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: and avraham got up early in the boker to the makom where he stood there before hashem;
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: and he looked down toward sodom and amora, and toward all the eretz of the plain, and hinei, he saw kitor smoke, steam of the eretz go up like kitor of a furnace.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and it came to pass, when elohim destroyed the cities of the plain, that zikron avraham came to elohim, and he sent lot out of the midst of the hafekhah upheaval, destruction, overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which lot dwelt.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: and lot left tzoar, and dwelt in the har, and his two banot with him; for he feared to dwell in tzoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two banot.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: and the bechirah said unto the younger, avinu is old, and there is not an ish in ha'aretz to come in unto us after the derech of kol ha'aretz:
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come, let us make avinu drink yayin, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve zera by avinu.
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: and they made their av drink yayin balailah: and the bechirah went in, and lay with her av; and he had da'as not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: and it came to pass on the next day, that the bechirah said unto the younger, hinei, i lay yesternight with avi. let us make him drink yayin halailah also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve zera by avinu.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: and they made their av drink yayin balailah also; and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he had da'as not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: thus were both the banot of lot with child by their av.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: and the bechirah bore ben, and called shmo moav; the same is the avi moav unto this day.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: and the younger, she also bore ben, and called shmo ben-ammi; the same is the avi bnei ammon unto this day.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: and avraham journeyed from there toward the negev region, and dwelled between kadesh and shur, and sojourned in gerar.
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: and avraham said of sarah his isha, she is my achot; and avimelech melech gerar sent, and took sarah.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: but elohim came to avimelech in a chalom halailah, and said to him, see, thou art met dead, for the isha which thou hast taken; for she is be'ulat ba'al married of a husband.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: but avimelech had not come near her; and he said, adonoi, wilt thou slay also a goy tzaddik? said he not unto me, she is my achot? and she, even she herself said, he is achi: in the tohm integrity, guilelessness of my lev and with clean hands of my innocency have i done this.
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: and haelohim said unto him in a chalom, yea, i have da'as that thou didst this in the tohm integrity, guilelessness of thy lev; for i also withheld thee from sinning against me; therefore allowed i thee not to touch her.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: now therefore restore the ish his isha; for he is a navi, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live; and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: therefore avimelech rose early in the boker, and called all his avadim, and told all these things in their ears; and the anashim were very afraid.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: then avimelech called avraham, and said unto him, what hast thou done unto us? and how have i offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my mamlechah kingdom a chata'ah gedolah great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and avimelech said unto avraham, what sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and avraham said, because i thought, surely the yirat elohim is not in this place; and they will slay me on account of my isha.
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and yet indeed she is my achot; she is the bat avi, but not the bat immi; and she became my isha.
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: and it came to pass, when elohim caused me to wander from my bais avi, that i said unto her, this is thy chesed which thou shalt show unto me; at every place where we shall come, say of me, he is achi.
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: and avimelech took tzon, and oxen, and avadim, and shfachot, and gave them unto avraham, and restored to him sarah his isha. and avimelech said, hinei, my land is before thee; dwell where it pleaseth thee. and unto sarah he said, hinei, i have given thy brother a thousand pieces of kesef; hinei, it is to thee a kesut einayim covering of the eyes, exoneration, unto all that are with thee, and with all other; thus she was vindicated.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: so avraham davened unto elohim: and elohim healed avimelech, and his isha, and his maidservants so that they bore children. for hashem had fast closed up kol rechem every womb of the bais avimelech, on account of sarah avrahamʼs isha.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: and hashem visited sarah as he had said, and hashem did unto sarah just as he had spoken. for sarah conceived, and bore avraham ben in his old age, at the mo'ed set time of which elohim had given promise unto him. and avraham called the shem of bno that was born unto him, whom sarah bore to him, yitzchak. and avraham circumcised bno yitzchak at age shemonat yamim, as elohim had commanded him. and avraham was a hundred years old, when bno yitzchak was born unto him. and she said, elohim hath brought me tzechok laughter, so that all that hear yitzchak will laugh with me. and she said, who would have said unto avraham, that sarah should nurse banim? for i have borne him ben in his old age.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and the yeled grew, and was weaned; and avraham made a mishteh gadol the same day that yitzchak was weaned.
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: and sarah saw the ben of hagar the egyptian, which she had borne unto avraham, metzachek mocking, scoffing. therefore she said unto avraham, cast out this bondwoman and her ben: for the ben of this bondwoman shall not be heir with beni my son, even with yitzchak.
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the thing was very grievous in the eyes of avraham because of bno.
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: and elohim said unto avraham, let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the na'ar, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that sarah hath said unto thee, shema pay heed unto her voice; for in yitzchak shall thy zera be called.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: and also of the ben haamah will i make a nation, because he is thy zera.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: and avraham rose up early in the boker, and took lechem, and a skin of mayim, and gave it unto hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the yeled, and sent her away; and she departed, and wandered in the midbar of be'er-sheva.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: and the mayim in the skin was done, and she cast the yeled under one of the bushes.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: and she went off, and sat down about a bowshot away: for she thought, let me not see the mot hayeled. and she sat there nearby, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: and elohim heard the voice of the na'ar; and the malach elohim called to hagar out of shomayim, and said unto her, mah lach, hagar? fear not; for elohim hath heard the voice of the na'ar where he is.
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: arise, lift up the na'ar, and hold him in thine yad; for i will make him a goy gadol.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: and elohim opened her eyes, and she saw a be'er of mayim; and she went, and filled the skin with mayim, and gave the na'ar drink.
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: and elohim was with the na'ar; and he grew, and dwelt in the midbar, and became a roveh keshet an archer. and he dwelt in the midbar of paran: and his em got him an isha out of eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: and it came to pass at that time, that avimelech and phichol the sar tz'va of his spoke unto avraham, saying, elohim is with thee in all that thou doest:
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: now therefore swear unto me here before elohim that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my child, nor with my descendant: but according to the chesed that i have showed thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the eretz wherein thou hast sojourned.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: and avraham said, i will swear.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: and avraham reproved avimelech because of a be'er hamayim, which avimelechʼs avadim had violently seized.
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: and avimelech said, i know not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard i of it, but today.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: and avraham took tzon and oxen, and gave them unto avimelech; and both of them made a brit. and avraham set apart seven ewe lambs of the tzon by themselves.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: and avimelech said unto avraham, what mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set apart by themselves?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said, for these sheva ewe lambs shalt thou accept of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that i have dug this well.
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: therefore he called that place be'er-sheva; because there they swore an oath both of them.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: thus they made a brit at be'er-sheva: then avimelech rose up, and phichol the sar tzeva of his, and they returned into eretz pelishtim.
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: and avraham planted an eshel tamarisk tree in be'er-sheva, and called there on the shem of hashem el olam.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and avraham sojourned in eretz pelishtim yamim rabbim.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that g-d did test avraham, and said unto him, avraham: and he said, hineini behold, here i am.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: and he said, take now thy son, thine ben yachid only son yitzchak, whom thou lovest, and get thee into eretz moriyah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which i will tell thee of.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: and avraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his servants with him, and yitzchak his son, and cut the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which g-d had told him.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: then on yom hashlishi avraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and avraham said unto his servants, abide ye here with the donkey; and i and the young man will go over there and nishtachaveh we will worship and we will come back again to you.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and avraham took atzei haolah the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon yitzchak his son; and he took the eish fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
target_text: ka abraham nare kadhèna dhu neo tunu korban, ka na tao mi kabela-kao isak. aa nèngu nèd'u tud'i, dènge suu ai. ropa dua ra palere lasi,

source_text: and yitzchak spoke unto avraham his father, and said, avi my father: and he said, hineini, beni here am i, my son. and he said, hinei, the eish fire and the wood: but where is the seh lamb for a burnt offering?
target_text: hèia isak paroa ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, ana? hèia isak karèi, aku nèngu na, èdhi neo lati tunu korban. de ai dènge kadhèna ka se'e le. te ngaa ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èdhi pake j'aj'i korban, ka mia?

source_text: and avraham said, my son, g-d will provide himself a seh lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
target_text: te ngaa, aku abraham na, pe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu hia ana kalèbho, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban. ka dua ra ca'e lasi taruu.

source_text: and they came to the place which g-d had told him of; and avraham built a mizbe'ach there, and laid the wood in order, and made the akedah binding of yitzchak his son, and laid him on the mizbe'ach upon the wood.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai era dhu lamatua peka èèna, ka abraham pudhi hadhu ho tao mei korban. hèia na paloko kadhèna ètu dedha mei korban ne. ka kèpe ana na isak, èki patarenga ne ètu dedha kadhèna.

source_text: and avraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
target_text: ka nare tud'i, ho neo kèj'i pamadhe ana na.

source_text: and the malach hashem called unto him out of shomayim, and said, avraham, avraham: and he said, hineini.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua lii nèti dedha-liru, peka na, abraham! mata ku! ka abraham dhaa, aku nèngu na, nga tao, lamatua?

source_text: and he said, lay not thine hand upon the young man, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now i know that thou fearest g-d, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine ben yachid from me.
target_text: ka na peka hari, na, baku pamadhe ana èèna! baku tao ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu. ja'a ke'a le, èu ne tare'a-re'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula èu dènge d'ara kateme hia ana èu ca dhèu mesa èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban hia ne.

source_text: and avraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and hinei behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and avraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering takhat instead of his son.
target_text: hèia abraham ladhe nèdhi kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u, dhu tadhu na pakai nare dadana aaj'u dhu karoki. ka na la'e kèpe nare, ho tunu j'aj'i mi korban hia ama lamatua, gati ana na.

source_text: and avraham called the name of that place hashem yireh: as it is said to this day, in the mount of hashem it shall be provided.
target_text: ka abraham pangare era èèna, na, ‘lamatua sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu. ' nèti èèna ka, d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu peka na, ètu ledhe lamatua èèna, na sadia tèke ngaa dhu parluu.

source_text: and the malach hashem called unto avraham out of shomayim the second time,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua lii hari nèti dedha-liru, peka na,

source_text: and said, by myself have i sworn, saith hashem, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine ben yachid:
target_text: lamatua unu na, peka, ‘ja'a subha dènge kolongara ja'a mesa ku, sèmi ne'e: èu sadia le hia ja'a ana mu ca dhèu mone mesa na ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: that in blessing i will bless thee, and in multiplying i will multiply thy zera as the stars of the skies, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy zera shall possess the gate of his enemies;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pala-bagi èu dènge ana-èpu èu mèngi-nale ae-ae. èèna na, ra bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu ige rare boe, sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa salae ètu sebhe dhasi. ana-èpu èu sèra, èèna na, segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra.

source_text: and in thy zera shall kol goyei ha'aretz be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
target_text: nèti ana-èpu èu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale lula èu madhutu le lii paredha ja'a. '

source_text: so avraham returned unto his servants, and they rose up and went together to be'er-sheva; and avraham dwelt at be'er-sheva.
target_text: èle hèia, abraham dènge isak, lèpa hari asa era dhu dhèu sab'a na sèra. ka lasi palere asa beer-syeba. d'ai nèi, abraham si pea dènge ka.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that it was told avraham, saying, hinei, milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother nachor;
target_text: ca lod'o, abraham tadèngi na, dhèu èmu ari na nahor, dhu ngara na milka, nara iisi ana na.

source_text: utz his bechor firstborn, and buz his brother, and kemuel the father of aram,
target_text: ana uru, ngara na us. ari na, bus. èle ka, nara iisi hari kemuel dhu j'aj'i ama aram.

source_text: and kesed, and chazo, and pildash, and yidlaph, and betuel.
target_text: ka na abhu hari kesed, haso, pildas, yidlaf, dènge betuel.

source_text: and betuel fathered rivkah: these eight milcah did bear to nachor, avrahamʼs brother.
target_text: betuel èèna, ama nèti ribka.

source_text: and his pilegesh, whose name was reumah, she bare also tevach, and gacham, and tachash, and maachah.
target_text: nahor abhu ana kahèi nèti bhèni piara na, ngara na reuma. ana reuma, nuka: teba, gaham, tahas, dènge maaka.

source_text: and sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty shanah old: these were the shnei chayyai sarah. and sarah died in kiryat-arba; the same is chevron in eretz kena'an: and avraham came to mourn for sarah, and to weep for her.
target_text: lod'o sara madhe, umur na ca ngasu dua nguru pidhu tèu le. lod'o na madhe èèna, abraham si pea ètu rae kiryat-arba nuka hebron, ètu rai kana'an. ka abraham beke aa tangi dhèu èmu na dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and avraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke unto the bnei chet, saying,
target_text: hèia abraham kèd'i la'e paraga dènge dhèu-dhèu het. ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i am a ger and a sojourner with you: give me an achuzzah possession of a kever with you, that i may bury my dead out of my sight.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu tao mai ètu talora miu se. ja'a dhu dènge boe rai ca kasib'i sa, sèna ka padhane dhèu èmu ja'a. de ladhe miu sue ja'a, ja'a hèli kore rai miu d'ai ca kasib'i sa, ho tao era padhane ne.

source_text: and the bnei chet answered avraham, saying unto him,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na,

source_text: hear us, adoni: thou art a nasi elohim among us; in the choice of kevareinu bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his kever, that thou mayest bury thy dead.
target_text: sèmi ne'e, ama! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ji'i se tadhe le ama, dhu sama sèmi ca dhèu, dhèu heka dhu ji'i pakab'ua. de sad'i ama d'èi rai mia dhu be'a, dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi ama. ji'i se dhoka ngo'o di; dhèu èci sa dhu magee boe.

source_text: and avraham stood up, and bowed himself to the am ha'aretz, even to the bnei chet.
target_text: hèia abraham pacud'u iisi ho hia hormat mi lamatua rai, dhèu het sèra.

source_text: and he spoke to them, saying, if it be your nefesh will that i should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intercede for me to ephron ben tzochar,
target_text: ka na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe miu sèmi lii ja'a na, ja'a manèngi ho peka dènge ana mone sohar, dhu ngara na efron.

source_text: that he may give me the cave of machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his sadeh; for the kesef maleh full price he shall give it me for an achuzzah possession of a kever amongst you.
target_text: peka dènge ne, ladhe na d'èi, na pahia dènge ja'a loe na, makpela, dhu ètu karasa oka na. na manèngi ca ngaa èèna ka, ja'a tihe. ja'a neo tihe pama'ète kab'ua na, ètu madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka rai èèna j'aj'i unu ja'a. ja'a neo tao era èèna, j'aj'i mi ro'a dhèu madhe ji'i.

source_text: and ephron dwelt among the bnei chet: and ephron the chitti answered avraham in the hearing of the bnei chet, even of all that went in at the sha'ar of his city, saying,
target_text: lod'o èèna, efron madhèdi ètu era èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu-dhèu het sèra. ka na tadèngi kahèi lii padhai lii abraham deo na. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na b'ala abraham ètu madha dhèu heka aa'i-aa'i ra ètu sèra, aku nèngu na,

source_text: lo, adoni, hear me; the sadeh give i thee, and the cave that is therein, i give it thee; in the presence of the bnei ammi give i it thee; bury thy dead.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna, ama! sèmi ne'e ka laa! oka dènge loe makpela èèna, ja'a hia iia ama. sèna ka mu padhane dhèu èmu èu mi èèna. ja'a pangèd'u rai èèna mi ama, ètu madha dhèu-dhèu ja'a se. sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i sakasii!

source_text: and avraham bowed down himself before the am ha'aretz.
target_text: ka abraham pacud'u kètu hari mi dhèu het se.

source_text: and he spoke unto ephron in the hearing of the am ha'aretz, saying, but if thou wilt give it, now, hear me; i will give thee kesef for the sadeh; accept it from me, and i will bury my dead there.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge efron, aku nèngu na, sèmi èèna oo, be'a kahèi. te ngaa miu nanene lii ja'a, la ma. ja'a neo hèli pama'ète rai na, sèna ka j'aj'i era padhane dhèu-dhèu ja'a.

source_text: and ephron answered avraham, saying unto him, pay heed, adoni, unto me; the land is worth four hundred shekels of kesef; what is that between me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
target_text: hèia, aku efron na, rai èèna, kab'ua na, dhoka èpa ngasu doi pudhi di. guna ngaa èdhi dua ti padhue kab'ua rai ciki oo'e èèna, dhu sasoa na aad'o. de lamu ka, ho mèti dhèu madhe na, sèna ka padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and avraham paid heed unto ephron; and avraham weighed to ephron the kesef, which he had named in the hearing of the bnei chet four hundred shekels of kesef, according to current merchant value.
target_text: ka abraham d'èi kahèi dènge kab'ua na sange èèna, madhutu sèmi lii efron. hèia ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, na ige nare doi pudhi èpa ngasu, tihe kab'ua rai èèna mi efron.

source_text: and the sadeh of ephron which was in machpelah, which was near mamre, the sadeh, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the sadeh, that were in all the borders round about, were deeded unto avraham for a property in the presence of the bnei chet, before all that went in at the sha'ar of his city. and after this, avraham buried sarah his isha in the cave of the sadeh of machpelah near mamre; the same is chevron in the eretz kena'an.
target_text: de dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, abraham abhu dènge rai ne nèti efron, j'aj'i mi unu na. rai na nuka ètu makpela, padètu dènge mamre nuka hebron. na hèli pama'ète rai ne dènge oka na, dènge loe na, aa dènge aj'u aa'i-aa'i ra. dhèu-dhèu heka nèti suku het, aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, rai èèna dènge isi aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i le unu abraham. èle èèna ka, abraham la'e padhane sara ètu d'ara loe èèna, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and the sadeh, and the cave that is therein, were deeded unto avraham for an achuzzah of a kever by the bnei chet.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhu uru èèna oka dènge loe na unu dhèu het, limuri ne j'aj'i le rai unu abraham. ka na tao j'aj'i mi era udhu rui ra.

source_text: and avraham was zaken old, and well stricken in age; and hashem berach had blessed avraham in all things.
target_text: tèu-tèu mamuri abraham madhera titu kèna. lamatua ladhe-leru ne dènge be'a, aa hia ne mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: and avraham said unto his eved zekan of his bais, hamoshel that ruled over all that he had, put, now, thy yad under my thigh; and i will make thee swear by hashem elohei hashomayim and elohei ha'aretz, that thou shalt not take an isha unto beni of the banot hakena'ani, among whom i dwell:
target_text: abraham dhu dènge dhèu èci dhu na lèka ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na. ca lod'o, abraham paroa nare, ka peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mu pasa dhilu èu paie-iie! ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu subha madhe dènge kolongara lamatua. nèngu ka, ama lamatua dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. dhu peka na, èu bisa boe more ana bhèni nèti dhèu kana'an, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a isak.

source_text: but thou shalt go unto my eretz, and to my moledet, and take an isha unto beni yitzchak.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i lamu ku asa rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa a'ari ja'a. ho tenge ètu rèngu sèi, ana bhèni ca dhèu, ho mu paleo dènge ana ja'a ne.

source_text: and the eved said unto him, what if the isha will not be willing to follow me unto haaretz hazot: must i needs bring binecha back unto ha'aretz from where thou camest?
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne karèi abraham, aku nèngu na, be'a, ama! te ngaa, sèmi ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, na tasamia? ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i ja'a kèti ana ama ku, ho hia ne leo-èmu ètu nèi, do tasamia?

source_text: and avraham said unto him, beware thou that thou bring not beni to there!
target_text: hèia, aku abraham na, èu nanene paie! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, mage èu mèti ana ja'a ne, asa nèi kahèi!

source_text: hashem elohei hashomayim, which took me from bais avi, and from the eretz of my moledet, and which spoke unto me, and that swore unto me, saying, unto thy zera will i give haaretz hazot; he shall send his malach before thee, and thou shalt take an isha unto beni from there.
target_text: mu sanèd'e, te lamatua dhu nèd'u koasa ètu dedha-liru, ka dhu lere ja'a nèti rai èta-èsu ja'a, asa dedha-rai ne'e ne. aa dhu na pa'èki le lii pajaji dènge ja'a, dhu peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne aa'i-aa'i mi ana-èpu èu. ' de èu baku madha'u. sad'i lamu. te èèna na, lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu paraga dènge ana bhèni, dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: but if the isha will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be released from this my shevu'ah oath: only do not bring back beni there.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ana bhèni na d'èi boe mai asa ne'e, lii soo-subha ne lèke boe èu. masi ka tasamia na, èu bisa boe mèti ana ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: and the eved put his yad under yerech avraham adonav, and swore to him concerning this matter.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne, ded'e subha dènge abraham, ka na peka, èèna na, nèngu tao madhutu dad'èi abraham aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the eved took asarah gemalim of the gemalei adonav, and departed; for all the goods of adonav were in his yad: and he arose, and went to aram naharayim mesopotamia, unto the ir nachor.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna pili nare badha onta canguru ngi'u. hèia na hua rupa-rupa mèdha dhu kab'ua asa dedha onta se. hèia la'e ka asa kota nahor, ètu rai mesopotamia.

source_text: and he made his gemalim to kneel down outside the ir near a be'er hamayim at the time of erev, at the time that women go out to draw mayim.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka mone ne d'ai kota èèna. hèia na ae kabhèsu dènge onta sèra ètu sebhe kota èèna, dètu dènge madha èi èci. na ae èèna d'ara lod'o nihia le, ropa ana bhèni-ana bhèni kota èèna mai rara èi ètu madha èi èèna.

source_text: and he said hashem elohei adoni avraham, now, send me success this yom, and show chesed unto adoni avraham.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne sabaj'a, peka na, lamatua, èu ka dhu j'aj'i ama lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a, abraham. bhoke j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka kakako ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. pad'elo sasue èu mi lamatua ja'a, aa baku bhèlu lii pajaji ne dènge ja'a. de hia la ja'a paraga dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: hinei, i stand here by the ayin hamayim; and the banot anshei hair come out to draw mayim;
target_text: lamatua, ja'a ka titu ètu karasa madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti kota ne, mai rara èi ètu ne'e.

source_text: and let it come to pass, that the na'arah to whom i shall say, let down thy jug, now, that i may drink; and she shall say, drink, and i will give thy gemalim drink also; let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy eved yitzchak; and thereby shall i know that thou hast showed chesed unto adoni.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge ana bhèni èci, peka na, ‘ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu hia ja'a kinu. ' ho ladhe na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama, minu la! aa, pe ja'a hia dènge onta ama, rinu hèi! ' j'ara ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, ana bhèni ne ka dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u, j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu isak! dènge tadha sèmi ne'e, ja'a ke'a na lamatua pad'elo le babe'a mi abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, hinei, rivkah came out, who was born to betuel ben milcah, eshet nachor, achi avraham, with her jug upon her shoulder. and the na'arah was tovat mareh me'od, a betulah, neither had any ish known her: and she went down to haayenah the spring, and filled her jug, and came up.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a nare mèka, ana bhèni ca dhèu mai. ngara na ribka. nèngu ne, èpu nèti ari abraham, nuka nahor, dènge dhèu èmu na, milka. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ribka ne, bhèni iia nia boe, aa pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge mone. d'ai era èèna, puru asa d'ara èi la'e, ka na isi èru èi na. nèbhu boe, ka ca'e mai sa dedha.

source_text: and the eved hurried to meet her, and said, let me, now, drink a little mayim of thy jug.
target_text: ropa nare dedha, ka dhèu sab'a abraham èèna, la'e padètu dènge ne. hèia na manèngi, peka na, ana. hia ku ja'a kinu ciki.

source_text: and she said, drink, adoni: and she hasted, and let down her jug upon her yad, and gave him drink.
target_text: ka na dhaa, minu la, ama! hèia na papuru ka èru èi na, ka na hia dhèu ne ninu.

source_text: and when she had done giving him drink, she said, i will draw for thy gemalim also, until they have done drinking.
target_text: ropa ninu èle, ka ana bhèni ne peka na, pe ja'a laku dhui hari èi, sèna ka hia onta ama se, rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and she hasted, and emptied her jug into the trough, and ran back unto the be'er to draw, and drew for all his gemalim.
target_text: ka la'e bhori èi dhu risi, asa d'ara karab'a badha. hèia na ca'e-la'e mai pèri-pèri hari, dhui èi, ho hia onta se rinu toke bècu.

source_text: and the ish gazed at her and held his peace, so as to have da'as whether hashem had made his derech prosperous or not.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a abraham, titu ka mau-mau, na taru kira ka ana bhèni ne sab'a. ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ele boe nèngu èèna ka ne'e, dhu lamatua paj'uj'u.

source_text: and it came to pass, just as the gemalim had done drinking, that the ish took a nezem zahav gold ring by weight a beka, and two tzemidim bracelets by weight ten shekels of gold for her wrists;
target_text: onta se rinu toke bècu. hèia dhèu ne nare kadheli sahènga, dènge kanau ca pasa. mèdha se dhu tao nèti hualaa. ka na pasa mi sahènga dènge pasaluu mi ai kariu dènge g'ana ana bhèni ne.

source_text: and said, whose bat art thou? tell me, now: is there makom in the bais of thy av for us to spend the night?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ne karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ama mu, ngara na cee? ladhe mo'o, na ja'a manubha taha ètu èmu ama mu.

source_text: and she said unto him, i am bat betuel ben milcah, the ben which she bore unto nachor.
target_text: hèia na dhaa, ngara ama ku, na betuel. aa ngara baki ku, nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka.

source_text: she said moreover unto him, we have both teven straw and mispo fodder enough, and makom room to spend the night.
target_text: ètu èmu ji'i, era j'unu ae, de d'ai miu j'unu. aa j'u'u ae kahèi, ho hia badha miu se ra'a.

source_text: and the ish bowed his head, worshiped hashem.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne pahaha iisi ho mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he said, baruch hashem elohei adoni avraham, who hath not left destitute of his chesed and his emes; i being on the derech, hashem led me to the bais achei adoni.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, ka ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu kabarai ne'e. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi lamatua ja'a, abraham, aa tao madhutu sama sèmi lii pajaji na dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the na'arah ran, and told them of her bais em these things.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana bhèni ne rai la'e asa èmu, na lolo dènge isi èmu na ngaa dhu j'aj'i le èèna.

source_text: and rivkah had an ach, shmo lavan; lavan ran out unto the ish, unto the ayin. and it came to pass, when he saw the nezem and tzemidim upon the wrists of his achot, and when he heard the words of rivkah his achot, saying, thus spoke the ish unto me; that he came unto the ish; and, hinei, he stood by the gemalim at the ayin.
target_text: ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. ropa laban ladhe nèdhi mèdha hualaa se, aa na tadèngi lii lolo ana hèni na, ka rai asa li'u la'e. la'e soru dhèu sab'a abraham dhu titu era dènge onta ra ètu madha èi.

source_text: and he said, come in, gebentshter fun hashem; why standest thou outside? for i have prepared the bais, and makom for the gemalim.
target_text: hèia laban peka, aku nèngu na, ama! lamatua ka dhu lere miu mai dènge karej'e-karae d'ai ne'e. de baku titu mi li'u ne! mai lati sa èmu ji'i, te ji'i lalau ngare le kama. nganga'a hia badha se, dhu tesa.

source_text: and the ish came into the bais; and he unloaded his gemalim, and gave teven straw and mispo fodder for the camels, and mayim to wash his raglayim, and the raglei haanashim that were with him.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: and there was set ochel before him to eat; but he said, i will not eat, until i have stated my business. and he said, speak on.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: and he said, i am eved avraham.
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: and hashem hath blessed adoni me'od; and he is become prospered: and he hath given him tzon, and bakar, and kesef, and zahav, and avadim, and shefachot, and gemalim, and chamorim.
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: and sarah eshet adoni bore ben to adoni when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: and adoni made me swear, saying, thou shalt not take an isha for beni of the banot hakena'ani, in whose land i dwell;
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: but thou shalt go unto bais avi, to my mishpokhot, and take an isha unto beni.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: and i said unto adoni, what if the isha will not follow me.
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: and he said unto me, hashem, before whom i walk, will send his malach with thee, and prosper thy derech; and thou shalt take an isha for beni of my mishpokhot, and of my bais avi;
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: then shalt thou be released from this my oath, when thou comest to my mishpokhot; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be released from my oath.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: and i came this day unto the ayin, and said, hashem elohei adoni avraham, if now thou do prosper my derech which i go;
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: hinei, i stand by the ayin hamayim; and it shall come to pass, that when haalmah cometh forth to draw mayim, and i say to her, give me, now, a little mayim of thy jar to drink;
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: and she say to me, both drink thou, and i will also draw for thy gemalim; let the same be the isha whom hashem hath appointed for ben adoni.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: and before i had done davening in mine lev, hinei, rivkah came forth with her jar on her shoulder; and she went down unto ha'ayenah, and drew: and i said unto her, let me drink, now.
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: and she made haste, and let down her jar from her shoulder, and said, drink, and i will give thy gemalim drink also: so i drank, and she made the gemalim drink also.

source_text: and i asked her, and said, whose bat art thou? and she said, bat betuel ben nachor, the ben whom milcah bore unto him: and i put the nezem upon her face, and the tzemidim upon her wrists.
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: and i bowed down my head, and worshiped hashem, and i said a brocha to hashem elohei adoni avraham, which had led me on the derech emes to take bat achi adoni for bno.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: and now if ye will do chesed and emes to adoni, tell me; and if not, tell me; that i may turn to yamin, or to smol.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: then lavan and betuel answered and said, the thing proceedeth from hashem; we cannot speak unto thee rah or tov.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: hinei, rivkah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be isha for ben adoneicha, just as hashem hath spoken.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, that, when eved avraham heard their words, he worshiped hashem, bowing himself to the ground.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the eved brought forth kelei kesef, and kelei zahav, and begadim, and gave them to rivkah; he gave also to her ach and to her em migdanot costly gifts.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and they did eat and drink, he and the anashim that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the boker, and he said, send me away unto adoni.
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: and her ach and her em said, let the na'arah abide with us ten days or so; after that she shall go.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: and he said unto them, hinder me not, seeing hashem hath prospered my derech; send me away that i may go to adoni.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: and they said, we will call the na'arah, and inquire at her mouth.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: and they called rivkah, and said unto her, wilt thou go with this ish? and she said, i will go.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: and they sent away rivkah their achot, and her nurse, and eved avraham, and his anashim. and they said a brocha over rivkah, and said unto her, thou art achoteinu, may thou be increased to thousands upon thousands and may thy zera possess the sha'ar of those which hate them.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: and rivkah arose, and her na'arot, and they rode upon the gemalim, and followed the ish: and the eved took rivkah, and went his way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: and yitzchak had come from be'er lachai roi; for he dwelt in the eretz hanegev.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: and yitzchak went out to meditate in the sadeh at erev: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, hinei, the gemalim camels were coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: and rivkah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw yitzchak, she got down from the gamal.
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: for she had said unto the eved, who is that ish that walketh in the sadeh to meet us? and the eved had said, he is adoni: therefore she took a veil, and covered herself.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: and the eved told yitzchak all things that he had done.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: and yitzchak brought her into the ohel of sarah immo, and took rivkah, and she became his isha; and he loved her: and yitzchak was comforted after the mot immo.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: then again avraham took an isha, and her shem was keturah.
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: and she bore him zimran, and yokshan, and medan, and midyan, and yishbak, and shuach.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: and yokshan fathered sheva, and dedan. and the bnei dedan were ashurim, and letushim, and leummim.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: and the bnei midyan; ephah, and epher, and chanokh, and avida, and eldaah. all these were the bnei keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: and avraham gave all that he had unto yitzchak. but unto the bnei hapilageshim sons of the concubines, which avraham had, avraham gave mattanot, and sent them away from yitzchak bno, while he yet lived, eastward, unto eretz kedem.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: and these are the days of the years of avrahamʼs life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen shanim. then avraham breathed his last, and died in a good old age, a zaken, full of years; and was gathered to his people.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: and his banim yitzchak and yishmael buried him in the cave of machpelah, in the sadeh of ephron ben tzochar the chitti, which is near mamre; the sadeh which avraham purchased of the bnei chet, there was avraham buried, and sarah his wife.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass after the mot avraham, that elohim blessed yitzchak bno; and yitzchak dwelt near be'er lachai roi.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: now these are the toldot yishmael ben avraham, whom hagar the egyptian, shifchat sarah, bore unto avraham:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: and these are the shemot bnei yishmael, by their shemot, according to their toldot: the bechor of yishmael, nevayot; and kedar, and adbe'el, and mivsam, and mishma, and dumah, and massa, chadad, and tema, yetur, naphish, and kedmah: these are the bnei yishmael, and these are their shemot, by their settlement, and by their camps; twelve nasiim princes, rulers according to their tribes.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: and these are the years of the life of yishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven shanah; and he breathed his last and died; and was gathered unto his people.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: and they dwelt from chavilah unto shur, that is near mitzrayim, as thou goest toward assyria; they took their place east of their brethren.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: and these are the toldot of yitzchak ben avraham: avraham fathered yitzchak;
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: and yitzchak was arba'im shanah when he took rivkah as his wife, the bat betuel haarami of paddan-aram, the achot lavan haarami.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: and yitzchak davened to hashem on behalf of his isha, because she was barren; and hashem was entreated of him, and rivkah his isha conceived.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: and the banim struggled jostling within her; and she said, if it be well, why am i thus? and she went to inquire of hashem.
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: and hashem said unto her, two goyim nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be separated from within thee; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the older shall serve the younger.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: and when her days were fulfilled to be delivered, hinei, there were twins in her womb.
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and the first came out admoni red all over like a hairy garment; and they called shmo esav.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: and after that came out his brother, and his yad was grasping on akev esav; and shmo was called ya'akov; and yitzchak was threescore shanah when she bore them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: and the nearim grew: and esav was a skilled hunter, an ish sadeh; and ya'akov was an ish tam quiet man, dwelling in ohalim.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: and yitzchak loved esav, because he did eat of his wild game; but rivkah loved ya'akov.
target_text: isak d'èi na'a sisi badha hui. nèti èèna ka, na sue risi esau. te ngaa ribka sue risi yakob.

source_text: and ya'akov cooked stew: and esav came from the sadeh, and he was famished.
target_text: ca lod'o, yakob dhu tao bubur kab'ui, aa esau heka lèpa nèti kasiro badha hui kèna. na lèpa dènge manganga, ka roe titu kèna.

source_text: and esav said to ya'akov, let me eat now some of the adom red stew; for i am famished; therefore was shmo called edom.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ari, ee! hia ku ja'a bubur kab'ui mea ciki ètu d'ara èru èèna, ho ja'a ku'a! te ja'a manganga bia. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare na, edom, dhu sasoa na ‘mea'.

source_text: and ya'akov said, first sell me today thy bechorah birthright, right of the firstborn.
target_text: ka, aku yakob na, be'a a'a. te ngaa pasilu ku dènge hak a'a èèna!

source_text: and esav said, hinei, i am at the point of death; and what profit shall this bechorah do to me?
target_text: hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, hak a'a ne, ngaa kèna, hud'i nèngu sèna! neo more, na more la. te ja'a manganga bia. sod'e mèti bubur èèna lai-lai mai, te ja'a taha heka.

source_text: and ya'akov said, swear to me this day; and he swore unto him; and he sold his bechorah unto ya'akov.
target_text: te ngaa, aku yakob hari na, mata ku a'a! èu subha uuru ku, dhu peka na, èu pangèd'u le hak a'a èèna mi ja'a ne. ka esau ded'e subha sèmi dhu yakob peka.

source_text: then ya'akov gave esav lechem and adashim lentils stew; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way; thus esav despised his bechorah.
target_text: hèia yakob sod'e dènge ka hia ne bubur kab'ui deo na dènge roti. ropa na'a-ninu nare, ka la'e dènge ka. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, esau pusi boe dènge hak a'a na.

source_text: and there was a ra'av famine in ha'aretz, besides the ra'av harishon that was in the days of avraham. and yitzchak went unto avimelech melech pelishtim philistines unto gerar.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara rai èèna, lèke tèu manganga, èci èèna ka dènge tèu abraham mamuri era. ka isak la'e manèngi abimelek, dhèu aae pilistin, sèna ka na pea ètu gerar.

source_text: and hashem appeared unto him, and said, go not down into mitzrayim; dwell in ha'aretz which i shall tell thee of;
target_text: na tao sèmi èèna, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le iisi na mi nèngu, peka na, mage lamu ka asa masir hèi. pea la mi era dhu èèna na ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu.

source_text: sojourn in ha'aretz hazot, and i will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy zera, i will give all these lands, and i will perform the shevu'ah oath which i swore unto avraham avichah; and i will make thy zera to multiply as the kokhavim of shomayim, and will give unto thy zera all these lands; and in thy zera shall kol goyei ha'aretz be blessed;
target_text: ladhe èu manubha ètu era èèna, ja'a sama-sama dènge èu, aa pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. èèna na, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru. aa ja'a hia kateme rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu mèngi-nale. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a tao madhutu lii pajaji dhu ja'a pa'èki le dènge ama mu abraham.

source_text: because avraham obeyed my voice, and was shomer over my mishmeret charge, my mitzvot, my chukkot, and my torot.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi ne'e ne, lula ama mu madhutu dad'èi ja'a, paredha ja'a, dènge atora ja'a.

source_text: and yitzchak dwelt in gerar;
target_text: ka isak pea taha ètu gerar.

source_text: and the anshei hamakom asked him about his isha; and he said, she is my achot; for he feared to say, she is my isha; lest, said he, the anshei hamakom should kill me for rivkah; because she was beautiful to look upon.
target_text: ribka ne, bhèni iia titu kèna. ka ropa dhèu ètu gerar ladhe rèdhi ne, ra pakarèi. te ngaa isak peka na, ribka ne, ana hèni ja'a. na madha'u, ladhe na peka na dhèu èmu nèngu, dhèu se pamadhe ne, aa ribka parame rare.

source_text: and it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that avimelech melech pelishtim philistines looked out at a chalon, and saw, and, hinei, yitzchak metzachek was caressing rivkah his isha.
target_text: isak dhu pea nèbhu le ètu nèi, hèia ca lod'o, dhèu aae nèdhi nèti ro'a jendela na, ladhe laa na isak dènge ribka dhu pa'ango.

source_text: and avimelech called yitzchak, and said, hinei, of a surety she is thy isha; and why saidst thou, she is my achot? and yitzchak said unto him, because i said, lest i die because of her.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu lasi paroa isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a dhu ke'a le, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu! te ngaa tasamia ka, èu peka na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu? hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ama! ja'a ne madha'u, ladhe ja'a peka na nèngu ne dhèu èmu ja'a, mage dhoka dhèu pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and avimelech said, what is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have slept with thy isha, and thou shouldest have brought asham guilt upon us.
target_text: ka dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, sèmi dhèu ètu se'e j'unu dènge dhèu èmu èu, tatu èu pasala ji'i! tasamia ka, èu ad'u j'ara ne'e mi dedha ji'i se?

source_text: and avimelech charged all his people, saying, he that toucheth this man or his isha shall surely be put to death.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pasanèd'e ana kabarai na, aku nèngu na, miu nanene paie-iie! cee ka dhu bani gagu dhèu ne'e, do dhèu èmu na, èèna na ja'a huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: then yitzchak sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year a hundredfold; and hashem blessed him.
target_text: tèu èèna, isak sèle hini ètu dedha rai dhèu se'e. lod'o d'ai puu-g'ètu, ka na abhu isi rai cangasu hari, lula lamatua hia ne mamèngi.

source_text: and the man became very prosperous, and went forward, and grew until he became gadol me'od:
target_text: lula mèdha-panyau na asa ae, ka na kaja titu kèna.

source_text: for he had possession of tzon, and possession of cattle, and many avadim; and the pelishtim envied him.
target_text: badha-manu na sèmi sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho asa tabha ae. dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pilistin tèka d'ara dènge ne.

source_text: for all the wells which avdei aviv had dug in the days of avraham aviv, the pelishtim had stopped them up, and filled them with dirt.
target_text: uru èèna, abraham, ama isak, dhu kèi èi ae-ae. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si dènge rai.

source_text: and avimelech said unto yitzchak, go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
target_text: ka dhèu aae abimelek peka dènge isak, aku nèngu na, isak! be'a risi èu pakèd'i ka nèti kabarai ne'e. lula koasa èu, risi eele le nèti ji'i se.

source_text: and yitzchak departed from there, and encamped in the valley of gerar, and dwelt there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak pakèd'i nèti era èèna, ka lasi pea hari ètu d'ara mamoo gerar.

source_text: and yitzchak dug again the be'erot hamayim wells of water, which they had dug in the days of avraham aviv; for the pelishtim had stopped them up after the mot avraham; and he called their shemot after the shemot by which his av had called them.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra kèi hari madha èi dhu uru èèna, dhèu pilistin dhènu eele aa'i si. ka na pangare madha èi se madhutu ngara dhu ama na pangare.

source_text: and avdei yitzchak dug in the valley, and found there a well of mayim chayyim.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a isak se kèi èi ètu d'ara mamoo gerar, hèi lèke èi madha dhu sabhoka mai.

source_text: and the herdmen of gerar did quarrel with yitzchakʼs herdmen, saying, the mayim is ours; and he called the shem of the well esek contention; because they disputed with him.
target_text: lula madha èi ne'e ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenge badha nèti gerar, patao dènge dhèu madhenge badha isak. dhèu se peka na, ne'e ne, madha èi ji'i! nèti èèna ka, isak pangare madha èi na esek, dhu sasoa na ‘patao-palaha'.
