source_text: and they dug another be'er, and feuded over that also; and he called the shem of it sitnah enmity.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu isak se, kèi hari èi leo ca madha. te ngaa ra patao-palaha hari, lula èi èèna. nèti èèna ka, isak pangare na sitna, dhu sasoa na ‘palab'a'.

source_text: and he moved away from there, and dug another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the shem of it rechovot broad places; and he said, for now hashem hath made rachav room for us, and we shall be fruitful in ha'aretz.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tèke eele era èèna, la'e kèi hari èi èci. d'ai ne'e ne, ra patao-palaha heka. ka isak pangare madha èi ne rehobot, dhu sasoa na ‘era taleo'. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, lamatua hia le èdhi pea ètu era taleo. ho ètu era ne'e ne, èdhi asa bèba-kacanga.

source_text: and he went up from there to be'er-sheva.
target_text: ka nèti era ne'e, isak si lasi hari era pea asa beer syeba.

source_text: and hashem appeared unto him balailah hahu, and said, i am elohei avraham avichah; fear not, for i am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy zera for the sake of avdi avraham my servant abraham.
target_text: ka mèda na, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi isak, hèia na peka, isak! ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti ama mu abraham. de mage mu madha'u, te ja'a ladhe-leru èu. èèna na, ja'a pala-bagi èu mèngi-nale. aa ana-èpu èu asa bèba-kacanga. ja'a ad'u madha j'ara ne'e, lula lii pajaji ja'a dènge ama mu.

source_text: and he built a mizbe'ach there, and called upon the shem of hashem, and pitched his ohel there: and there avdei yitzchak dug a well.
target_text: hèia isak pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban ètu èèna. ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. hèia, na pea ètu era èèna, ka dhèu sab'a na kèi hari èi.

source_text: then avimelech went to him from gerar, and achuzzat his adviser, and phichol the sar tz'va of his.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek mai nèti gerar. angalai na ahusat, dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai dènge ne, ho paraga dènge isak.

source_text: and yitzchak said unto them, why come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
target_text: ka isak karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! uru èèna, miu se dhu babège eele ja'a nèti kabarai miu. de ne'e ne, miu se mai tao ngaa hari?

source_text: and they said, we saw certainly that hashem was with thee; and we said, let there be now an oath between us, even between us and thee, and let us cut a brit covenant with thee;
target_text: hèia ra peka na, sèmi ne'e. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua dhu j'aga pa'ère èu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pangee, hua iia èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji dhu peka sèmi ne'e: èu j'oka subha, peka na,

source_text: that thou wilt do us no ra'ah, just as we have not touched thee, and just as we have done unto thee nothing but tov, and have sent thee away in shalom; thou art now the gebentshter fun hashemthe blessed of hashem.
target_text: miu se baku tao karehe dènge ji'i, aa ji'i kahèi baku tao karehe dènge miu. mema ji'i se d'ara be'a dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, ca hari ni, miu se lami dènge mera-milu nèti kabarai ji'i ne. ji'i dhu nge'a le, lamatua ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale mi miu.

source_text: and he made them a mishteh feast, and they did eat and drink.
target_text: èle èèna ka, isak tao pesta, ka ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they rose up early in the boker, and swore one to another: and yitzchak sent them away, and they departed from him in shalom.
target_text: ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, rèngu j'oka lii soo-subha. hèia isak patalala si lèpa dènge dame.

source_text: and it came to pass the same day, that the avdei yitzchak came, and told him concerning the be'er which they had dug, and said unto him, we have found mayim.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu sab'a isak mai peka lula-nèti èi dhu rèngu kèi, na, ama! ji'i rage le èi.

source_text: and he called it shevah seven, oath: therefore the shem of the ir is be'er-sheva unto this day.
target_text: hèia isak pangare madha èi ne syeba dhu sasoa na ‘subha'. ka ra pangare kota èèna beer syeba, toke sange ne'e.

source_text: and esav was arba'im shanah when he took to wife yehudit the bat be'eri the chitti, and basmat the bat elon the chitti:
target_text: ropa umur esau d'ai èpa nguru tèu, na leo dènge bhèni dhèu dua nèti suku het. bhèni èci, ana nèti beeri, ngara na yudit. èci hari, ana elon, ngara na basmat.

source_text: and they were a morat ruach grief of mind unto yitzchak and rivkah.
target_text: bhèni dhèu dua se, papèd'a d'ara isak dènge ribka.

source_text: and it came to pass, that when yitzchak was zaken old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called esav bno hagadol and said unto him, beni: and he said unto him, hineni.
target_text: ropa isak manahu asa d'ara heka, nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa, lula musi madha na ahu le. ka na paroa ana uuru èèna, dhu na sue risi èèna, peka na, esau. mai ku sa ne'e! hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama?

source_text: and he said, hinei now, i am old, i know not my yom mot:
target_text: ka isak peka hari, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne, ètu d'ara heka le. ke'a boe, pèri lod'o ja'a ne madhe.

source_text: therefore take, now, thy kelim weapons, thy quiver and thy keshet bow, and go out to the sadeh, and hunt me some wild game;
target_text: de more rèka èu, lamu kataki mèti badha hui ci'u hia ja'a.

source_text: and make me matamim savory meat, tasty food, such as i love, and bring it to me, that i may eat; that my nefesh may make a brocha upon thee before i die.
target_text: mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a, madhutu dad'èi ja'a, ho mèti mai hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia mema èu mèngi-nale. sad'i èu unu le mèngi-nale èèna, ja'a madhe èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and rivkah heard when yitzchak spoke to esav bno. and esav went to the sadeh to hunt for wild game, and to bring it.
target_text: hèia esau la'e dènge ka, kataki badha hui. te ngaa ribka dhu tadèngi kahèi lii padhai isak deo na.

source_text: and rivkah spoke unto ya'akov her ben, saying, hinei, i heard avicha speak unto esav achicha, saying,
target_text: ka ribka la'e peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, yakob! èu nanene ku! deo na, ja'a tadèngi ama mu pua esau sèmi ne'e:

source_text: bring me wild game, and make me matamim, that i may eat, and make a brocha upon thee before hashem before my mot.
target_text: ‘lamu kataki more ku badha hui ci'u, mai mu pananasu pabe'a-be'a hia ja'a. ladhe ku'a-kinu kora, ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale ètu katanga madha lamatua. '

source_text: now therefore, beni my son, obey my kol voice according to that which i command thee.
target_text: de mu nanene paie-iie! mu madhutu mola-mola lii paredha ja'a ne.

source_text: go now to the tzon, and bring me from there two gedayei izzim tovim good kids of goats; and i will make them matamim for avicha, such as he loveth:
target_text: de lamu ka asa era badha èdhi sèi, ho kèpe more kalèbho èni dhu kabèb'u dua ngi'u. roro ho mèti sisi mai asa ja'a. pe ja'a pananasu madhutu dad'èi ama mu.

source_text: and thou shalt bring it to avicha, that he may eat, and that he may make a brocha upon thee before his mot.
target_text: ladhe panasu kore, mèti hia ama mu na'a. ho èle na, na hia èu mèngi-nale, heka na madhe kèna. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, èu ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale èèna. a'a mu abhu boe.

source_text: and ya'akov said to rivkah immo, look, esav achi is an ish sa'ir hairy man, and i am an ish chalak smooth man.
target_text: te ngaa yakob peka dènge ina na, ina! a'a ku esau, ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge rèu, te ngaa ja'a ne, isi dhu milu aadha-aadha!

source_text: what if avi will touch me, and i shall seem to him as a meta'te'a mocker; and i shall bring a kelalah upon me, and not a brocha.
target_text: mage dhoka ama ku g'ag'e isi ja'a, ladhe na ne'a na ja'a dhu leko-monya na. hèia na dhoo ja'a!

source_text: and immo said unto him, upon me be thy kelalah, beni; only obey my kol voice, and go bring me them.
target_text: ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, èu baku cag'ag'a! hud'i laa ina ka dhu ator! ladhe ama mu dhoo èu, pe ina ka pasae! mu mate ia ka, la more ka kahib'i sèra.

source_text: and he went, and got, and brought them to immo: and immo made matamim, such as aviv loved.
target_text: ka yakob la'e nare kahib'i dua ngi'u sèra, hèia na roro, ka nèti hia ina na. hèia ribka pananasu madhutu dad'èi isak.

source_text: and rivkah took begadim of esav her ben hagadol, the chamudot best ones which were with her in the bais, and dressed ya'akov her ben hakatan;
target_text: ka ribka la'e nare mèdha-papake esau dhu be'a, ho na papake mi yakob.

source_text: and with orot gedayei haizzim skins of the kids of the goats she dressed and covered his hands, and also upon the smooth of his tzavar neck;
target_text: hèia na pahutu kahèi kacui-aai dènge ladhe goro yakob, pake ka'uri kahib'i deo sa.

source_text: and she gave the matamim and the lechem, which she had prepared, into the yad ya'akov her ben.
target_text: ka na pangèd'u yakob nganga'a dhu pananasu nare deo na, dènge roti dhu tunu nare.

source_text: and he came unto aviv, and said, avi; and he said, hineni; who art thou, beni?
target_text: hèia yakob ded'e nèti nganga'a se'e, hia ama na na'a. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama. ja'a mai hari le. hèia isak dhaa, peka na, hee! èu ne, cee?

source_text: and ya'akov said unto aviv, i am esav thy bechor; i have done according as thou told me; arise, now, sit up and eat of my wild game, that thy nefesh may make a brocha upon me.
target_text: ka yakob dhaa, peka na, ja'a, esau ana mone uuru ama ku! ja'a sab'e le, madhutu sèmi dhu ama pua deo na. kèd'i, ho mu'a-minu ka. lula ja'a pananasu kore le sisi badha hui dhu ja'a kèti nèti d'ara j'ami. mu'a, ho èle na, ama pala-bagi ja'a mèngi-nale.

source_text: and yitzchak said unto bno, how is it that thou hast found it so quickly, beni? and he said, hashem eloheicha worked it out for me.
target_text: hèia isak peka, aku nèngu na, èu ne, bia tai nga! abhu malai titu kèna, badha hui èèna! hèia yakob dhaa, ja'a abhu le, lula lamatua dhu èu mangaj'i èèna, ka dhu tulu ja'a.

source_text: and yitzchak said unto ya'akov, come near, now, that i may touch thee, beni, indeed, whether thou be beni esav or not.
target_text: ka isak paroa yakob, aku nèngu na, padètu ku asa ne'e mai, sèna ka ja'a g'ag'e sèku èu. èu ne, tare'a ana ja'a esau, do aad'o?

source_text: and ya'akov went near unto yitzchak aviv; and he touched him, and said, the kol is kol ya'akov, but the yadayim are the yedei esav.
target_text: hèia yakob la'e padètu-dètu dènge ama na, ka ama na g'ag'e ne. ka isak peka, lii ne, sèmi lii yakob! te ngaa kacui-aai na, kacui-aai esau.

source_text: and he discerned him not, for his hands were se'irot, as yedei esav achiv; so he made a brocha upon him.
target_text: te ngaa isak dhu tadhe iia boe yakob, lula kacui-aai na rèu sèmi esau. ka ropa na neo hia mèngi-nale mi yakob,

source_text: and he said, art thou indeed beni esav? and he said, i am.
target_text: na karèi hari era, aku nèngu na, èu ne, tare'a-re'a esau, do? hèia yakob dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a ama. ja'a ne, esau!

source_text: and he said, bring it near to me, and i will eat of the wild game of beni, that my nefesh may make a brocha upon thee. and he brought it near to him, and he did eat; and he brought him yayin and he drank.
target_text: ka isak peka na, na, j'ole ka sisina mai, sèna ka ja'a ku'a. èle ku, pe ja'a hia èu mèngi-nale. hèia yakob hia sisi dènge èi anggor hia ama na na'a-ninu.

source_text: and aviv yitzchak said unto him, come near now, and kiss me beni.
target_text: na'a nare ka, isak lii, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai padètu asa ne'e, ho mu uu ku ja'a laa.

source_text: and he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the reiach smell of his begadim, and made a brocha upon him, and said, see, the reiach of beni is as the reiach of a sadeh upon which hashem hath made a brocha;
target_text: ka ropa yakob padètu dènge ne, ho uu ne, isak sangèd'u nare hèu mèdha-papake esau. hèia na padhai lii hia mèngi-nale mi yakob, aku nèngu na, hèu ana ja'a tare'a-re'a sèmi hèu j'u'u ètu d'ara pad'a, dhu abhu mamèngi nèti lamatua.

source_text: therefore haelohim give thee of the tal hashomayim, and the fatness of ha'aretz, and plenty of dagan and tirosh;
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua patiri èi paringi nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka oka-tedhe èu j'aj'i mi rai hèu mèngi. hud'i laa na hia èu are dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, dènge hua anggor dhu pènu ako-pènu èru.

source_text: let people serve thee, and amim bow down to thee: be gevir over thy achim, and let bnei immecha bow down to thee: arur be every one that curseth thee, and baruch be he that blesseth thee.
target_text: suku-suku j'aj'i mi ènu èu, aa dhèu-dhèu leo pahaha iisi mi dedha èu. èu j'aj'i mi lamatua nèti a'ari èu. aa rèngu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha èu. dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu, rèngu abhu dhoo kahèi. aa dhèu cee dhu hia mèngi-nale mi èu, rèngu abhu mèngi-nale kahèi.

source_text: and as soon as yitzchak had completed making on ya'akov a brocha, and ya'akov had hardly gone out from the presence of yitzchak aviv, that esav achiv came in from his hunt.
target_text: ropa isak hia nare mèngi-nale mi yakob, ka heka bhodho li'u la'e tèke eele ama na, cag'ag'a laa esau lèpa nèti kataki badha hui.

source_text: and he also had prepared matamim, and brought it unto aviv and said unto aviv, let avi arise, and eat of the wild game of bno, that thy nefesh may make a brocha upon me.
target_text: hèia la'e pananasu, ka sod'e nèti hia ama na. ka na parèi ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, kèd'i mu'a. ja'a lalau kore le sisi badha dhu ja'a kataki kore. mu'a more ku, pe hia ja'a berkat.

source_text: and yitzchak aviv said unto him, mi atah? who art thou? and he said, i am binecha, thy bechor esav.
target_text: te ngaa isak malaa, ka na karèi, hee! te èu ne, cee hari ne? hèia esau dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e, esau! ana uuru ama ku.

source_text: and yitzchak trembled with charadah gedolah ad me'od exceedingly great trembling, and said, who? where is he that hath hunted wild game, and brought it me, and i have eaten of all of it before thou camest, and have made a brocha upon him? and indeed he shall be baruch blessed!
target_text: ka isak cag'ag'a, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, deo na cee ka dhu hia ja'a sisi, ka ja'a ku'a èèna? ka ja'a hia ne mèngi-nale. aa mèngi-nale èèna, bisa heka ère hari.

source_text: and when esav heard the words of aviv, he cried with tzeakah gedolah umarah ad me'od a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto aviv, make a brocha on me, even me also, o avi.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, esau roe ai ca palèpa, ka na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, aku nèngu na, tasamia ne, ama, ee! bagi hia ja'a berkat hèi ma.

source_text: and he said, achicha came with mirmah deceit, and hath taken away thy brocha.
target_text: hèia isak peka, ari mu ka monya ja'a, ka parame nare berkat dhu pala èu di.

source_text: and he said, is not he rightly called shmo ya'akov? for vaya'keveni now he deceived/outwitted me these two times he took away my bechorah birthright; and, hinei, now he hath taken away my brocha blessing. and he asked, hast thou not reserved a brocha for me?
target_text: ka aku esau na, nèngu na leko-monya ja'a dua hari kèna. uru èèna, parame nare hak a'a. ka ne'e ne, parame nare hari berkat dhu madhutu iia-iia na unu ja'a. nèka na, ngara na ‘yakob' te ngaa ele boe ama dhu dènge berkat era, ho hia ja'a. do, aad'o heka? yakob sasoa na ‘kèpe hui tèdhu', te ngaa sasoa dhu leo ‘tuka leko-monya'.

source_text: and yitzchak answered and said unto esav, see, i have made him gevir over you, and all his achim have i given to him for avadim; and with dagan and tirosh have i sustained him; and what shall i do now unto thee, beni?
target_text: hèia isak dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu ded'e le nèngu, j'aj'i lamatua èu. aa a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra, j'aj'i mi ènu na. ja'a hia na le, unu are pènu soka-pènu karo, dènge hua anggor pènu ako-pènu èru. de ana, ee! mamèngi tasamia hari, dhu ja'a ne pala-bagi mi èu?

source_text: and esav said unto aviv, hast thou but one brocha, avi? make a brocha on me, even me also, o avi. and esav lifted up his kol voice, and wept.
target_text: masi ka tadèngi nare le sèmi èèna, te ngaa esau loe boe dènge pamako ama na, peka na, mamèngi na dhodhoka èci di, do? tatu ama dènge hari mamèngi dhu leo hia ja'a. masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, sad'i ja'a ne abhu! ka esau tangi hari dènge d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: and yitzchak aviv answered and said unto him, hinei, thy moshav dwelling shall be the fatness of ha'aretz, and of the tal hashomayim from above;
target_text: ka isak b'ala ne, peka na, mamuri èu ne, èèna na kaj'èu nèti oka-tedhe dhu hèu mèngi, lula èi paringi patiri boe nèti dedha-liru mai, ho pabasa rai èu.

source_text: and by thy cherev shalt thou live, and shalt serve achicha; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt become restless, that thou shalt break his ol yoke from off thy tzavar neck.
target_text: èu ne, mamuri dhoka nèti samala èu di. aa tasa mera mia èèna ka, èu ne j'aj'i ènu ari mu. dhodhoka ladhe bèli-camèd'a, èu bani lab'a ne, èèna na èu heka rai eele nèti d'ara adhe-aai na.

source_text: and esav hated ya'akov because of the brocha wherewith aviv made a brocha upon him: and esav said in his lev, the yemei evel days of mourning for avi are at hand; then will i slay ya'akov achi.
target_text: lula j'ara sèmi ne'e ne ka, esau tèke d'ara dènge ari na yakob, lula parame nare mamèngi na. ka esau pangee na, nèbhu heka, ama ku madhe. de hud'i laa, pe d'ai ku lod'o. ladhe èle beke, ja'a pamadhe ne!

source_text: and these words of esav her ben hagadol were told to rivkah; and she sent and called ya'akov her ben hakatan, and said unto him, hinei, esav achicha, as touching thee, doth console himself, purposing to kill thee. now therefore, beni, shema bekoli listen to my voice! arise, flee thou to lavan achi to charan;
target_text: ropa ribka tadèngi esau dhu neo ad'u j'ara karehe, ka na peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, èu nanene ku lii ne! a'a mu neo b'ala d'ara pèd'a na, de na neo pamadhe èu. de be'a risi, èu ne rai lai-lai asa to'o mu laban, ètu kota haran.

source_text: and tarry with him a few days, until chamat achicha subsides;
target_text: lamu asa nèi, pea ako nèbhu, toke èle nanasa a'a mu.

source_text: and when af achicha subsides from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him; then i will send, and get thee from there. why should i be bereaved also of you both in yom echad one day, the same day?
target_text: ladhe na bhèlu eele ku tatao èu ne, pe ja'a pua dhèu dhiu paroa èu, sèna ka èu lèpa hari mai. lula ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka ana ja'a dua-dua mi ele parènga d'ara ca lod'o èèna ka.

source_text: and rivkah said to yitzchak, i am weary of my life because of the banot chet: if ya'akov take an isha of the banot chet hittite women such as these which are of the banot ha'aretz, what will chayyim to me be?
target_text: hèia ribka roma iisi dènge isak, peka na, ja'a ru'a le dènge dhèu èmu esau, dhèu het se! de ladhe yakob todhe nare hari kahèi ana bhèni nèti dhèu het se, hua iia ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and yitzchak called for ya'akov, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, thou shalt not take an isha of the banot kena'an.
target_text: hèia isak paroa nare yakob, ka hia ne mèngi-nale aa holo ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie! èu mage leo ka dènge ana bhèni kana'an hèi.

source_text: arise, go to paddanah-aram, to the bais betuel avi immecha; and take thee an isha from there of the banot lavan achi immecha.
target_text: de lamu ka asa padan aram, asa baki mu betuel. lamu madhèdi dènge ana bhèni to'o mu laban ca dhèu.

source_text: and el shaddai bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a kahal amim;
target_text: hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele na, hia èu mamèngi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu bèba-kacanga, ho nèti rèngu ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae dhu kapai.

source_text: and give thee the birkat avraham, to thee, and to thy zera with thee; that thou mayest inherit the eretz wherein thou art a ger, which elohim gave unto avraham.
target_text: hud'i laa, lii pajaji ama lamatua dènge abraham èèna, noto mi dedha èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu. sèna ka èu unu rai dhu ama lamatua jaji tèke le mi abraham.

source_text: and yitzchak sent away ya'akov; and he went to paddanah-aram unto lavan ben betuel haarami, achi rivkah, em ya'akov and esav.
target_text: padhai lii nare, ka isak hia yakob la'e asa padan aram, asa èmu to'o na laban, dènge baki na betuel.

source_text: when esav saw that yitzchak had blessed ya'akov, and sent him away to paddanah-aram, to take an isha for him from there; and that when he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, thou shalt not take an isha of the banot kena'an;
target_text: esau dhu tadèngi le kahèi, dhu peka na isak hia yakob mamèngi, aa kai ne sèna ka baku leo dènge bhèni kana'an. aa na tadèngi hèi, dhu isak hia yakob leo dènge ana bhèni to'o na laban ètu padan aram.

source_text: and that ya'akov obeyed his av and his em, and went to paddanah-aram;
target_text: ka yakob madhutu lii paredha ina dènge ama na, ka pakèd'i la'e asa padan aram.

source_text: and esav seeing that the banot kena'an pleased not yitzchak his av;
target_text: aa esau dhu ne'a le kahèi, ama na d'èi boe dhèu èmu na, bhèni kana'an dua sèra.

source_text: then went esav unto yishmael, and took unto the nashim which he had machalat bat yishmael ben avraham, the achot of nevayot, to be his wife.
target_text: hèia na la'e asa ama aae na ismael, ka leo hari èmu dènge ana bhèni ismael ca dhèu, ngara na mahalat. mahalat ne, ana mone na ka nebayot.

source_text: and ya'akov went out from be'er-sheva, and went toward charan.
target_text: ka yakob tèke eele beer syeba, la'e asa haran.

source_text: and he reached a certain place, and tarried there, because the shemesh was set; and he took of the avanim of that place, and put them for his pillow, and lay down in that place to sleep.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, yakob d'ai era èci, ka na j'unu ètu era èèna. na neo j'unu, nare hadhu cue, tao lalaka kètu na.

source_text: and he had a chalom, and hinei a sullam ladder, stairway set up on the ground, and the top of it reached to shomayim: and hinei the malachim of elohim ascending and descending on it.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, na nii. na ladhe nèdhi langa èci dhu patitu ètu rai, suu na d'ai dedha-liru. ka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ca'e-puru ètu dedha langa èèna.

source_text: and, hinei, hashem stood above it, and said, i am hashem elohei avraham thy av, and elohei yitzchak; ha'aretz whereon thou liest, to thee will i give it, and to thy zera;
target_text: ètu d'ara nii na, yakob ladhe nèdhi lamatua dhu titu ètu karasa nèngu, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne lamatua, ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak. èèna na, ja'a hia rai ne mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and thy zera shall be as the dust of ha'aretz, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south; and in thee and in thy zera shall kol hamishpochot haadamah be blessed.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu ae-ae, sama sèmi ahu rai ne. rèngu se, èèna na, pea palème era-era ètu rai-haha ne. nèti ana-èpu èu ka, suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and, hinei, i am with thee, and will be shomer over thee in all places where thou goest, and will bring thee back into haadamah hazot; for i will not leave thee, until i have done that which i have promised thee.
target_text: mage mu bhèlu! èu ne ètu mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge èu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a lere kèti hari èu mai asa dedha-rai ne'e. ja'a bhera boe èu. aa èèna na, ja'a tao aa'i madhutu sèmi lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu.

source_text: and ya'akov awoke out of his sleep, and he said, surely hashem is in this place! and i had no da'as of it.
target_text: ropa yakob kèd'i nèti bhèj'i, na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, lamatua dhu ètu era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: and he was afraid, and said, how nora awesome is this place! this is none other than the beis elohim, and this is the sha'ar hashomayim.
target_text: na madha'u, ka na pangee, na, boo! era ne'e ne pamadha'u ja'a, nga. tatu èmu ama lamatua ètu era ne'e ne! aa era ne'e ne, j'aj'i hèb'a babèdho sorga.

source_text: and ya'akov rose up early in the boker, and took haeven the stone that he had put for his pillow, and set it up for a matzevah pillar, and poured shemen upon the top of it.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, yakob kèd'i le èèna. ka nare hadhu dhu na tao lalaka deo na. hèia na patitu j'aj'i mi tadha. ka na bhori èi mènyi asa dedha hadhu èèna, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and he called the shem of that place beit-el; but the shem of that ir was called luz at the first.
target_text: ka na pangare era ne betel, dhu sasoa na ‘èmu lamatua'. uru èèna, era ne ngara na lus.

source_text: and ya'akov vowed a neder vow, saying, if elohim will be with me, and will be shomer over me in this derech way, journey that i go, and will give me lechem to eat, and beged clothes to put on,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob ded'e subha, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama lamatua dhu dènge ja'a, aa j'aga ja'a ètu d'ara kakako ja'a ne, aa panga'e dènge papake ja'a,

source_text: so that i return to bais avi in shalom; then shall hashem be for me elohim my g-d.
target_text: toke ja'a lèpa dènge sod'a, èèna na lamatua j'aj'i mi ama lamatua ja'a.

source_text: and this even stone, which i have set for a matzevah pillar, shall be beis elohim: and of all that thou shalt give me i will surely give the aser tenth unto thee.
target_text: hadhu dhu ja'a patitu ne, j'aj'i mi era sogo-tagu mi ama lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi ja'a, ja'a hia na ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: then ya'akov went on his journey, and came into the eretz of the bnei kedem.
target_text: hèia yakob kako hari ka asa bèka dhimu.

source_text: and he looked, and hinei a be'er in the sadeh, and, hinei, there were shloshah edrei tzon lying by it; for out of that be'er they watered the edarim: and a great even stone was upon the mouth of the be'er.
target_text: ca lod'o, ladhe nèdhi èi ca madha, dètu dènge rae cue. padètu-dètu dènge madha èi èèna, abhu tèlu kaboko kahib'i-kalèbho, dhu mate rinu èi. te ngaa hadhu aae cue dhu ra pasaguru mi hèb'a èi na.

source_text: and to there were all the edarim gathered: and they rolled the even stone from the mouth of the be'er, and watered the tzon, and put the even stone again upon the mouth of the be'er in its place.
target_text: dhu tema le, ladhe kahib'i tesa aa'i-aa'i ra, ana-ana madhenga kahib'i se, lasi bhoke hadhu na, heka ra dhui kèna, panginu kahib'i si. panginu rare na, ra katange hari hadhu na la'e.

source_text: and ya'akov said unto them, my brethren, where are you from? and they said, of charan are we.
target_text: ka yakob kako la'e asa madha dhèu madhenge kahib'i se, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu mia? hèia ra dhaa, ji'i se, nèti rae haran ne'e.

source_text: and he said unto them, know ye lavan ben nachor? and they said, we know him.
target_text: ka yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu tadhe to'o ja'a, laban, do? nèngu na, ana nahor. ka ra dhaa, ji'i tadhe ne.

source_text: and he said unto them, is the shalom with him? and they said, shalom; and, hinei, rachel his bat cometh with the tzon.
target_text: hèia yakob karèi hari, aku nèngu na, na be'a-be'a, sina ma? ka ra peka, oo, na be'a-be'a. ladhe, ana bhèni na ka nèi. ngara na, rahel. nuka eo nèti kahib'i ama na mai sa ne'e, ho hia rinu ètu ne'e. mate ne.

source_text: and he said, look, the sun is still high, neither is it time that the flock should be gathered together; water ye the tzon, and go and feed them.
target_text: hèia yakob peka hari, loo nètu era. de be'a risi, badha mia ètu se'e le, panginu ka si. sèna ka lere mèti hari asa d'ara pad'a, ho ra'a hari j'u'u.

source_text: and they said, we cannot, until all the edarim be gathered together, and till they roll the even stone from the mouth of the be'er; then we water the tzon.
target_text: te ngaa ra peka, we, j'ara na aad'o sèmi èèna! ji'i mate toke tesa aa'i ku, heka ji'i pakeso hadhu ne, heka panginu badha se kèna.

source_text: and while he yet spoke with them, rachel came with the tzon of her av; for she was a ro'ah shepherdess.
target_text: yakob padhai lii era, rahel d'ai le era èèna dènge kahib'i ama na. nèngu ka dhu biasa ladhe-leru si.

source_text: and it came to pass, when ya'akov saw rachel bat lavan achi immo, and the tzon of lavan achi immo, that ya'akov went near, and rolled the even stone from the mouth of the be'er, and watered the tzon of lavan achi immo.
target_text: ropa yakob nèdhi rahel dènge kahib'i sèra, la'e dènge ka pa'eso eele hadhu dhu saguru hèb'a èi na. ka na panginu badha to'o na sèra.

source_text: and ya'akov kissed rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
target_text: èle ka, la'e uu rahel, dènge tangi.

source_text: and ya'akov told rachel that he was the relative of her av, and that he was ben rivkah; and she ran and told her av.
target_text: ka na lolo dènge rahel, aku nèngu na, ari! ja'a ne, ana nèti ribka, ana hèni ama mu. hèia rahel rai sa èmu la'e, peka dènge ama na.

source_text: and it came to pass, when lavan heard the news of ya'akov ben achoto, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his bais. and he told lavan all these things.
target_text: ropa laban tadèngi lii lolo rahel, dhu peka na yakob ana nèti ana hèni na ribka, ka la'e dènge ka, soru nare yakob. ropa na d'ai, liku nare yakob, ka na uu, hèia gale nèti dènge ka, lasi asa èmu na. ka yakob lolo aa'i-aa'i dènge to'o na.

source_text: and lavan said to him, surely thou art my etzem bone and my basar. and he abode with him the space of a chodesh month.
target_text: hèia laban lii, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! èdhi dua ti dhu pa'a'ari. ropa yakob pea dènge rèngu d'ai ca hèru,

source_text: and lavan said unto ya'akov, because thou art my relative, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nothing? tell me, what shall thy maskoret wages be?
target_text: laban padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yakob! ja'a ko'o boe, sèna ka èu sab'a hia ja'a dènge iia-iia d'ara, lula èdhi se dhu pa'a'ari. de èu neo sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra èu ja'a b'ae ca ngaa?

source_text: and lavan had two banot: the shem of the elder was leah, and the shem of the younger was rachel.
target_text: laban ne, dhu dènge ana bhèni dhèu dua. dhu uru, ngara na lea. aa ari na, ngara na rahel.

source_text: leah had weak eyes; but rachel was yafeh and lovely in form.
target_text: lea ne, musi madha na ako ahu. te ngaa rahel, rèhu na bhèni iia, aa ngi'u na saraga bia.

source_text: and ya'akov loved rachel; and said, i will serve thee sheva shanim for rachel thy bat haketannah younger daughter.
target_text: yakob d'èi risi rahel. ka na peka dènge laban, ladhe to'o ku mo'o, ja'a sab'a hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, sad'i to'o ku hia ja'a madhèdi dènge rahel.

source_text: and lavan said, it is better that i give her to thee, than that i should give her to another ish; abide with me.
target_text: hèia laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! be'a risi, ja'a paleo èu dènge rahel, lula èdhi dua ti dhu a'ari. mage dhoka na madhèdi dènge dhèu leo. de mu pea mi ne'e, sèna ka sab'a hia ja'a.

source_text: and ya'akov served sheva shanim for rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few yamim, because of the ahavah he had for her.
target_text: ka yakob sab'a hia laban pidhu tèu, sèna ka na bisa madhèdi dènge rahel. lula na d'èi madhe-madhe rahel, nèti èèna ka, pidhu tèu èèna, na pangee nuka sèmi pèri-pèri lod'o di.

source_text: and ya'akov said unto lavan, give me my isha, for my yamim are completed, that i may go in unto her.
target_text: ropa risi nèti pidhu tèu, ka na pasanèd'e laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ja'a sab'a le hia to'o ku pidhu tèu, de paleo ka ja'a dènge rahel.

source_text: and lavan gathered together all the anshei hamakom, and made a mishteh feast.
target_text: hèia laban tao tatao, ka na nèru aa'i rae lesa ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and it came to pass in the erev, that he took leah his bat, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her. and lavan gave unto his daughter leah zilpah shifchato his maid for a shifchah. and it came to pass, that in the boker, hinei, it was leah! and he said to lavan, what is this thou hast done unto me? did not i serve with thee for rachel? so why then hast thou deceived me? and lavan said, it must not be so done in our land, to give the younger before the bechirah. finish her shvu'a week, and we will give thee this also for the avodah service, work which thou shalt do for me yet sheva shanim acherot.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda èèna, laban hia boe rahel, te ngaa na pua lea maso asa d'ara paleo yakob. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne. asa bèli èèna, yakob heka ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu leo dènge lea di. hèia yakob la'e patao dènge laban, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, to'o pasèru ja'a sèmi ne'e? ja'a sab'a sèmi ènu pidhu tèu kateme hia mi èu, sèna ka bisa abhu rahel! nga tao ka to'o pasilu dènge lea? ka laban dhaa, baku nasa ku! madhutu ad'a ji'i ètu rai ne'e, ari bisa boe leo uuru èmu nèti a'a. de be'a risi sèmi ne'e! èu mate hari ku pidhu lod'o, d'ai èle tatao ne, heka èu abhu rahel kèna. sad'i èu sab'a hari hia ja'a pidhu tèu. hèia laban pangèd'u dènge ènu bhèni èci, hia mi lea. ngara na silpa.

source_text: and ya'akov did so, and fulfilled her shvu'a; and he gave him rachel his bat to be his isha also.
target_text: lii padhai laban deo na, yakob d'èi kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èle tatao ne pidhu lod'o, ka laban pamadhèdi hari yakob dènge rahel.

source_text: and lavan gave to his bat rachel bilhah his shifchah to be her shifchah.
target_text: ka laban hia ènu na dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na bilha, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ènu rahel.

source_text: and he went in also unto rachel, and he loved also rachel more than leah, and served him yet sheva shanim acherot.
target_text: hèia yakob pa'èci ka dènge rahel. na d'èi risi rahel nèti lea. ka yakob sab'a hari hia to'o na pidhu tèu.

source_text: and when hashem saw that leah was hated, he opened her womb but rachel was barren.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua ne'a le, yakob sue risi rahel nèti lea. nèti èèna ka, na hia lea nara iisi ana. te ngaa rahel abhu boe ana.

source_text: and leah conceived, and bore a ben, and she called shmo reuven: for she said, surely hashem hath looked upon my misery; now therefore my ish will love me.
target_text: hèia lea dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare ne, ruben dhu sasoa na ‘mèdhi si, abhu ana', lula na peka na, lamatua ladhe nèdhi le sasusa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a tao madha-dhilu mi ja'a.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bore ben; and said, because hashem hath heard i was hated, he hath therefore given me this also; and she called shmo shim'on.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia, hèia nara iisi hari ana mone èci. na pangare ne, simeon dhu sasoa na, ele boe ‘dhèu tadèngi le', lula na peka na, lamatua dhu ne'a na, dhèu èmu ja'a sue boe ja'a. tu d'ai èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana dhèu èci hari.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bore ben; and said, now this time will my ish yillaveh become attached unto me, because i have born him shloshah banim: therefore was shmo called levi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea kad'o hari ana èci, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. na pangare na lewi, lula na peka na, dènge ana ne'e ne, èle dènge lii langu ja'a. d'ara dhèu èmu ja'a, pa'èki dènge ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone, dhèu tèlu kèna.

source_text: and she conceived again, and bore ben; and she said, now will odeh i praisehashem; therefore she called shmo yehudah; and stopped giving birth.
target_text: ka lea dènge hari babia ca tèka, hèia nara iisi ana mone èci. na pangare na, yahuda dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘koa-kio', lula na peka na, dènge j'ara ne'e ne, ja'a neo koa-kio lamatua! èle ka, lea dènge heka ana.

source_text: and when rachel saw that she did not bear banim to ya'akov, rachel had kina toward her achot; and said unto ya'akov, give me banim, or else i die.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu abhu mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, nèngu tèke d'ara dènge a'a na. hèia na peka dènge dhèu èmu na, a'a! hia ku ja'a ana laa, ma. ladhe aad'o, be'a risi ja'a madhe ka laa.

source_text: and af ya'akov was kindled against rachel; and he said, am i in place of elohim, who hath withheld from thee p'ri beten?
target_text: te ngaa yakob jèke ne, aku nèngu na, èu ngee na, ja'a ne, lamatua, ho bisa hia èu ana! ?

source_text: and she said, hinei my amah maidservant bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my birkayim, that i may also build up through her.
target_text: ka rahel b'ala na, sèmi ne'e: hua iia èu more bilha, ènu ja'a na. j'unu dènge ne, sèna ka na matana hia ja'a ana.

source_text: and she gave him bilhah her shifchah slave woman, maidservant as isha; and ya'akov went in unto her.
target_text: hèia na pangèd'u bilha mi dhèu èmu na. ka yakob j'unu dènge ne.

source_text: and bilhah conceived, and bore ya'akov ben.
target_text: ka bilha dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and rachel said, elohim danani g-d hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given to me ben: therefore called she shmo dan.
target_text: hèia rahel padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua nanene le lii manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu. ama lamatua pama'ète le, lii langu ja'a dènge mola-mola. ka na pangare ana ne, dan dhu sasoa na ‘pama'ète lii'.

source_text: and bilhah shifchat rachel conceived again, and bore ya'akov ben sheni.
target_text: èle èèna ka, bilha dènge hari babia, ka nara iisi ana mone èci.

source_text: and rachel said, with naftulei elohim niftalti with wrestlings of g-d have i wrestled with my achot, and i have prevailed: and she called shmo naphtali.
target_text: ka rahel peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a limuri ne pa'uji dènge a'a ku, ka ja'a segi. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana na, naftali dhu sasoa na ‘pa'uji', do ‘pa'ère'.

source_text: when leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took zilpah her shifchah, and gave her to ya'akov as isha.
target_text: ropa lea ne'a na nèngu ne dènge heka ana, ka na paleo ènu na silpa dènge yakob.

source_text: and zilpah shifchat leah bore ya'akov ben.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and leah said, bagad what good fortune! and she called shmo gad.
target_text: hèia lea peka na, kalua ja'a, mèngi le. ka na pangare na, gad dhu sasoa na ‘kalua mèngi'.

source_text: and zilpah shifchat leah bore ya'akov ben sheni.
target_text: ka silpa nara iisi hari ana mone èci.

source_text: and leah said, b'ashri happy am i, for the banot will call me asher blessed: so she called shmo asher.
target_text: hèia lea padhai lii, peka na, waa! limuri ne, ja'a heka karej'e kèna! mi laladhe ee, te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na ja'a ne oto bia. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, aser dhu sasoa na ‘karej'e'.

source_text: and reuven went in the yemei ketzir chittim, and found duda'im mandrakes in the sadeh, and brought them unto leah immo. then rachel said to leah, give me, now, of the duda'im of thy ben.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge hèru puu-g'ètu are, ruben la'e asa d'ara j'ami. na rage ana aaj'u ca kapua dhu j'aj'i sèmi èi na'i ho hia dhèu bhèni abhu kolo. ka ruben nèti hia ina na lea. ropa rahel nèdhi, ka na peka dènge lea, aku nèngu na, a'a! bagi ku ja'a ciki, èi na'i dhu ruben nèti èèna.

source_text: and she said unto her, is it a small matter that thou hast taken my ish? and wouldest thou take away the duda'im of beni also? and rachel said, therefore he shall lie with thee halailah tonight for the duda'im of thy ben.
target_text: te ngaa lea b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne seli-kolane! parame more le dhèu èmu ja'a. te ngaa roca mèka na. mu neo hari unu aj'u èi na'i èèna nèti ana ja'a? me'a heka makae d'ara! te ngaa rahel dhaa, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ladhe ja'a abhu èi na'i na, mèda ne'e èu pa'èci dènge yakob. ka lea d'èi kahèi.

source_text: and ya'akov came in from the sadeh ba'erev, and leah went out to meet him, and said, thou must come in unto me; for surely i have hired thee with duda'im of beni. and he lay with her that night.
target_text: ka pe d'ai loo nihia sa, yakob lèpa nèti d'ara oka. lea la'e soru nare ne, ka na peka, a'a! mèda ne, èu j'unu dènge ja'a! lula ja'a dhu hèli kore le èu, dènge kab'ua èi na'i ana ja'a! ka mèda na, yakob j'unu dènge lea.

source_text: and elohim paid heed unto leah, and she conceived, and bore ya'akov ben chamishi.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi-mangaj'i lea. nèti èèna ka, na dènge babia, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka lèmi.

source_text: and leah said, elohim hath given me my hire, because i have given my shifchah to my ish; and she called shmo yissakhar.
target_text: hèia lea pangare ana na, isaskar, dhu sasoa na, ‘b'ae j'aj'èra', lula na peka na, ama lamatua b'ae-baj'a le j'aj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a hia le silpa madhèdi dènge dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and leah conceived again, and bore ya'akov ben shishi.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lea dènge babia hari, hèia nara iisi ana mone ka èna.

source_text: and leah said, elohim hath endued me with a zeved tov good endowment; now will my ish zabal honor me, because i have born him shisha banim; and she called shmo zevulun.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua parasee ja'a mèdha dhu be'a. ka limuri ne, dhèu èmu ja'a hud'i pakab'ua ku ja'a, lula ja'a matana hia ne ana mone dhèu èna. nèti èèna ka, na pangare ana ne, sebulon dhu sasoa na ‘pakab'ua'.

source_text: and afterwards she bore a bat, and called her shem dinah.
target_text: ka lea nara iisi hari, te ngaa ana bhèni, ka na pangare na, dina.

source_text: and elohim remembered rachel, and elohim paid heed to her, and opened her rekhem womb.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu bhèlu boe rahel, ka sèmi lii manèngi-mangaj'i na. nèti èèna ka, na bhoke era ana na.

source_text: and she conceived, and bore ben; and said, elohim hath taken away my cherpah shame, disgrace, reproach;
target_text: hèia rahel dènge babia, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, ama lamatua saku eele le d'ara makae ja'a.

source_text: and she called shmo yosef; and said, yosef may he add, may hashem add me ben acher another son.
target_text: hèia na pangare ana na yusuf dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘hud'i laa na hia tabha hari', lula aku nèngu na, ja'a manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua hia ja'a ana mone ca dhèu hari.

source_text: and it came to pass, when rachel had born yosef, that ya'akov said unto lavan, send me away, that i may go unto mine own makom place, home and to my eretz.
target_text: lod'o rahel nara iisi yusuf, yakob peka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, to'o! ladhe mo'o, ja'a neo lèpa asa rai ètu-èsu ja'a.

source_text: give me my nashim and my yeladim, for whom i have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my avodah which i have done thee.
target_text: ja'a neo laku dènge ana-dhèu èmu ja'a. to'o, èu dhu me'a le, ja'a ne sab'a tèu-tèu nèti mad'ae d'ai loo nihia. de ja'a b'ae pama'ète le rèngu se. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se, j'aj'i le unu ja'a ka teme aae.

source_text: and lavan said unto him, now, if i have found chen favor, grace in thine eyes, tarry; for i have learned by nachash divination that hashem hath made a brocha upon me for thy sake.
target_text: hèia, aku to'o na, ana, ee! èu nanene ku lii ja'a laa! madhutu lii malare dhu ja'a abhu, lamatua hia ja'a mamèngi lula èu.

source_text: and he said, specify thy sachar wages, reward, and i will pay it.
target_text: de èu neo manèngi ca ngaa, peka, sèna ka ja'a b'ae! sad'i èu baku tèke eele ja'a, te ngaa sab'a taruu hia ja'a.

source_text: and he said unto him, thou knowest how i have served thee, and how thy mikneh fared with me.
target_text: ka yakob peka, to'o! èu mèdhi unu mu le, sasab'a-la'a ja'a. nèti èèna ka, badha-manu to'o se, bèba-kacanga.

source_text: for it was me'at little which thou hadst before i came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and hashem hath made a brocha upon thee since my coming; and now when shall i do for mine own bais also?
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhae mai mèka, mèdha-panyau to'o ku ae èèna mèka. te ngaa limuri ne, to'o kaja le. lamatua pala-bagi le to'o ku mamèngi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ka. te d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka ja'a sab'a hia ana-dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: and he said, what shall i give thee? and ya'akov said, thou shalt not give me any thing; if thou wilt do this thing for me, i will again tend and be shomer over thy tzon.
target_text: hèia laban karèi ne, aku nèngu na, de sèmi èèna na, ja'a b'ae èu tasamia? ka yakob dhaa, peka na, to'o ku, hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa badha-manu to'o ku, ja'a ladhe-leru taruu, sad'i mu tao ku j'ara èci.

source_text: i will pass through all thy tzon today, removing from there speckled and spotted seh, and every dark seh among the kesavim, and the spotted and speckled among the izzim; and of such shall be my sachar.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, deo ne'e kahèi, ja'a laku asa badha-manu to'o sèi, ho hag'e si. mia dhu dènge boe katèd'a aa dènge boe karata, sèra sa unu to'o ku taruu. te ngaa mia dhu dènge katèd'a aa dhu karata, hia mi ja'a. dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi, ja'a kora aa'i si. se'e se, hud'i laa j'aj'i mi bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra ja'a.

source_text: so shall my tzedakah answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my sachar before thy face; every one that is not speckled and spotted among the izzim, and dark among the kesavim, that shall be counted a ganavʼs with me.
target_text: d'ai lod'o limuri, pe to'o me'a ja'a ne sab'a dènge mola, do aad'o. sad'i lake more, mai ho mu parisa badha-manu ja'a. ladhe mu abhu kahib'i-ka'ia dhu dènge boe katèd'a, aa dhu karata boe, do, kahib'i-kalèbho dhu pudhi, èèna na, dhu me'a le èèna, ja'a mana'u badha-manu to'o.

source_text: and lavan said, agreed, i would it might be according to thy davar.
target_text: ka laban d'èi kahèi, aku nèngu na, oo! j'ara na sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and he removed that day the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the izzim that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some lavan in it, and all the dark among the kesavim, and gave them into the yad of his banim.
target_text: te ngaa ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, laban hag'e dènge badha dhu katèd'a, dhu karata, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho dhu mèdhi. ka na pangèd'u mi ana na si, ho ladhe-leru.

source_text: and he set a derech shloshet yamim between himself and ya'akov; and ya'akov tended the rest of the tzon lavan.
target_text: hèia eo rèti ka badha se asa era èci dhu kaj'èu na tèlu lod'o kako haga nèti era yakob si. ka yakob madhenge ka badha dhu ata se.

source_text: and ya'akov took him fresh cut makal rod, branch of poplar and of almond and plane tree; and peeled strips of bark in them, and made the lavan white appear which was in the maklot rods, branches.
target_text: èla èèna ka, yakob poro nare dadana aaj'u nèti aj'u tèlu rupa. ka na caci pakarata ka'uri aj'u sèra, tao strep-strep.

source_text: and he set the maklot which he had peeled before the flocks in the small channels of the shikatot mayim watering troughs when the tzon came to drink. and since they bred when they came to drink,
target_text: hèia aj'u dhu strep-strep se, na tèke asa d'ara karab'a kahib'i. badha se dhu tema le pa'ango aa paleo ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the flocks bred before the maklot, and brought forth tzon streaked, speckled, and spotted.
target_text: de ladhe badha se paleo ètu madha aj'u strep-strep se, ra matana ana dhu rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata.

source_text: and ya'akov did separate the kesavim, and set the faces of the tzon toward the streaked, and all the dark in the tzon lavan; and he put his own adarim flocks by themselves, and put them not unto the tzon lavan.
target_text: ka ladhe badha laban se neo paleo, yakob patangare si asa kahib'i dhu katèd'a dènge karata sèra. hèia ana dhu ra matana sa rèu ra katèd'a dènge karata kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, badha na asa ae. ka na pacèri eele si nèti badha laban sèra.

source_text: and it came to pass, whensoever tzon hamekusharot the stronger flock did breed, that ya'akov set the maklot before the eyes of the tzon in the trough channels, that they might breed among the maklot.
target_text: ropa badha dhu èra neo paleo, yakob nare kadhèli aj'u dhu strep-strep sèra, tao mi d'ara karab'a ètu madha si.

source_text: but when the tzon were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler would belong to lavan, and the stronger to ya'akov.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kahib'i dhu roe dènge malaka-god'a neo paleo, yakob soro tèke si. ka badha dhu roe, sèra unu to'o na laban. aa mia dhu èra, sèra unu nèngu.

source_text: and the ish increased exceedingly, and had much tzon, and shefachot, and avadim, and gemalim, and chamorim.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne, yakob j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. ka kahib'i-ka'ia na, kahib'i-kalèbho na, onta na, keled'ei na, dènge ènu na bhèni-mone, udhu sobhu-sobhu.

source_text: and he heard the divrei bnei lavan, saying, ya'akov hath taken away all that belonged to avinu; and of that which belonged to avinu hath he gotten all this kavod.
target_text: ca tèka, yakob tadèngi lii padhai ana-ana laban se, aku rèngu na, kakaja-sasu'i yakob sèra, lula na kao nare aa'i mèdha-panyau ama èdhi.

source_text: and ya'akov beheld the countenance of lavan, and, hinei, it was not toward him as before.
target_text: yakob nèdhi kahèi rèhu to'o laban mare heka, aa be'a heka dènge ne, sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and hashem said unto ya'akov, shuv el eretz avoteicha! and to thy moledet; and i will be with thee.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge yakob, d'ai le lod'o, ho èu lèpa asa ina dènge ama mu. ja'a palere-lere dènge èu.

source_text: and ya'akov sent and called rachel and leah to the sadeh unto his tzon,
target_text: ka yakob hia dhèu lasi paroa rahel dènge lea, sèna ka mai paraga dènge ne ètu era ani badha, ètu d'ara mamoo.

source_text: and said unto them, i see penei avichen, that it is not toward me as before; but elohei avi is with me.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, ja'a ladhe-ladhe na, ama miu na rèhu na mare heka dènge ja'a. aa babe'a na mi ja'a, sèmi heka uru èèna. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ama ku sogo-tagu èèna, palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: and ye know that with all my koach i have served avichen.
target_text: miu dua mi se me'a le, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a j'aj'i kuli ètu ama miu!

source_text: and avichen hath deceived me, and changed my sachar aseret monim but elohim allowed him not to harm me.
target_text: te ngaa sèmi èèna, d'ara na la'e kahèi, ka na kapod'e-kabèli taruu ja'a. ka na ub'a rui-j'aj'èra ja'a, canguru hari kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua j'aga pa'èra ja'a.

source_text: if he said thus, the speckled shall be thy sachar; then all the tzon bore speckled; and if he said thus, the streaked shall be thy sachar; then bore all the tzon streaked.
target_text: lod'o ama miu peka na, ‘badha dhu rèu ra katèd'a sèra j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ho ladhe lod'o badha se matana, ana dhu katèd'a hua-hua. lod'o leo hari, na peka, ‘badha dhu karata sèra, j'aj'i mi unu èu, ' ka badha se matana ana karata aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: thus elohim hath taken away the mikneh of your av, and given them to me.
target_text: ama lamatua ad'u sèmi èèna na, sèna ka nare aa'i badha-manu ama miu èèna, ho hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and it came to pass at the time that the tzon breed, that i lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a chalom, and, hinei, the male goats mounting the tzon were streaked, speckled, and spotted.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa badha se paleo, ja'a kèdhi ètu d'ara nii, dhu peka na, badha mone aa'i-aa'i dhu paleo, abhu dhu katèd'a aa dhu karata hèi.

source_text: and the malach haelohim spoke unto me in a chalom saying, ya'akov: and i said, hineni.
target_text: ka ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga paroa ja'a, peka na, ‘yakob! ' hèia ja'a dhaa, ‘tasamia, lamatua? '

source_text: and he said, lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the male goats leaping upon the tzon are streaked, speckled, and spotted; for i have seen all that lavan doeth unto thee.
target_text: ka na lii, ‘ladhe ku laa! badha mone dhu paleo sèra, dhodhoka dhu karata dènge katèd'a di. ja'a ka ad'u sèra sa, lula ja'a dhu kèdhi le, ngaa dhu laban tao mi dedha èu.

source_text: i am hael beit-el, where thou anointedst a matzevah pillar, and where thou vowedst a neder vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from haaretz hazot, and return unto thy eretz moledet.
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua, dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu betel èèna. ètu era nèi, èu patitu hadhu, ka mu bhori èi mènyi ètu dedha na, ka èu sogo-tagu ja'a. ka èu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ja'a ètu nèi. de kèd'i ka, tèke eele ka rai ne'e ne, lamu ka asa kabarai ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and rachel and leah answered and said unto him, is there yet any chelek or nachalah for us in bais avinu?
target_text: hèia rahel dènge lea b'ala lii na, aku rèngu na, la'a ma! ji'i dènge heka pusaka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama ji'i laban.

source_text: are we not regarded by him nokhriyyot foreigners, strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our kesef.
target_text: nèbhu nare sange ne'e, mone heka ne tao ji'i sèmi dhèu leo kara sa. na pahie eele le ji'i se. ka na'e aa'i le kab'ua-kadheli ji'i se.

source_text: for all the oisher elohim hath taken from avinu, that belongs to us and baneinu; so then, whatsoever elohim hath said unto thee, do.
target_text: de mèdha-panyau dhu ama lamatua nare sèra nèti ama ji'i laban, aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu èdhi dènge ana-ana èdhi se. de ladhe aku lamatua tasa mera mia, te'a dhoka madhutu di!

source_text: then ya'akov rose up, and set his banim and his nashim upon the gemalim; and he drove all his mikneh, and all his goods which he had gotten, the mikneh of his getting, which he had gotten in paddan-aram, for to go to yitzchak aviv in eretz kena'an.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob lalau mèdha-panyau na. hèia na paca'e ana-dhèu èmu na asa dedha onta lasi, aa na eo nèti badha-manu na aa'i-aa'i, dènge mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu ètu padan aram, ho lasi asa rai kana'an.

source_text: and lavan went to shear his tzon; and rachel had stolen the terafim that belong to her av.
target_text: lod'o èèna, laban dhu la'e g'ute rèu kahib'i-kalèbho na. ka rahel mana'u nare patung mèdha sogo-tagu ama na.

source_text: unawares to lavan haarami, ya'akov stole away, in that he told him not that he was fleeing.
target_text: aa yakob si lasi palangu boe lii dènge to'o na.

source_text: so he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the nahar i. e. the euphrates, and set his face toward har gil'ad.
target_text: na bau nèti aa'i mèdha-panyau na, ka ra kako pamèri-mèri, lasi re loko efrat, asa ledhe gilead.

source_text: and it was told lavan on yom hashlishi that ya'akov was fled.
target_text: rarai yakob si èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o ku, heka laban ne'a kèna.

source_text: and he took his achim with him, and pursued after him derech shivat yamim; and they overtook him at har gil'ad.
target_text: hèia laban oru nare ka dhèu-dhèu na, lasi bate yakob si. d'ai pidhu lod'o ku, heka ra paraga dènge si ètu ledhe gilead.

source_text: and elohim came to lavan haarami in a chalom halailah, and said unto him, take heed that thou speak not to ya'akov either tov or rah.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda èèna, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi laban ètu d'ara nii. na peka na, laban! ladhe èu padhai lii dènge yakob, j'aga paie hèb'a èu na.

source_text: then lavan overtook ya'akov. now ya'akov had pitched his ohel on the har; and lavan with his achim encamped in har gil'ad.
target_text: mèda èèna, yakob si dhu patitu paleo ètu ledhe gilead. aa laban si patitu unu ra kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna kahèi.

source_text: and lavan said to ya'akov, what hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my banot, like shevuyot captives taken with the cherev?
target_text: èle ka, laban mai paraga dènge yakob. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu rai mèti ana bhèni ja'a se, dènge boe lii ugu-ge'e sa hèi? mu tao si sèmi dhèu dhu èu segi ètu d'ara papara-pakèj'i.

source_text: why didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that i might have sent thee away with simchah, and with shirim songs, with tof timbrel, tambourine and with kinnor harp?
target_text: èu ne ad'a aad'o, palangu boe sa hèi dènge ja'a! ladhe èu peka dènge ja'a be'a-be'a, ele boe ja'a tao sisi-kau, ho ta'a-tinu boko-boko, ho lere miu dènge lii sod'a, heka ji'i patabuli miu kèna.

source_text: and hast not allowed me to kiss my banim grandchildren and my banot? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
target_text: sasala èu èci hari ka, èu hia boe ja'a uu ana-èpu ja'a hèi. tatao èu ne goa titu kèna!

source_text: it is in the power of my yad to do you rah; but elohei avichem spoke unto me emesh last night, saying, take thou heed that thou speak not to ya'akov either tov or rah.
target_text: carui boe, ladhe ja'a ne neo paj'èra èu! te ngaa malo-malo ka mèda-mèda na, ama lamatua dhu ama mu sogo-tagu èèna, kai ja'a peka na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge èu, ja'a hud'i j'aga paie-iie ku hèb'a ja'a.

source_text: and now, though thou had to go, because thou greatly longedst after bais avicha, yet why hast thou stolen elohai?
target_text: mema, ja'a dhu ke'a le, èu pakèd'i lula èu dhu neo le lèpa. te ngaa tasamia ka, èu mana'u mèti patung mèdha sogo-tagu ja'a?

source_text: and ya'akov answered and said to lavan, because i was afraid; for i said, thou wouldest take by force thy banot from me.
target_text: hèia yakob b'ala, aku nèngu na, to'o baku nasa ku dènge ja'a! ja'a pakèd'i mau-mau èèna, lula ja'a mage dhoka mo'o boe ja'a kèti ana-ana se!

source_text: with whomsoever thou findest eloheicha, let him not live; before acheinu discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. for ya'akov knew not that rachel had played the ganav with them.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhu ne'a nare boe, na dhèu èmu na rahel ka dhu mana'u nèti. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, to'o! mèdha sogo-tagu èèna, mu tenge ne! ladhe mèdhi ètu cee, huku pamadhe ne. parisa aa'i mèu-mèu. ladhe abhu kahèi pusaka to'o dhu leo, more aa'i si. hud'i laa, dhèu se'e se j'aj'i sakasii.

source_text: and lavan went into the ohel ya'akov, and into the ohel leah and into the ohel shtei ha'amahot; but he found them not. then went he out of the ohel leah, and entered into the ohel rachel.
target_text: hèia laban la'e parisa ka asa d'ara paleo se èci-èci. na la'e uru asa d'ara paleo yakob. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo lea. èle ka, la'e asa d'ara paleo ènu se dua ra. te ngaa abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. paleo rahel limuri tèka.

source_text: now rachel had taken the terafim, and put them in the saddle of the gamal, and sat upon them. and lavan searched all the ohel, but found them not.
target_text: te ngaa rahel dhu huni le mèdha sogo-tagu sèra ètu d'ara lalaka onta. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha. d'ai d'ara paleo ne, laban tenge paie-iie, te ngaa na rage boe.

source_text: and she said to her av, let it not displease adoni that i cannot rise up in thy presence; for the derech nashim is upon me. and he searched but found not the terafim.
target_text: hèia rahel peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama mage mu nasa kahèi. te ja'a bisa boe titu, lula ja'a abhu hèru. masi ka sèmi èèna, laban tenge taruu, te ngaa abhu boe mèdha sogo-tagu sèra.

source_text: and ya'akov was in wrath, and upbraided lavan: and ya'akov answered and said to lavan, what is my peysha? what is my chattat, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
target_text: ka yakob nasa, hèia na pajèka dènge laban, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne tao bhelu ngaa mi to'o? ka to'o mai bate ja'a, sèmi dhu ja'a ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa!

source_text: whereas thou hast searched through all that i own, what hast thou found of all thy kelei bais? set it here before my achim and thy achim, that they may judge between us both.
target_text: mèdha-panyau ja'a, to'o ceb'e eele si. de mu abhu ngaa? more ka mai tèke mi madha ne, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti tèdhi. aa hud'i laa, dhèu se'e ka dhu pama'ète mèdha èèna unu cee.

source_text: these esrim shanah have i been with thee; recheleicha thy ewes and thy female goats have not miscarried, and the rams of thy tzon have i not eaten.
target_text: dua nguru tèu kèna, ja'a sab'a kuli mi to'o. lod'o ja'a madhenga badha-manu to'o, ci'u sa legu boe. aa ku'a kèdhi boe ci'u sa hèi!

source_text: that which was treifah torn of beasts i brought not unto thee; i bore the loss of it; of my yad didst thou require it, whether stolen by yom, or stolen by lailah.
target_text: ladhe badha hui-hahi hui, kadhi pamadhe badha to'o ci'u, ja'a peka boe, te ngaa ja'a gati. aa ladhe dhèu mana'u, to'o pua ja'a gati, masi ka ja'a sala boe.

source_text: thus i was; in the yom the chorev heat consumed me, and the kerach cold by lailah; and my sheynah sleep departed from mine eyes.
target_text: ladhe re mèu, madha lod'o ai pamango ja'a. aa ladhe mèda, ja'a maringi rig'i-rig'i. ja'a pasaruru boe ciki sa, toke mèu rai, lula madhenge badha-manu to'o.

source_text: thus have i been esrim shanah in thy bais; i served thee arba-esreh shanah for thy two banot, and shesh shanim for thy tzon: and thou hast changed my sachar aseret monim.
target_text: mema tare'a, dua nguru tèu èèna! ja'a sab'a canguru èpa tèu, sèna ka abhu ana bhèni to'o, dhèu dua se. ka ja'a sab'a hari èna tèu, sèna ka ja'a unu badha-manu se'e. j'aj'i kuli nèbhu nare sange èèna, te ngaa to'o pakura rui-j'aj'èra ja'a d'ai canguru hari.

source_text: except elohei avi, elohei avraham, and the pachad of yitzchak had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty handed. elohim hath seen mine oni and the toil of my palms, and rebuked thee emesh last night.
target_text: malo-malo ka, dènge ama lamatua, dhu baki ku abraham, dènge ama ku isak, dhu sogo-tagu ne. ladhe na leru boe ja'a ne, ele boe to'o hia ja'a lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu pa'abhe boe musi madha na mi j'aj'èra ja'a, aa na tao madha-dhilu mi sasab'a-la'a ja'a aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, mèda deo na, na mai kai to'o, sèna ka baku lii sakaa dènge ja'a.

source_text: and lavan answered and said unto ya'akov, these banot are my banot, and these banim are my banim, and this tzon is my tzon, and all that thou seest is mine; yet what can i do today about these my banot, or about their banim which they have born?
target_text: ropa nanene nare lii padhai yakob, ka laban dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! bhèni dua se, ana ja'a. ana dhu ra matana se, aa'i-aa'i ra èpu ja'a. badha-manu aa'i-aa'i se, unu ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi ètu se'e se, unu ja'a. te ngaa ja'a neo tao si, tasamia? ja'a bisa boe magee si.

source_text: now therefore come thou, let us cut a brit, i and thou; and let it be for an ed between me and thee.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji. sèna ka lii pajaji èèna ka dhu èki èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and ya'akov took an even, and set it up for a matzevah pillar.
target_text: hèia yakob nare ka hadhu aae cue, na patitu ètu èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha.

source_text: and ya'akov said unto his achim, gather avanim; and they took avanim, and made a gal heap, mound; and they did eat there upon the gal.
target_text: hèia yakob pua dhèu sab'a na, lasi udhu hadhu. ka ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu era èèna, padètu dènge hadhu sèra.

source_text: and lavan called it yegar sahaduta; but ya'akov called it gale'ed heap of witness.
target_text: hèia laban pangare hadhu udhu sèra, yegar sahaduta. te ngaa yakob pangare na, galeed.

source_text: and lavan said, this gal heap, mound is an ed witness between me and thee this day. therefore was shmo called gale'ed;
target_text: ka laban padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hadhu udhu se, j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ngara na, galeed.

source_text: and mitzpah watch; for he said, hashem watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
target_text: laban pangare kahèi era èèna, mispa dhu sasoa na ‘era j'aga dhu dedha', lula na peka na, pe èèna na, lamatua ka dhu j'aga èdhi dua ti, ho masi ka dua ti pakaj'èu, baku kako eele lii pajaji ne.

source_text: if thou shalt afflict my banot, or if thou shalt take nashim besides my banot, no man is with us; see, elohim ed beini uveinecha elohim is witness between me and you.
target_text: ladhe èu tao karehe ana ja'a se, do leo-èmu dènge bhèni leo hari, tatu ja'a ke'a boe. te ngaa mu sanèd'e! ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi èdhi dua ti.

source_text: and lavan said to ya'akov, hinei this gal heap, mound, and hinei the matzevah pillar, which i have cast between me and thee; this gal heap, mound be ed witness, and this matzevah pillar be edah witness, that for ra'ah i will not pass over this gal to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this gal and this matzevah unto me.
target_text: èu ladhe ku hadhu dhu patitu ne, dènge hadhu dhu udhu se. sanèd'e, hadhu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi too dènge lane. èu bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi ja'a. aa ja'a kahèi bisa boe kako seli hadhu se, ho tao bhelu mi èu.

source_text: the elohei avraham, and elohei nachor, elohei avihem judge between us. and ya'akov swore by the pachad aviv yitzchak.
target_text: dua ti pa'èki lii pajaji ne, dènge kolongara ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èdhi. nuka ama lamatua nèti baki mu abraham dènge baki ja'a nahor. nèngu èèna ka, dhu j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti. ropa nanene nare, hèia yakob j'oka soo-subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, dhu ama na isak sogo-tagu.

source_text: then ya'akov offered zavach upon the har, and called his achim to eat lechem; and they did eat lechem, and tarried all night on the har.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob roro badha, ho j'aj'i mi korban hia mi lamatua ètu ledhe èèna. hèia na paroa dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai ra'a-rinu pa'èci, ka ra beke d'ai lod'o rea.

source_text: and early in the boker morning lavan rose up, and kissed his banim and his banot, and made on them a brocha; and lavan departed, and returned unto his makom.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si kako taruu. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga sèra mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and ya'akov went on his derech, and the malachim of elohim met him.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi si, na lii, aku nèngu na, era ne'e ne, sèmi era ae sordad'u lamatua! nèti èèna ka, era èèna na pangare na, mahanaim dhu sasoa na ‘dua era ae iisi'.

source_text: and when ya'akov saw them, he said, this is mahaneh elohim; and he called the shem of that makom place machanayim.
target_text: ka yakob pua dhèu na pèri-pèri lasi uuru asa rai edom nuka seir, sèna ka lasi peka dènge a'a na esau, ho ne'a mamai na.

source_text: and ya'akov sent malachim before him to esav achiv unto eretz se'ir, the country of edom.
target_text: hèia yakob peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lami peka dènge a'a ku esau, sèmi ne'e: ‘lamatua esau! ènu mu yakob, hia ji'i ngèti lii karej'e-karae mi a'a na. peka na, karèi nèti ja'a pakèd'i, toke sange ne'e ne, ja'a pea ètu d'ara èmu to'o laban.

source_text: and he commanded them, saying, thus shall ye speak unto adoni esav; thy eved ya'akov saith thus, i have sojourned with lavan, and stayed there until now;
target_text: limuri ne, ènu lamatua na dènge le unu sapi, keled'ei, rupa-rupa kahib'i, dènge ènu bhèni-mone. ja'a hia uru dhèu se'e dhiu, ho peka dènge a'a ku, mamai ja'a ne. ja'a sanao sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ' èle ka dhèu se lasi.

source_text: and i have shor oxen, and chamor, tzon, and eved, and shifchah; and i have sent to tell adoni, that i may find chen grace in thy sight.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa hari mai, ra lolo dènge yakob, aku rèngu na, ji'i paraga le dènge a'a mu esau. nuka na mai re limuri nèi, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu dhèu mone, neo mai paraga dènge èu.

source_text: and the malachim returned to ya'akov, saying, we came to esav achicha, and also he cometh to meet thee, and arba me'ot ish with him.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, sangasa yakob rèbha-rèbha, aa na madha'u ae. ka na hag'e eele dhèu na dènge badha-manu j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: then ya'akov was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided haam that was with him, and the tzon, and bakar, and the gemalim, into two machanot;
target_text: na pangee, ladhe esau mai, ho na age kaboko dhu uru, na kaboko dhu limuri bisa rai, tenge sod'a.

source_text: and said, if esav come to the one machaneh, and attack it, then the other machaneh which is left shall escape.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi-mangaj'i, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! èu j'aj'i lamatua nèti baki ja'a abraham, aa nèti ama ku isak. nanene ku lii manèngi ja'a la! uru èèna, lamatua ka dhu hia ja'a lèpa asa a'ari ja'a, ètu kabarai ne'e. lamatua ka dhu moa tèke, peka na pe lamatua uri pamola j'ara.

source_text: and ya'akov said, o elohei avi avraham, and elohei avi yitzchak, hashem which saidst unto me, shuv l'aretzecha and to thy moledet kindred, and i will deal well with thee;
target_text: ja'a ne madhutu mola-mola na, bisa boe abhu sasue dènge mamako lamatua. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pège loko yarden, ja'a kèti dhoka tatea di. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a lèpa kèti dènge dhèu dua nau, aa dènge badha-manu ae.

source_text: i am not worthy of the least of all the chasadim, and of all the emes, which thou hast showed unto thy eved; for with my makal rod, staff i passed over this yarden; and now i am become two machanot.
target_text: ja'a mangingi, mage dhoka a'a ja'a esau, mai pare pamadhe ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamuri mi ja'a, dènge ana-dhèu èmu-kamali aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: save me, now, from the yad achi, from the yad esav; for i fear him, lest he will come and attack me, em with banim.
target_text: lamatua dhu jaji tèke, èèna na pala-bagi mi dedha ja'a mamèngi ae-ae, aa hia ana-èpu ja'a bèba-kacanga, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi, dhu dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: but thou saidst, i will surely do thee good, and make thy zera as the chol of the yam, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
target_text: èle ka, yakob si j'unu ètu era èèna. asa bèli èèna, na hag'e badha pèri-pèri ngi'u ho rèti hia a'a na.

source_text: and he spent there that same night; and took of that which came to his yad a minchah for esav achiv;
target_text: na pili nare kahib'i rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i mone dua nguru ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho rena dua ngasu ngi'u, kahib'i-kalèbho mone dua nguru ngi'u,

source_text: two hundred female goats, and twenty male goats, two hundred rechelim ewes, and twenty eilim rams,
target_text: onta rena tèlu nguru ngi'u dènge ana susu, sapi rena èpa nguru ngi'u, canguru ngi'u sapi mone, keled'ei rena dua nguru ngi'u, dènge canguru ngi'u keled'ei mone.

source_text: thirty nursing gemalim with their colts, forty parot cows, and ten parim bulls, twenty female donkeys, and ten male donkeys.
target_text: ka na hag'e ka badha se, èci-èci ka dènge anga na. hèia na papala ka, èci-èci dènge ana madhenge na. ka na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu kako uuru. pe ja'a dhiu. te ngaa mi palaladha ho kaboko èci pakaj'èu nèti kaboko dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and he delivered them into the yad of his avadim, every herd by itself; and said unto his avadim, pass over before me, and keep a space between herd and herd.
target_text: ka na peka dènge kaboko dhu uuru tèka, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'a ku esau paraga dènge èu, aa na karèi, peka na, ‘èu lamu mia? èu ne, ènu nèti cee? badha-manu se, unu cee? '

source_text: and he commanded the rishon, saying, when esav achi meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, whose art thou? and to where goest thou? and whose are these animals before thee?
target_text: na mi dhaa, peka na, ‘badha-manu se, unu ènu mu, yakob. na pa'adhu hia a'a na, esau. te ngaa nèngu nuka nèti limuri nèi. '

source_text: then thou shalt say, they are of thy eved ya'akov; it is a minchah sent unto adoni esav; and, hinei, also he is behind us. and so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the adarim herds, saying, on this manner shall ye speak unto esav, when ye find him.
target_text: lii sèmi èèna, na peka kahèi dènge dhèu madhenga badha cahag'e sèra hèi, aku nèngu na, ladhe mi paraga dènge a'a ku esau, mi hia ne badha-manu se. aa mi peka dènge ne, ja'a re limuri. lula madhutu a'abhu yakob, na hia badha se aa'i-aa'i mi esau, èèna na esau sèmi nèngu dènge be'a.

source_text: and say ye moreover, hinei, thy eved ya'akov is behind us. for he said, akhapperah i will appease, cover his face with the minchah that goeth ahead of me, and afterward i will see his face; perhaps he will accept me.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na hia uuru rèti badha se. te ngaa mèda èèna, nèngu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: so went the minchah present over ahead of him; but he himself stayed balailah in the machaneh.
target_text: mèda na, yakob kèd'i, ka na pua dhèu èmu na dhèu dua, dènge dhèu èmu piara dhèu dua, dènge ana na dhèu canguru èci sèra, lasi uuru pège asa cabèka loko yabok.

source_text: and he rose up that night, and took his two nashim and his two shifchot, and his eleven yeladim, and passed over the ma'avar ford yabbok.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai ca bèka loko, ka na hia aa'i mèdha-panyau na asa nèi.

source_text: and he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over all that he had.
target_text: te ngaa yakob pea ka mesa-mesa ètu èèna. hèia dhèu mone èci mai, ka dua ra palèka d'ai oe mèu.

source_text: and ya'akov was left by himself; and there wrestled an ish with him until the shachar dawn, sunup.
target_text: ropa mone ne ne'a na nèngu segi boe yakob, ka na kalabhe mi kolo keja yakob, ka gage na tabod'a eele nèti era na.

source_text: and when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he struck his hip socket; so ya'akovʼs hip socket dislocated while he wrestled with him.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii, aku nèngu na, patabuli ja'a, te ciki hari, lod'o rea kèna. te ngaa, aku yakob na, èu hia ja'a mèngi-nale, heka ja'a patabuli èu kèna!

source_text: and he said, let me go, for shachar breaketh. and he said, i will not let thee go, unless thou make a berakhah upon me.
target_text: ka mone ne karèi ne, ngara èu ne, cee? na dhaa, peka na, yakob.

source_text: and he said unto him, what is shemecha? and he said, ya'akov.
target_text: hèia mone ne lii hari, aku nèngu na, èu ngara heka yakob. te ngaa mulai nèti deo ne'e ne, dhèu paroa èu, isra'el, lula èu lab'a le dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, ka èu segi. ngara isra'el sasoa na ‘dhu palèka dènge ama lamatua'.

source_text: and he said, shimcha shall be called no more ya'akov, but yisroel: for sarita im elohim yisrah=to prevail + el=g-d = yisroel ye have striven with elohim and with anashim, and hast overcome.
target_text: ka yakob karèi ne, èu peka ku ngara èu la. te ngaa mone ne peka na, èu neo me'a ngara ja'a, tao ngaa? hèia na hia mèngi-nale mi yakob ètu era èèna.

source_text: and ya'akov asked him, and said, tell me, now, shemecha. and he said, why is it that thou dost ask after shmi? and he made a brocha upon him there.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le ama lamatua madha dènge madha, te ngaa ja'a mamuri era. nèti èèna ka, yakob pangare era èèna, peniel, dhu sasoa na, ‘rèhu lamatua'.

source_text: and ya'akov called the shem of the makom place peniel face of g-d: for i have seen elohim panim el panim, and my nefesh is saved.
target_text: ropa yakob tèke eele era èèna, lod'o dhu rea le. te ngaa na kako ged'a, lula gage na tabod'a.

source_text: and as he passed over penuel the shemesh rose upon him, and he limped upon his hip.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu isra'el ra'a boe sisi isi lasona, lula lamatua kalabhe patabod'a eele gage bèi-baki ra yakob.

source_text: and ya'akov lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, hinei, esav came, and with him arba me'ot ish four hundred men. and he divided the yeladim unto leah, and unto rachel, and unto the two shefachot.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o èèna kahèi, yakob ladhe nèdhi esau, dènge dhèu na èpa ngasu sèra, mai asa rèngu. ka na papala ana na mi ina ra èci-èci.

source_text: and he put the shefachot and their yeladim rishonah, and leah and her yeladim acharonim, and rachel and yosef acharonim.
target_text: na hia dhèu èmu piara sèra dènge ana ra kako uuru. èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, heka rahel dènge ana na yusuf limuri tèka.

source_text: and he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground sheva pe'amim, until he came near to achiv his brother.
target_text: te ngaa yakob kako uuru nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa na padètu dènge a'a na, na patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u d'ai rai pidhu hari.

source_text: and esav ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his tzavar neck, and kissed him; and they wept.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o esau ladhe nèdhi ari na, rai dènge ka, la'e liku nare yakob. dua ra paliku dènge pa'uu. hèia dua ra tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw the nashim and the yeladim; and said, who are those with thee? and he said, the yeladim which elohim hath graciously given thy eved.
target_text: ropa esau nèdhi bhèni dènge ana-ana si, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, se'e se, cee ka se'e? ka yakob peka, rèngu se'e se, dhu ama lamatua pala-bagi hia ja'a, ènu a'a ku ne.

source_text: then the shefachot came near, they and their yeladim, and they bowed themselves.
target_text: hèia dhèu èmu piara na, dènge ana niki ra lasi pahaha iisi ètu madha esau.

source_text: and leah also with her yeladim came near, and bowed themselves; and after came yosef near and rachel, and they bowed themselves.
target_text: èle ka, lea dènge ana-ana na, lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi. dhu lasi limuri, yusuf dènge ina na rahel lasi pahaha iisi mi esau kahèi.

source_text: and he said, what meanest thou by all this machaneh which i met? and he said, these are to find chen grace in the eyes of adoni.
target_text: èle èèna ka, esau karèi, aku nèngu na, èu pa'adhu badha pèri nau sèi, èu neo tao ngaa? hèia yakob dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'a! ja'a hia mi a'a ku, sèna ka a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo.

source_text: and esav said, i have enough, achi my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
target_text: te ngaa esau peka, ja'a dènge mèdha-panyau ae kahèi. de hia ia ka ja'a ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and ya'akov said, no, now, if i have found chen grace in thy sight, then receive my minchah at my yad inasmuch as i have seen thy face, as though i had seen the p'nei elohim the face of g-d vatirtzeini and thou wast pleased to accept me, thou wast appeased by me.
target_text: te ngaa yakob b'ala, peka na, baku, a'a. a'a ku hud'i sèmi la mèdha se, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge d'ara taleo. te ropa a'a ku b'ui mari, ka ja'a sèmi dhu kèdhi b'ui mari nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: accept, now, my brocha that is brought to thee; because elohim hath dealt graciously with me, and because yesh li khol there is to me all, my needs are met. and he urged him, and he accepted.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, a'a ku sèmi la mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua aad'o se. lula ama lamatua be'a titu kèna dènge ja'a ne. nèti èèna ka, na hia ja'a unu ngaa-ngaa se aa'i-aa'i. lula yakob pamako taruu, no'o do no'o boe èèna ka, esau sèmi nare kahèi.

source_text: and he said, nise'ah let us take our journey, and let us go, i will go next to thee.
target_text: hèia esau peka dènge yakob, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, miu pa'èra ho lati palere. ja'a lere miu.

source_text: and he said unto him, adoni knoweth that the yeladim are tender and the nursing tzon and bakar are upon me; and if men should overdrive them yom echad, all the tzon will die.
