target_text: te ngaa aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a! a'a ku ladhe mèdhi unu mu. ana mu se, ana iiki ae era. rèngu se dhae èra èèna mèka. aa badha ae ka dhu heka matana. ladhe ta pakaseti si kako pamèri, ètu d'ara ca lod'o, èèna na madhe aa'i si.

source_text: let now adoni, pass over before his eved; and i will lead on slowly, according to the pace of the drove that goeth before me and the pace the yeladim are able to endure, until i come unto adoni at se'ir.
target_text: de be'a risi, a'a ku si kako uuru. pe ji'i kako mau-mau dhiu. ladhe èèna na, ja'a dhiu ngad'o a'a ku ètu seir.

source_text: and esav said, let me now leave with thee some of haam that are with me. and he said, what needeth it? let me find chen in the sight of adoni.
target_text: hèia esau lii hari, na peka, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele dhèu ja'a se cahag'e, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa, aku yakob na, hud'i laa, a'a, ee! sad'i ja'a ke'a le, a'a ku sèmi ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: so esav returned that day on his derech unto se'ir.
target_text: tadèngi nare, esau pakèd'i ka, tèke eele si, lèpa asa seir.

source_text: and ya'akov journeyed to sukkot, and built him a bais, and made sukkot for his mikneh; therefore the shem of the makom is called sukkot.
target_text: te ngaa nèti era èèna, yakob la'e asa sukot. d'ai nèi, na tao èmu dènge oka hia badha aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, era èèna ra pangare na sukot dhu sasoa na ‘èmu pea taha'.

source_text: and ya'akov came shalem to ir shechem, which is in eretz kena'an, when he came from paddan-aram; and encamped before the ir.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe ka, yakob si kako nèti padan aram, lasi d'ai rae sikem ètu rai kana'an dènge sod'a-mole. hèia ra patitu paleo, sèna ka ra pea padètu dènge rae èèna.

source_text: and he bought a chelkat hasadeh piece of land, where he had pitched there his ohel, from the yad bnei chamor avi shechem, for a hundred pieces of kesitah money.
target_text: rai dhu yakob patitu paleo ne, hèli nare nèti hemor, ana sikem. kab'ua rai ne, ca ngasu doi iia.

source_text: and he erected there a mizbe'ach, and called it el elohei yisroel.
target_text: ètu era ne, na pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne'e, el-elohe-isra'el, dhu sasoa na ‘ama lamatua nèti isra'el'.

source_text: and dinah bat leah, which she bore unto ya'akov, went out to see the banot haaretz.
target_text: ca lod'o, dina, ana bhèni yakob dènge lea, la'e pangad'o dènge bhèni anga-aangalai na ètu rae èèna.

source_text: and when shechem ben chamor the chivi hivite, nasi haaretz, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and violated her.
target_text: dhèu aae kabarai ne, ngara na hemor, nèti suku hewi. ngara ana mone na, sikem. ca tèka, sikem ladhe nèdhi dina, ka rai nèti ne, hèia na tao pakarehe ne.

source_text: and his nefesh had deveykus unto dinah bat ya'akov, and he loved the na'arah, and spoke to the lev hanaarah.
target_text: sikem d'èi madhe-madhe dina ne. ka na solo mako, sèna ka dina no'o dènge ne.

source_text: and shechem spoke unto chamor aviv, saying, get me this yaldah as isha.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama! lamu karèi dina hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhèdi dènge ne.

source_text: and ya'akov heard that he had made his bat dinah tameh; now his banim were with his mikneh in the sadeh; and ya'akov held his peace until they were come.
target_text: tatao sikem ne, yakob dhu tadèngi le, te ngaa na mau-mau, aa tao boe ngaa-ngaa. te lod'o èèna, ana mone na sèra, ètu d'ara pad'a madhenge badha rèngu. ka na mate si mai ku.

source_text: and chamor avi shechem went out unto ya'akov to speak with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, hemor, ama sikem, mai padhai lii dènge yakob, ho neo karèi dina hia sikem.

source_text: and the bnei ya'akov came from the sadeh when they heard it; and the anashim were grieved, and they were in wrath greatly, because he had wrought nevalah folly, disgrace, outrage against yisroel in lying with bat ya'akov; which thing ought not to be done.
target_text: ètu talora dua ra padhue-padhai era, ana-ana yakob lèpa nèti d'ara pad'a. ropa ra tadèngi sikem dhu tao pakarehe le ana hèni ra, ka d'ara ra pèd'a, ka ra nasa bia. ka ra peka, madha j'ara dhu sèmi ne'e ne, lèke boe ètu isra'el. de ji'i se sèmi boe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: and chamor spoke with them, saying, the nefesh of beni my son shechem longeth for your bat; now give her him as isha.
target_text: ka hemor pamako yakob, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a sikem d'èi tare'a-re'a ana èu dina. de ja'a manèngi d'ara èu, sèna ka mo'o la, paleo ana bhèni èu dènge ne.

source_text: so intermarry with us, and give your banot unto us, and take benoteinu our banot unto you.
target_text: ladhe mo'o ana-ana èdhi se paleo iisi-aanga ra. ana-ana mone nèti miu, madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni nèti ji'i. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana-ana mone ji'i madhèdi dènge ana-ana bhèni miu.

source_text: and ye shall dwell with us; and haaretz shall be before you; dwell and trade therein, and get you possessions therein.
target_text: sèna ka èdhi pea pa'oru pa'èci ètu d'ara rai ne'e. sad'i miu d'èi era mia èèna ka, mi pea la dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. mi d'aga, sèna ka abhu kakaja ètu ne'e.

source_text: and shechem said unto her av and unto her achim, let me find chen grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me i will give. ask me never so much mohar bride price, dowry and mattan gift, and i will pay according as ye shall say unto me; but give me the na'arah as isha.
target_text: hèia sikem peka dènge ama dina dènge a'a na sèra, peka na, miu se, sad'i manèngi ngaa, ja'a dhoka madhutu di. masi ka miu manèngi doi pamèu madha, dènge kab'ua pèri-pèri èèna ka, ja'a hia. sad'i mo'o ja'a leo dènge ana hèni miu.

source_text: and the bnei ya'akov answered shechem and chamor aviv in mirmar deceit and spoke because he had made dinah their achot tameh;
target_text: te ngaa ana-ana yakob se re'a le, sikem dhu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra dina. hèia ra karihu-kahadhu, ka ra bèle, peka mi sikem dènge ama na hemor,

source_text: and they said unto them, we cannot do this thing, to give achoteinu our sister to ish that is arelah uncircumcised; for that would be a cherpah reproach, disgrace unto us;
target_text: aku rèngu na, ji'i bisa boe hia ana hèni ji'i leo dènge dhèu dhu suna boe. te èèna na, era makae ji'i èèna!

source_text: but in this will we consent unto you: if ye will become like us, that every zachar of you be circumcised;
target_text: te ngaa j'ara na sèmi ne'e: miu se, hud'i sama ku sèmi ji'i, mone aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki, dhèu kapai, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: then will we give benoteinu unto you, and we will take your banot to us, and we will dwell among you, and we will become as am echad.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu j'ara ne'e, èdhi heka paleo kèna. aa ji'i pea ètu rai ne'e hèi, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but if ye will not pay heed unto us, to become circumcised; then will we take biteinu our daughter, and we will go.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i, aa mo'o boe suna, ji'i ngare hari ana hèni ji'i, ho kèd'i eele rai ne'e.

source_text: and their words pleased chamor, and shechem ben chamor.
target_text: hèia hemor dènge ana na sikem ro'o kahèi.

source_text: and the na'ar deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in bat ya'akov; and he was more respected than kol bais aviv.
target_text: te ngaa sikem no'o heka mate, lula d'ara na d'èi ae dina. dhèu isi rai ètu èèna pakab'ua sikem ne titu kèna.

source_text: and chamor and shechem bno came unto the sha'ar of their city, and they spoke with the anashim of their city, saying,
target_text: ka hemor dènge sikem lasi asa era pama'ète lii, ètu hèb'a tedhe rae èèna, hèia ra padhue lii ne dènge kabarai sèra. ra peka, aku rèngu na,

source_text: these anashim are shlemim peaceable with us; therefore let them settle in haaretz, and let them trade therein for haaretz, hinei, it is plenty of room for them; let us take their banot to us as nashim, and let us give them benoteinu.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhèu isra'el se, d'èi mamuri mera-milu dènge èdhi. de hud'i laa ta pea pa'èci dènge rèngu ètu dedha-rai ne'e. rai ne taleo, de èdhi bisa pea pa'èci aa'i-aa'i ti. èdhi se bisa leo dènge ana bhèni rèngu. aa rèngu bisa madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èdhi kahèi.

source_text: only herein will the anashim consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be am echad, if every zachar among us be circumcised, just as they are nimolim ones being circumcised.
target_text: lii manèngi rèngu dhoka èci di, nèti èdhi se. ra manèngi, èdhi mone se aa'i-aa'i hud'i suna ku, madhutu ad'a rèngu.

source_text: shall not their mikneh and their property and every behemah of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will settle among us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi se pab'ali le dènge rèngu, èèna na badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau ra j'aj'i unu èdhi. de be'a risi èdhi to'o la madhutu dad'èi ra. mai sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ti suna! mo'o, sina ma?

source_text: and unto chamor and unto shechem bno paid heed all that went out of the sha'ar of his city; and every zachar was circumcised, all that went out of the sha'ar of his city.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra sa, sèmi lii padhai lii hemor dènge ana na sikem. hèia dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ètu rai èèna suna palere-lere.

source_text: and it came to pass on the yom hashlishi, when they were in pain, that two of the bnei ya'akov, shim'on and levi, achei dinah, took each ish his cherev, and came upon the ir betach boldly, confidently, and they slaughtered kol zachar.
target_text: d'ara lod'o ka tèlu, ropa rèngu dhu suna se, nu'a ra dhu pèd'a era, ka ana mone dina, simeon dènge lewi, rare samala ra, kako mau-mau, lasi asa d'ara kota. ka dua ra pare pamadhe aa'i-aa'i dhèu mone sèra.

source_text: and they slaughtered chamor and shechem bno with the edge of the cherev, and took dinah from the bais shechem and left.
target_text: hemor dènge sikem, ra pare pamadhe kahèi. hèia ra rèti dènge ka dina nèti d'ara èmu sikem, lèpa èmu rèngu.

source_text: the bnei ya'akov came upon the chalalim dead ones, slain ones, and plundered the ir, because they had made their achot tameh.
target_text: aa ana yakob dhu cahag'e sèra, maso asa d'ara kota èèna, ra parama rèti aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èèna. ra nasa, lula dhèu tao pakarehe ana hèni ra ètu èèna.

source_text: they seized their tzon, and their bakar, and their chamorim, and that which was in the ir, and that which was in the sadeh,
target_text: ra parama rèti mèdha-panyau dhèu nèti d'ara èmu ra, dènge eo rèti badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara pad'a.

source_text: and all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their nashim they carried off and plundered even all that was in the bais.
target_text: rèti aa'i bhèni dènge ana-ana, aa parame rare aa'i mèdha dhu kab'ua nèti kabarai ne.

source_text: and ya'akov said to shim'on and levi, ye have brought trouble on me to make me a stench among the inhabitants of haaretz, among the kena'ani and the perizzi; and i being few in mispar, they shall gather themselves together against me, and attack me; and i shall be destroyed, i and my bais.
target_text: ropa yakob ne'a j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, na peka dènge simeon dènge lewi, miu dua mi se, goa ngaa ka ne'e? miu paj'èra ja'a! èèna na, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu peris dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu dedha rai ne'e, tèka d'ara dènge èdhi se. rèngu se, dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa èdhi se, dhèu ciki di. ladhe rèngu se mai age èdhi, na, ra palaho aa'i èdhi.

source_text: and they said, should he deal with achoteinu like with zonah?
target_text: te ngaa ana se dhaa dènge lii nasa, peka na, ama! ama pangee na hud'i laa ji'i soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao ana hèni ji'i ne, bhèni kajeo!

source_text: and elohim said unto ya'akov, arise, go up to beit-el, and settle there; and make there a mizbe'ach unto el g-d that appeared unto thee when thou didst flee from the face of esav achicha.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua padhai lii dènge yakob, peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu, lod'o èu rai nèti madha a'a mu esau. kèd'i, lamu dènge ka asa betel. ladhe d'ai nèi, mu patitu mei korban hia ja'a. aa pea dènge ka ètu èèna.

source_text: then ya'akov said unto his bais, and to all that were with him, put away the elohei hanekhar that are among you, and be tahor, and change your simlah garments; and let us arise, and go up to beit-el; and i will build there a mizbe'ach unto el g-d who answered me in my yom tzoros, and was with me in the derech in which i went.
target_text: ka yakob peka dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i, aku nèngu na, aa'i-aa'i ti lati dènge ka asa betel. uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ama lamatua ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu èèna. ja'a neo tao mei korban ètu nèi. de mi core eele mèdha sogo-tagu miu. aa mi pamèu iisi mi, ho mi gati mèdha-papake leo, te èdhi neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and they gave unto ya'akov kol elohei hanekhar which were in their yad, and all their nezamim which were in their oznayim; and ya'akov buried them under the elah terebinth which was at shechem.
target_text: ka ra oru mèdha sogo-tagu, dènge ate-ate ra aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia yakob dhènu mèdha se aa'i-aa'i ra ètu kapua aj'u aae ca kapua dhu padètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and they journeyed; and the chittat elohim terror of g-d was upon the cities that were around them, and they did not pursue after the bnei ya'akov.
target_text: ropa yakob dènge dhèu na aa'i-aa'i pakèd'i nèti sikem, ama lamatua hia d'ara madha'u mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu padètu dènge rae sikem, ka ra bani boe tao karehe mi yakob si.

source_text: so ya'akov came to luz, which is in eretz kena'an, that is, beit-el, he and kol haam that were with him.
target_text: ka yakob si d'ai dènge sod'a ètu betel dhu uru èèna, ngara na lus, ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and he built there a mizbe'ach, and called the makom place el beit-el; because there haelohim appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of achiv.
target_text: ètu ne'e, yakob pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban. ka na pangare era ne, el betel, sasoa na ‘betel unu ama lamatua', lula uru èèna ama lamatua pad'elo iisi mi yakob ètu era èèna, lod'o nèngu rai nèti madha a'a na.

source_text: but devorah meineket rivkah died, and she was buried under an alon oak below beit-el; and shmo was called alon bachut.
target_text: padètu dènge rae betel, abhu aj'u aae ca kapua, ngara na alon bakut. sasoa na ‘aj'u tangi dhèu madhe'. pake ngara ne, lod'o debora, ina dhu lalau-lalo'o ribka, madhe, ka padhane ètu karasa aj'u èèna.

source_text: and elohim appeared unto ya'akov again, when he returned from paddan-aram, and made a brocha upon him.
target_text: lod'o yakob lèpa nèti padan aram, ama lamatua pad'elo hari iisi na, ka hia na berkat.

source_text: and elohim said unto him, shimcha is ya'akov; shimcha shall not be called any more ya'akov, but yisroel shall be shemecha; and he called shmo yisroel.
target_text: hèia lamatua peka dènge ne, nèti deo ne'e ne, èu ngara heka yakob, te ngaa isra'el.

source_text: and elohim said unto him, i am el shaddai; be fruitful and multiply; a goy nation and a kehal goyim shall be from thee, and melechim shall come out of thy loins;
target_text: ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. de èu matana pa'ae-ae, aa ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, suku-suku mai nèti ana-èpu èu. aa nèti ana-èpu èu sèra, cèu dhèu aae-dhèu aae.

source_text: and haaretz which i gave avraham and yitzchak, to thee i will give it, and to thy zera after thee will i give haaretz.
target_text: rai dhu pangèd'u mi baki mu abraham, dènge ama mu isak, ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu.

source_text: and elohim went up from him in the makom where he talked with him. and ya'akov set up a matzevah pillar, monument in the makom where he talked with him, even a matzevat even pillar of stone; and he poured a nesech drink offering thereon, and he poured shemen oil thereon.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua peka nare, yakob patitu dènge hadhu ètu era èèna, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha ho na baku bhèlu eele lii lamatua. ka na bhori èi anggor dènge èi mènyi mi dedha hadhu na, hèia na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: and ya'akov called the shem of the makom where elohim spoke with him, beit-el.
target_text: era èèna, na pangare ‘betel'.

source_text: and they journeyed from beit-el; and there was still a space of ha'aretz to get to ephratah; and rachel travailed, and she had hard labor.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pakèd'i nèti betel. ropa rèngu kaj'èu èèna mèka nèti rae efrata nuka betlehem èèna, rahel dhu d'ai le lod'o nara iisi na. te ngaa nara iisi carui, hèia na roe titu kèna.

source_text: and it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the meyaledet midwife said unto her, fear not; thou shalt have this ben also.
target_text: ka ropa na pèngu stenga madhe, dhèu ai tadha peka dènge ne, pa'èra d'ara èu, te mora iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu! de baku paroe iisi.

source_text: and it came to pass, as her nefesh was in departing, for she died that she called shmo ben-oni son of affliction; but aviv called him binyamin.
target_text: lod'o rahel oe ma'ète a'ae, na pangare ana ne, ben-oni, dhu sasoa na ‘ana nèti j'aj'èra ja'a'. ka heka na madhe kèna. te ngaa yakob hia ana ne ngara benyamin, dhu sasoa na ‘ana ai g'ana'.

source_text: and rachel died, and was buried on the derech to ephratah, which is beit-lechem.
target_text: ka ra padhane rahel ètu sebhe j'ara dhu la'e asa efrata, dhu limuri ne, ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and ya'akov set up a matzevah upon her kever; that is matzevet kevurat rachel to this day.
target_text: hèia yakob pudhi lutu bhatu ètu ro'a dhèu èmu na èèna. d'ai sange ne'e, ro'a rahel ne era.

source_text: and yisroel journeyed, and pitched his ohel beyond migdal-eder.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob pea boe mi ca era sa. ca tèka, na patitu paleo ètu sebhe manara eder.

source_text: and it came to pass, when yisroel dwelt in that land, that reuven went and lay with bilhah pilegesh aviv and yisroel heard it. now the bnei ya'akov were sheneym asar twelve;
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu era èèna, ruben j'unu dènge bilha, dhèu èmu piara ama na. èèna ka, yakob ne'a j'ara ne'e kahèi. ana mone yakob, canguru dua dhèu.

source_text: the bnei leah: reuven bechor ya'akov, and shim'on, and levi, and yehudah, and yissakhar, and zevulun;
target_text: ana-ana nèti lea, nuka: ruben ana uuru yakob, simeon, lewi, yahuda, isaskar, dènge sebulon.

source_text: the bnei rachel: yosef, and binyamin;
target_text: ana-ana rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and the bnei bilhah shifchat rachel: dan, and naphtali;
target_text: ana-ana nèti bilha, ènu rahel: dan dènge naftali.

source_text: and the bnei zilpah shifchat leah: gad, and asher; these are the bnei ya'akov, which were born to him in paddan-aram.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti silpa, ènu lea, nuka: gad dènge aser. rara iisi ana se ètu padan aram.

source_text: and ya'akov came unto yitzchak aviv unto mamre, unto kiriat-haarba, which is chevron, where avraham and yitzchak sojourned.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob la'e ngad'o ama na isak asa mamre, dhu dètu dènge kiryat-arba dhu limuri ne, ngara na hebron. uru èèna, baki na abraham pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of yitzchak were me'at shanah u'shemonim shanah. and yitzchak expired, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being zaken old and full of yamim; and his banim esav and ya'akov buried him.
target_text: umur isak d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna. ka ana na esau dènge yakob padhane ne.

source_text: now these are the toldot esav, who is edom.
target_text: ne'e ne, ana-èpu esau. ngara esau dhu leo, edom.

source_text: esav took his nashim of the banot kena'an: adah bat elon the chitti, and oholivamah bat anah bat tziveon the chivi;
target_text: esau leo dènge ana bhèni kana'an dhèu dua. èci dhèu het, ana bhèni nèti elon, ngara na ada. dhèu èmu na èci hari, dhèu hewi, ngara na oholibama. ama na, ngara na anah, aa baki na sibeon.

source_text: and basmat bat yishmael, achot nevayot.
target_text: esau leo kahèi dènge ana ismael, ngara na basmat. ana mone basmat, ngara na nebayot.

source_text: and adah bore to esav eliphaz; and basmat bore reuel;
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu uuru esau, nara iisi elifas. basmat matana rahuel.

source_text: and oholivamah bore ye'ush, and ya'alam, and korach; these are the bnei esav, which were born unto him in eretz kena'an.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: and esav took his nashim, and his banim, and his banot, and kol nafshot of his bais, and his mikneh, and all his behemah, and all his possessions, which he had acquired in eretz kena'an; and went into the eretz from the face of ya'akov achiv.
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: for their wealth was more than that they might dwell together; and the eretz of their sojourns could not support them because of their mikneh.
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: thus dwelt esav in har se'ir; esav is edom.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: and these are the toldot esav avi edom in har se'ir:
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these are the shemot bnei esav; eliphaz ben adah eshet esav, reuel ben basmat eshet esav. and the bnei eliphaz were teman, omar, tzepho, and gatam, and kenaz. and timna was pilegesh concubine to eliphaz ben esav; and she bore to eliphaz amalek; these were the bnei adah eshet esav. and these are the bnei reuel: nachat, and zerach, shammah, and mizzah; these were the bnei basmat eshet esav.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: and these were the bnei oholivamah bat anah bat tziveon, eshet esav: and she bore to esav ye'ush, and ya'alam, and korach.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these were alufei chiefs of the bnei esav: the bnei eliphaz the bechor esav; aluf chief teman, aluf omar, aluf tzepho, aluf kenaz, aluf chief korach, aluf chief gatam, and aluf chief amalek; these are the alufei eliphaz in eretz edom; these were the bnei adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: and these are the bnei reuel ben esav: aluf chief nachat, aluf zerach, aluf shammah, aluf mizzah; these are the alufei reuel in eretz edom; these are the bnei basmat eshet esav.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: and these are the bnei oholivamah eshet esav: aluf chief ye'ush, aluf ya'alam, aluf korach; these were the alufei oholivamah bat anah eshet esav.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: these are the bnei esav, who is edom, and these are their alufim chiefs.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these are the bnei se'ir the chori, who inhabited haaretz: lotan, and shoval, and tziveon, and anah, and dishon, and etzer, and dishan; these are the alufei hachori, the bnei se'ir in eretz edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: and the bnei lotan were chori and hemam; and achot lotan was timna.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: and the bnei shoval were these: alvan, and manachat, and eival, shepho, and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: and these are the bnei tziveon: both ayah, and anah; this was that anah that found the hot springs in the midbar, as he pastured the chamorim of tziveon aviv.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: and the bnei anah were these: dishon, and oholivamah bat anah. and these are the bnei dishon: chemdan, and eshban, and yitran, and keran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: the bnei etzer are these: bilhan, and za'avan, and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: the bnei dishan are these: utz, and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these are the alufei chiefs hachori: aluf chief lotan, aluf shoval, aluf tziveon, aluf anah, aluf dishon, aluf etzer, aluf chief dishan; these are the alufei hachori by their alufim chiefs in eretz se'ir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: and these are the melechim that reigned in eretz edom, before there reigned any melech over the bnei yisroel.
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: and bela ben be'or reigned in edom; and the shem of his city was dinhavah.
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: and bela died, and yovav ben zerach of botzrah reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: and yovav died, and chusham of eretz temani reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: and chusham died, and hadad ben bedad, who defeated midyan in the sadeh of moav, reigned in his place; and the shem of his city was avit.
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: and hadad died, and samlah of masrekah reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: and samlah died, and sha'ul of rechovot-nahar reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: and sha'ul died, and ba'al-chanan ben achbor reigned in his place.
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: and ba'al-chanan ben achbor died, and hadar reigned in his place; and the shem of his city was pau; and the shem of his isha was mehetavel bat matred bat mei-zahav.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: and these are the shemot of the alufei esav, according to their mishpechot, after their mekomot, by their shemot: aluf chief timna, aluf chief alvah, aluf chief yetet, aluf oholivamah, aluf chief elah, aluf chief pinon, aluf chief kenaz, aluf chief teman, aluf chief mivtzar, aluf chief magdiel, aluf chief iram; these are the alufei edom, according to their moshavot in the eretz of their achuzzah; this is esav avi edom.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: and ya'akov dwelt in the eretz megurei aviv in the land wherein his father was a ger in eretz kena'an.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: these are the toldot ya'akov. yosef, being seventeen years old, was ro'eh with his achim to the tzon; now the na'ar was with the bnei bilhah, and with the bnei zilpah, the ne'shei aviv the wives of his father; and yosef brought unto avihem their father dibbatam ra'ah a bad, evil report of them.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: now yisroel loved yosef more than all his children, because he was the ben zekunim the son of his old age; and he made him a kesones passim ketonet tunic reaching to palms and soles.
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: and when his achim saw that avihem loved him more than all his achim, they hated him, and could not speak with shalom unto him.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: and yosef dreamed a chalom dream, and he told it to his achim; and they hated him yet the more. and he said unto them, hear, now, this chalom which i have dreamed: for, hinei, we were binding alummim sheaves of wheat out in the sadeh, and, hinei, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, hinei, your alummot sheaves of wheat gathered around it, and bowed down to my sheaf.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: and his achim said to him, shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? and they hated him yet the more for his chalomot dreams, and for his devarim.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: and he dreamed yet another chalom, and told it his achim, and said, hinei, i have dreamed a chalom more; and, hinei, the shemesh and the yarei'ach and the eleven kokhavim bowed down to me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: and he told it to aviv, and to his achim: and aviv rebuked him, and said unto him, what is this chalom that thou hast dreamed? shall i and immecha and achecha indeed come to bow down ourselves to the ground before thee?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: and his achim had kina jealousy, envy toward him; but aviv was shomer over the saying.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: and his achim went for the purpose to be ro'eh tzon avihem in the vicinity of shechem.
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: and yisroel said unto yosef, do not thy achim ro'im in shechem? come and i will send thee unto them. and he said to him, hineni.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: and he said to him, go, now, see about the shalom achecha, and the shalom hatzon; and bring me devar. so he sent him out of the emek chevron, and he went to shechem.
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: and a certain ish found him, and, hinei, he was wandering in the sadeh; and the ish asked him, saying, what seekest thou?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: and he said, i seek my achim; tell me, now, where they ro'im feed their flocks.
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: and the ish said, they are departed from here; for i heard them say, let us go to dotan. and yosef went after his achim, and found them in dotan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: and when they saw him merachok afar off, in the distance, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to kill him.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they said one to another, hinei, this ba'al hachalomot cometh.
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: come now therefore, and let us kill him, and throw him into one of the borot pits, and we will say, some chayyah ra'ah evil wild beast hath devoured him; and we shall see what will become of his chalomot.
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: and reuven heard it, and he saved him out of their yadayim; and said, let us not take his nefesh.
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: and reuven said unto them, do no shefach dahm shedding of blood, but throw him into this bor that is in the midbar, and lay no yad upon him; that he might rescue him out of their yadayim, to take him back to aviv.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: and it came to pass, when yosef was come unto his achim, that they stripped yosef of his kesones, his kesones hapassim that was on him;
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: and they took him, and threw him into the borah pit; and the bor was empty, there was no mayim in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: and they sat down to eat lechem; and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, hinei, a caravan of yishm'elim was coming from gil'ad with their gemalim bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to mitzrayim.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: and yehudah said unto his achim, what betza profit, gain is it if we kill achinu our brother, and conceal his dahm?
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: come, and let us sell him to the yishm'elim, and let not yadeinu our hands be upon him; for he is achinu our brother and besareinu our flesh. and his achim agreed.

target_text: ropa dhèu èmu na nare d'ara èmu, na lolo peka na, a'a! dhèu ibrani dhu mèti mai sa èmu ne'e, deo na maso asa d'ara kama ja'a, neo pakarehe ja'a!

source_text: and it came to pass, as i lifted up my voice and screamed, that he left his beged with me, and fled outside.
target_text: malo ka ja'a pa'oo, paroa ana sab'a se'e. hèia na rai tèke eele kodho na, ka ne'e.

source_text: and it came to pass, when adonav heard the words of his isha, which she spoke unto him, saying, after this manner did thy eved to me; that his wrath was kindled.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu èmu na, potifar nasa bia.

source_text: and adonei yosef took him, and put him into the bais hasohar, a place where the asirei hamelech were prisoners; and he was there in the bais hasohar.
target_text: hèia na paredha ka dhèu lasi kèpe yusuf. ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho dhèu aae.

source_text: but hashem was with yosef, and showed him chesed, and gave him chen in the eyes of the sar bais hasohar.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua bhèlu boe yusuf. nèti èèna ka, lamatua ladhe-leru ne taruu, ka kapala ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, sue yusuf ae titu kèna.

source_text: and the sar bais hasohar entrusted to the yad yosef all the asirim prisoners that were in the bais hasohar; and whatsoever they did there, he was the accomplisher of it.
target_text: na lèka yusuf, ka hia ne j'aj'i madho ho laladhe ana bèdho sèra aa'i-aa'i ra. aa, hia na lalau sasab'a ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the sar bais hasohar looked not to anything that was under his yosefʼs yad; because hashem was with him, and that which he did, hashem made it to prosper.
target_text: lula lèka ne, ka kapala èmu bèdho na, tao heka ai-hèb'a mi ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho èèna. lamatua ladhe-leru taruu yusuf, nèti èèna ka, sasab'a ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho na kako dènge be'a.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that the mashkeh cupbearer melech mitzrayim and his ofeh baker had offended adoneihem melech mitzrayim. and pharaoh was in wrath against two of his sarisim, against the sar hamashkim, and against the sar ha'ofim. and he put them b'mishmar under watch, in custody in the bais sar hatabachim house of the captain of the bodyguards, in the bais hasohar, in the makom place where yosef was incarcerated.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu dua, dhu uru na j'aj'i kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae masir. èci lalau dhua èi dhèu aae. aa èci hari lalau roti dhèu aae. dua ra tao pasala dhèu aae. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aae nasa, ka na pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. dua ra pea ètu era èci dènge yusuf.

source_text: and the sar hatabachim charged yosef with them, and he ministered to them; and they continued a season b'mishmar in custody, under watch.
target_text: kapala èmu bèdho na, paredha yusuf lalau dhèu dua se'e. ra ètu d'ara bèdho na, ele boe ca tèu do dua tèu le.

source_text: and they dreamed a chalom both of them, each man his chalom in lailah echad in one night, the same night, and each chalom with its own pitron meaning, interpretation, the mashkeh and the ofeh of melech mitzrayim, which were prisoners in the bais hasohar.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, dua ra nii. ca dhèu ka dènge nii na. aa, lii nii dua sèra, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: and yosef came in unto them in the boker, and looked upon them, and, hinei, they were zo'afim troubled ones, sad ones.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yusuf ladhe na dua ra rèhu susa.

source_text: and he asked the sarisim of pharaoh that were with him b'mishmar in the custody ward of bais adonav, saying, why look ye so ra'im bad, downcast ones hayom today?
target_text: ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka mad'ae ne'e, miu dua mi roe-roe?

source_text: and they said unto him, we have dreamed a chalom, and there is no poter interpreter of it. and yosef said unto them, do not pitronim interpretations belong to elohim? tell now to me.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the sar hamashkim told his chalom to yosef, and said to him, in my chalom, hinei, a gefen was before me;
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: and in the gefen were shloshah sarigim three branches; and it was as soon as it budded, its blossom shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth anavim ripe grapes;
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: and the kos pharaoh was in my yad; and i took the anavim grapes, and pressed them into kos pharaoh, and i put the kos into the palm of pharaoh.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: and yosef said unto him, this is the pitron interpretation of it; the shloshet hasarigim are shloshet yamim.
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: within shloshet yamim shall pharaoh lift up thine rosh, and restore thee unto thy ken place, post; and thou shalt deliver kos pharaoh into his yad, after the mishpat harishon former practice when thou wast his mashkeh.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.

source_text: but remember me when it shall be well with thee, and show chesed now unto me, and make mention of me unto pharaoh, and bring me out of this bais;
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for indeed i was stolen away out of the eretz haivrim; and here also have i done nothing that they should put me into the bor dungeon.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: when the sar ha'ofim saw that he had done the pitron well, he said unto yosef, i also was in my chalom, and, hinei, i had shloshah salei chori three baskets of cakes on my rosh;
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: and in the sal haelyon uppermost basket there was all manner of food for pharaoh; and ha'oph the birds did eat them out of the sal basket upon my rosh.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: and yosef answered and said, this is the pitron interpretation, meaning thereof: the shloshet hasalim three baskets are shloshet yamim.
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: yet within shloshet yamim shall pharaoh lift off thy rosh from on thee, and shall hang thee on an etz; and ha'oph the birds shall eat thy basar from off thee.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: and it came to pass on yom hashlishi, which was the yom huledet of pharaoh, that he made a mishteh feast unto all his avadim; and he lifted up the rosh sar hamashkim and the rosh sar ha'ofim head of the chief baker in the midst of his avadim officials.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: he restored the sar hamashkim unto his mashkeh; and he gave the kos into the palm of pharaoh;
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: but he hanged the sar ha'ofim: just as yosef had made the pitron to them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: yet did not the sar hamashkim remember yosef but forgot him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: and it came to pass at the end of two full years, that pharaoh dreamed a chalom: and, hinei, he stood by haye'or the river, i. e. , the nile.
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and, hinei, there came up out of haye'or the river, i. e. , the nile seven cows, fine in appearance and fat in basar; and they grazed on the riverbank.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and, hinei, seven other cows came up after them out of the nile, ra'ot mareh ugly in appearance and dakot basar gaunt ones in flesh, lean-fleshed; and stood by the other cows upon the bank of the nile.
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and the cows that were ra'ot hamareh and that were dakot habasar did devour the seven cows that were fine in appearance and fat. then pharaoh awoke.
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: and he slept and dreamed a chalom the second time; and, hinei, sheva heads of grain came up upon one stalk, beri'ot fat ones and tovot.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: and, hinei, seven thin heads of grain scorched by the east wind tzomechot sprung up after them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: and the seven thin heads of grain devoured the seven fat and mele'ot full heads of grain. and pharaoh awoke; and, hinei, it was a chalom!
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: and it came to pass in the boker that his ruach was troubled; and he sent and called for all the chartummei mitzrayim magicians of egypt, and all the chachamim thereof; and pharaoh told them his chalom; but there was no poter interpreter for pharaoh.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then the sar hamashkim spoke unto pharaoh, saying, i do remember my faults this day.
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: pharaoh was in wrath with his avadim, and put me b'mishmar in custody in the bais sar hatabbachim, both me and the sar ha'ofim;
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: and we dreamed a chalom in the same lailah, i and he; and each chalom we dreamed had its own pitron interpretation.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: and there was there with us a na'ar ivri, eved to the sar hatabbachim; and we told him, and he interpreted to us chalomoteinu our dreams; to each according to his chalom he did interpret.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: and it was, just as he interpreted to us, so it came to pass; me he restored unto mine ken post, and him he hanged.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: then pharaoh sent and summoned yosef, and they brought him hastily out of the bor dungeon; and he shaved, and changed his clothes, and came in unto pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, i have dreamed a chalom, and there is no poter interpreter for it; and i have heard it said of thee, that thou canst understand a chalom to interpret it.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: and yosef answered pharaoh, saying, it is not in me; elohim shall give pharaoh an answer of shalom.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, in my chalom, hineni, i stood upon the bank of the nile;
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and, hinei, there came up out of the nile seven cows beri'ot basar fat in body and sleek of form; and they grazed by the riverbank.
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and, hinei, seven other cows came up after them, dalot poor, scrawny, thin and ra'ot to'ar me'od very ugly in appearance and lean-fleshed, such as i never saw in kol eretz mitzrayim, unacceptably bad;
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and the lean and the ra'ot cows did eat up the first seven fat cows;
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still rah in appearance, as at the beginning. so i awoke.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: and i saw in my chalom, and, hinei, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, mele'ot full and tovot good;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: and, hinei, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and scorched with the east wind, tzomechot sprung up after them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: and the thin heads of grain devoured the seven tov heads of grain; and i told this unto the chartummim magicians; but there was none that could explain it to me.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: and yosef said unto pharaoh, the chalom of pharaoh is echad: haelohim hath revealed to pharaoh what he is about to do.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven good cows are seven shanim; and the seven good heads of grain are seven shanim. the chalom is echad.
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: and the seven lean and ugly cows that came up after them are sheva shanim; and the seven empty heads of grain scorched by the east wind are sheva shnei ra'av seven years of famine.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: this is the thing which i have spoken unto pharaoh; what haelohim is about to do he showeth unto pharaoh.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: hinei, there come sheva shanim of sava gadol great fullness, plenty, abundance throughout kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: and there shall arise after them sheva shnei ra'av seven years of famine and kol hasava all abundance shall be forgotten in eretz mitzrayim; and the ra'av famine shall consume the land; and the sava shall not be known in the land by reason of that ra'av famine following; for it shall be kaved me'od very grievous.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: and for that the chalom was doubled unto pharaoh; it is because the thing is decidedly established by haelohim, and haelohim will shortly bring it to pass.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: now therefore let pharaoh select an ish navon and chochom a man discerning and wise and set him over eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: let pharaoh do this, and let him appoint pekidim officers, overseers, commissioners over the land, and take up the fifth part of the harvest of eretz mitzrayim in the sheva shnei hasava.
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: and let them gather kol ochel of those shanim hatovot that come, and store up grain under the yad pharaoh, and let them be shomer over ochel in the cities.
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: and that ochel shall be for reserves for the land against the sheva shnei hara'av, which shall be in eretz mitzrayim; that the land perish not through the ra'av.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: and the thing was good in the eyes of pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his avadim.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto his avadim, can we find such an ish as this is, an ish in whom is the ruach elohim?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, forasmuch as elohim hath showed thee all this, there is none so navon discerning and chochom wise as thou art;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: thou shalt be over my bais palace, and according unto thy mouth shall all my people order themselves; only with respect to the kisse will i be greater than thou.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, see, i have set thee over kol eretz mitzrayim. and pharaoh took off his taba'at signet ring from his yad, and put it upon yad yosef, and arrayed him in garments of fine linen, and put a chain of zahav around his neck;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: and he made him to ride in the second merkavah which he had; and they cried before him, avrech! and he put him over kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, i am pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his yad or regel in kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and pharaoh called shem yosef tzaphnat pa'neach; and he gave him as isha asenat bat poti phera kohen of on. and yosef went out over all eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: and yosef was thirty years old when he stood before pharaoh melech mitzrayim. and yosef went out from the presence of pharaoh, and went throughout kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: and in the sheva shnei hasava the land brought forth by handfuls.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and he gathered up kol ochel of the sheva shanim, which were in eretz mitzrayim, and laid up the ochel in the cities; the ochel of the sadeh, which surrounded every city, laid he up in the same.
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: and yosef gathered grain as the chol sand of the yam, very much, until he stopped counting; for it was without mispar number.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: and unto yosef were born two banim before the shnat ra'av came, which asenat bat poti phera kohen of on bore unto him.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and yosef called the shem of the bechor menasheh: for elohim, said he nashani, hath made me forget all my amal, and kol bais avi.
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and the shem of the second called he ephrayim: for elohim hifrani hath caused me to be fruitful in the eretz of my oni suffering.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: and the sheva shnei hasava that was in eretz mitzrayim were ended.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: and the sheva shnei hara'av began to come, just as yosef had said; and the ra'av was in all lands; but in kol eretz mitzrayim there was lechem.
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: and when kol eretz mitzrayim was famished, the people cried to pharaoh for lechem; and pharaoh said unto kol mitzrayim, go unto yosef; what he saith to you, do.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: and the ra'av famine was over kol pnei ha'aretz; and yosef opened all that was in them, and sold unto the mitzrayim; and the ra'av famine became severe in eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and kol haaretz all the world came into mitzrayim to yosef to buy grain; because that the ra'av famine was so chazak in kol haaretz.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: now when ya'akov saw that there was shever grain in mitzrayim, ya'akov said unto his banim, why do ye look one upon another?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: and he said, hinei, i have heard that there is shever grain in mitzrayim; get you down to there, and buy for us from there; that we may live, and not die.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: achei yosef asarah yosefʼs ten brothers then went down to buy grain in mitzrayim.
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: but binyamin, achi yosef, ya'akov sent not with his achim; for he said, lest ason evil, harm befall him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and the bnei yisroel came to make purchase among those that were coming; for the ra'av famine was in eretz kena'an.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: and yosef was the shalit al haaretz, and he it was that sold to kol am haaretz: and achei yosef came, and prostrated themselves before him with their faces to the ground.
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and yosef saw his achim, and he recognized them, but made himself a stranger unto them, and spoke roughly unto them; and he said unto them, from where come ye? and they said, from eretz kena'an to buy ochel. and yosef recognized his achim, but they recognized not him.
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: and yosef remembered the chalomot which he dreamed about them, and said unto them, ye are meragelim spies; to see the ervat ha'aretz nakedness of the land ye came.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: and they said unto him, lo, adoni, but to buy okhel are thy avadim come.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: we are all bnei ish echad; we are truthful ones, thy avadim are no meragelim.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: and he said unto them, lo, but to see the ervat ha'aretz ye came.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: and they said, thy avadim are shneym asar achim, the bnei ish echad in eretz kena'an; and, hinei, the katon is today with avinu, and one is not.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: and yosef said unto them, that is it just as i spoke unto you, ye are meragelim;
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: hereby ye shall be tested: by the life of pharaoh ye shall not go forth from here, except achichem hakaton your youngest brother come here.
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send one of you, and let him bring back achichem, and ye shall be kept prisoner, that your words may be tested, whether there be any emes in you; or else by the life of pharaoh surely ye are meragelim spies.
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: and he put them all together el-mishmar in custody shloshet yamim.
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: and yosef said unto them on the yom hashlishi, this do, and live; for i fear haelohim:
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if ye be truthful ones, let one of your achim be bound in your bais mishmar; go ye, carry grain for the ra'avon famine of bateichem your house;
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: but bring achichem hakaton unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. and they did so.
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they said one to another, surely we are ashemim guilty ones because of achinu our brother, in that we saw the tzoros of his nefesh, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this tzoros come upon us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: and reuven answered them, saying, spoke i not unto you, saying, do not sin against the yeled; and ye would not hear? therefore, hinei, the accounting for his dahm is required of us.
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: and they had no da'as that yosef understood them; for he spoke unto them by the melitz go-between, interpreter.
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and he turned himself away from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and spoke with them, and took from them shim'on, and bound him before their eyes.
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: then yosef commanded to fill their kelim with grain, and to restore every manʼs kesef into his sack, and to give them provision for the derech; and thus did he unto them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: and they loaded their chamorim with the grain, and departed from there.
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and as one of them opened his sack to get feed for his chamor in the malon inn, he saw his kesef; for, hinei, it was in the mouth of his sack.
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

source_text: and he said unto his achim, my kesef is restored; and, hinei, it is even in my sack; and their lev failed them, and they shook with fear, saying one to another, what is this that elohim hath done unto us?
target_text: capa na cag'ag'a! hèia na paroa a'a na si, peka na, irii! miu mai ladhe ku laa! madhe èdhi kèna. ra tao hari doi ja'a asa d'ara karo ne. ladhe rèdhi èèna ka, ra ele ngangee, aa madha'u bia. ka ra papeka ka, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua tao èdhi samia ka ne?

source_text: and they came unto ya'akov avihem in eretz kena'an, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
target_text: hèia ra kako taruu ka, lasi d'ai kana'an. d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, ngaa dhu rèngu paraga ètu rai masir.

source_text: the ish, who is adonei haaretz, spoke roughly to us, and took us for meragelim haaretz.
target_text: ra lolo, peka na, ama, ee! ai g'ana dhèu aae masir èèna, bhelu titu kèna. na jèka taruu ji'i. na peka na ji'i la'a j'aj'i mata-mata ho neo pa'ele iie rai masir.

source_text: and we said unto him, we are truthful ones; we are no meragelim;
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa, peka na, ‘aad'o! ji'i se'e padhai lii mola-mola. ji'i mata-mata boe.

source_text: we are shneym asar achim, bnei avinu; one is not, and the katon is today with avinu in eretz kena'an.
target_text: ji'i se'e, dhèu be'a-be'a. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi, j'aj'i nèti ca ama, dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa èci madhe le. aa ari dhu limuri èèna, dènge ama ji'i ètu kana'an. '

source_text: and the ish, adonei haaretz, said unto us, hereby shall i know that ye are truthful ones; leave one of your achim here with me, and that which is needful for the ra'avon bateichem famine of your houses, take and be gone;
target_text: na peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo kèdhi, na, miu se'e dhèu be'a, do aad'o! miu èci, pea mi ne'e. aa leo lèpa mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, sèna ka ra baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and bring achichem hakaton unto me; then shall i know that ye are not meragelim, but that ye are truthful ones: so will i restore you achichem, and ye shall freely trade in the land.
target_text: hud'i miu mèti ku ari miu èèna mai sa ne'e, heka ja'a ke'a kèna, tare'a-re'a miu se'e dhèu be'a, mata-mata boe. èèna na, heka ja'a patabuli dhèu miu dhu ja'a taha ne. aa dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a heka ko'o kèna, miu kako palème dedha rai ne'e. '

source_text: and it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, hinei, every manʼs pouch of kesef was in his sack; and when both they and avihem saw the pouches of kesef, they were afraid.
target_text: lolo èle hèia, heka ra bhoke karo-karo rèngu dhu pènu dènge are sèra. te ngaa ra cag'ag'a ladhe la'a na doi rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu hèb'a karo. rèdhi sèmi èèna, yakob dènge ana-ana na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and ya'akov avihem said unto them, me have ye bereaved of my children; yosef is not, and shim'on is not, and ye will take binyamin away; all these things are against me.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge si, peka na, miu se, pa'ele le ana-ana ja'a. yusuf aad'o heka. sèmi èèna kahèi, simeon. ne'e miu neo mèti hari benyamin kèna? miu se'e, tare'a-re'a neo paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and reuven spoke unto aviv, saying, slay my two banim, if i bring him not to thee; entrust him into my yad, and i will bring him to thee again.
target_text: hèia ruben peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! pangèd'u laa benyamin asa ja'a mai. ja'a tago kore. ja'a jaji kèna mi ama ku, èèna ja'a kèti hari na mai. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na ja'a hia ana ja'a, mone dhèu dua sèra ho ama pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: and he said, beni my son shall not go down with you; for achiv is dead, and he is left alone; if ason harm, evil befall him on the derech in which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hair in yagon sorrow to sheol.
target_text: te ngaa yakob dhaa hari, peka na, bisa boe! miu bisa boe mèti benyamin. te a'a na yusuf, madhe le. ne'e, di nèngu ka mesa na. ladhe na abhu calaka ètu j'ara, miu tabha babia mi ja'a, toke madhe kèti.

source_text: and the ra'av famine was kaved heavy, severe in the land.
target_text: tèu èèna, ètu rai kana'an asa tabha manganga.

source_text: and it came to pass, when they had eaten up the shever grain which they had brought out of mitzrayim, then avihem said unto them, shuvu return! buy for us a little ochel.
target_text: isi èmu yakob ra'a aa'i le nganga'a dhu ca hari na, ana na si lasi hèli ètu masir. ka na padhai lii dènge ana na si, be'a risi lami hari hèli nganga'a asa rai masir.

source_text: and yehudah spoke unto him, saying, the ish did solemnly warn us, saying, ye shall not see my face, unless achichem be with you.

source_text: and he said, shalom lachem, fear not; eloheichem, and elohei avichem, hath given you matmon treasure in your sacks; i had your kesef. and he brought shim'on out unto them.
