source_text: and the one went out from me, and i said, surely he is torn to pieces; and i saw him not ad-hennah until now;
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: and if ye take this also from me, and ason evil, harm befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hair in ra'ah misery to sheol.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: now therefore when i come to thy eved avi, and the na'ar be not with us; seeing that his nefesh is bound up in the nefesh of the na'ar; it shall come to pass, when he seeth that the na'ar is not with us, that he will die; and thy avadim shall bring down the gray hair of thy eved avinu with yagon sorrow to sheol,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: for thy eved became surety for the na'ar unto avi, saying, if i bring him not unto thee, then i shall bear the blame before avi kol hayamim.
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: therefore, let thy eved, now, abide instead of the na'ar, an eved to adoni; and let the na'ar go up with his achim.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for how shall i go up to avi, and the na'ar be not with me? lest i see the rah that would overtake avi.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: then yosef could not control himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, cause kol ish to go out from me. and there stood no ish with him, while yosef made himself known unto his achim.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and he wept aloud; and the mitzrayim and the bais pharaoh heard.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim brethren, i am yosef; doth avi yet live? and his achim could not answer him; for they were shocked with dismay at his presence.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim, come near to me, now. and they came near. and he said, i am yosef achichem your brother, whom ye sold into mitzrayim.
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me here; for elohim did send me before you to save life.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for these two years hath the ra'av famine been in the land; and yet there are chamesh shanim five years, in the which there shall neither be plowing nor harvest.
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: and elohim sent me before you to save you a she'erit remnant in the earth, and to save life for you by a peletah gedolah great deliverance, escape.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: so now it was not you that sent me here, but haelohim; and he hath made me as an av to pharaoh, and adon of all his bais, and moshel throughout kol eretz mitzrayim.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: haste ye, and go up to avi, and say unto him, thus saith thy ben, yosef, elohim hath made me as adon kol mitzrayim; come down unto me, tarry not;
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: and thou shalt dwell in eretz goshen, and thou shalt be karov near unto me, thou, and thy banim, and thy bnei banecha, and thy tzon, and thy bakar, and all that thou hast:
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there will i nourish thee; for yet there are chamesh shanim of ra'av famine; lest thou, and thy bais, and all that thou hast, come to destitution.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: and, hinei, your eyes see, and the eyes of achi binyamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: and ye shall tell avi of kol my kavod b'mitzrayim, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down avi here.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and he fell upon the neck of binyamin achiv, and wept; and binyamin wept upon his neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: moreover he kissed all his achim, and wept upon them; and after that his achim talked with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and the news thereof was heard in bais pharaoh saying, achei yosef are come; and it pleased pharaoh well, and his avadim.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto yosef, say unto thy achim, this do ye; load your beasts, and go, get you unto eretz kena'an;
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and take avichem and your households, and come unto me; and i will give you the best of eretz mitzrayim, ye shall eat the chelev haaretz.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you agalot wagons out of eretz mitzrayim for your little ones, and for your nashim, and bring avichem, and come.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: also regard not your kelim; for the best of kol eretz mitzrayim is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the bnei yisroel did so; and yosef gave them agalot, according to the commandment of pharaoh, and gave them provision for the derech.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: to all of them he gave each man chalifot semalot; but to binyamin he gave three hundred pieces of kesef, and chamesh chalifot semalot.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and to aviv he sent after this manner; ten chamorim loaded with the best of mitzrayim, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and lechem and provision for aviv for the derech.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: so he sent his achim away, and they departed; and he said unto them, see that ye not quarrel by the derech.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: and they went up out of mitzrayim, and came into eretz kena'an unto ya'akov avihem,
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and told him, saying, yosef chai! yosef is yet alive, and he is moshel kol eretz mitzrayim. and ya'akovʼs lev fainted, for he believed them not.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they told him kol divrei yosef, which he had said unto them; and when he saw the agalot which yosef had sent to carry him, the ruach ya'akov avihem revived;
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and yisroel said, it is enough; yosef beni chai! yosef beni is yet alive; i will go and see him before i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and yisroel took his journey with all that he had, and came to be'er-sheva, and offered zevakhim unto elohei aviv yitzchak.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and elohim spoke unto yisroel in the marot halailah, and said, ya'akov, ya'akov. and he said, hineni.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: and he said, i am el elohei avicha; fear not to go down to mitzrayim; for there i will make thee a goy gadol;
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i will go down with thee to mitzrayim; and i will also surely bring thee up again; and yosef shall put his yad upon thine eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: and ya'akov rose up from be'er-sheva; and the bnei yisroel carried ya'akov avihem, and their little ones, and their nashim, in the agalot which pharaoh had sent to carry him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they took their mikneh, and their possessions, which they had acquired in eretz kena'an, and came to mitzrayim, ya'akov, and all his zera with him; his banim, and his bnei banim with him, his banot, and his banot banim, and all his zera brought he with him to mitzrayim.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the shemot bnei yisroel, which came to mitzrayim: ya'akov and his banim: reuven, bechor ya'akov;
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and the bnei reuven: chanokh, and pallu, and chetzron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and the bnei shim'on: yemuel, and yamin, and ohad, and yachin, and tzochar, and sha'ul ben hakena'ani.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: and the bnei levi: gershon, kohat, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: and the bnei yehudah: er, and onan, and shelah, and peretz, and zerach; but er and onan died in eretz kena'an. and the bnei peretz were chetzron and chamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: and the bnei yissakhar: tola, and puvah, and yov, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: and the bnei zevulun: sered, elon, and yachle'el.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these are the bnei leah, which she bore unto ya'akov in paddan-aram, with his bat dinah; kol nefesh of his banim and his banot were thirty and three.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: and the bnei gad: tziphyon, chaggi, shuni, etzbon, eri, arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: and the bnei asher: yimnah, and yishvah, and yishvi, and beri'ah, and serach their achot; and the bnei beri'ah: chever, and malki'el.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are the bnei zilpah, whom lavan gave to leah his bat, and these she bore unto ya'akov, even sixteen nefesh.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the bnei rachel eshet ya'akov: yosef, and binyamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and unto yosef in eretz mitzrayim were born menasheh and ephrayim, which asenat bat poti phera kohen of on bore unto him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and the bnei binyamin were bela, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and na'aman, echi, and rosh, muppim, and chuppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these are the bnei rachel, which were born to ya'akov; kol nefesh were fourteen.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: and the bnei dan: chushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: and the bnei naphtali: yachtze'el, and guni, and yetzer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these are the bnei bilhah, which lavan gave unto rachel his bat, and she bore these unto ya'akov; kol nefesh were shivah.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: kol hanefesh that came with ya'akov to mitzrayim, which came out of his loins, apart from the nashim of the bnei ya'akov, kol nefesh were threescore and six;
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: and the bnei yosef, which were born to him in mitzrayim, were two nefesh; kol hanefesh of bais ya'akov, which came into mitzrayim, were shivim seventy.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: and he sent yehudah before him unto yosef, to direct his face unto goshen; and they came into eretz goshen.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: and yosef made ready his merkavah, and went up to meet yisroel aviv, to goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a long time.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and yisroel said unto yosef, now let me die, since i have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and yosef said unto his achim, and unto bais aviv, i will go up, and speak to pharaoh, and say unto him, my achim and bais avi, which were in eretz kena'an, are come unto me;
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and the anashim are roei tzon shepherds, keepers of livestock; and they have brought their tzon, and their bakar, and all that they have.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and it shall come to pass, when pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, what is ma'aseichem your occupation?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: that ye shall say, thy avadim hath been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and also avoteinu; that ye may dwell in eretz goshen; for every ro'eh tzon is a toevat mitzrayim.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: then yosef came and told pharaoh, and said, avi and my achim, and their tzon, and their bakar, and all that they have, are come out of eretz kena'an; and they are now in eretz goshen. and he took some of his achim, even five anashim, and presented them unto pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto his achim, what is your occupation? and they said unto pharaoh, thy avadim are roeh tzon, both we, and also avoteinu.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: they said moreover unto pharaoh, for to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy avadim have no mireh pasture for their tzon; for the ra'av famine is heavy in eretz kena'an; now therefore, let now thy avadim dwell in eretz goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and pharaoh spoke unto yosef, saying, avicha and acheicha are come unto thee;
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: eretz mitzrayim is before thee; in the best of the land make avicha and acheicha to dwell; in eretz goshen let them dwell; and if thou knowest any anshei chayil among them, then make them sarei mikneh royal overseers of livestock of mine.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: and yosef brought in ya'akov aviv, and set him before pharaoh; and ya'akov made on pharaoh a brocha.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and pharaoh said unto ya'akov, how old art thou?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and ya'akov said unto pharaoh, the days of the shanim of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty shanah; few and bad have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my avot in the days of their pilgrimage.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and ya'akov made a brocha on pharaoh, and went out from the presence of pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and yosef settled aviv and his achim, and gave them an achuzzah possession in eretz mitzrayim, in the best of the land, in eretz ra'meses, just as pharaoh had commanded.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and yosef provided for aviv, and his achim, and kol bais aviv, with lechem, according to the children.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: and there was no lechem in kol ha'aretz; for the ra'av was very heavy, so that eretz mitzrayim and kol eretz kena'an fainted by reason of the ra'av famine.
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and yosef gathered up all the kesef that was found in the eretz mitzrayim, and in eretz kena'an, for the shever grain which they bought; and yosef brought the kesef into bais pharaoh pharaohʼs palace.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and when kesef failed in eretz mitzrayim, and in eretz kena'an, kol mitzrayim came unto yosef, and said, give us lechem; for why should we die in thy presence? for the kesef is gone.
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: and yosef said, give your mikneh; and i will give you for your mikneh, if kesef is gone.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and they brought their mikneh unto yosef; and yosef gave them lechem in exchange for susim, and for the tzon, and for the mikneh of the bakar, and for the chamorim; and he fed them lechem for all their mikneh for that year.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: when that year was ended, they came unto him the shanah hashenit, and said unto him, we will not hide it from adoni, how that our kesef is spent; adoni also hath our mikneh of behemah; there is not ought left in the sight of adoni, but geviyyatenu our bodies, and adematenu our lands;
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: why shall we die before thine eyes, both we and adematenu? buy us and adematenu for lechem, and we and adematenu will be avadim unto pharaoh; and give us zera, that we may live, and not die, that the adamah be not desolate.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: and yosef bought kol admat mitzrayim for pharaoh; for the mitzrayim sold every ish his sadeh, because the ra'av famine was chazak over them; so the land became pharaohʼs.
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: and as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of mitzrayim even to the other end thereof.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: only the admat hakohanim bought he not; for the kohanim had a chok assigned them of pharaoh, and did eat their chok which pharaoh gave them; therefore they sold not their lands.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: then yosef said unto the people, see, i have bought you this day and your land for pharaoh: lo, here is zera for you, and ye shall sow the adamah.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and it shall come to pass in the tevu'ot, that ye shall give the fifth part unto pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for zera of the sadeh, and for your ochel, and for them of your batim, and for food for your children.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: and they said, thou hast saved our lives; let us find chen grace, favor in the sight of adoni, and we will be avadim to pharaoh.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: and yosef made it a chok over eretz mitzrayim unto this day, that pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the admat hakohanim only, which became not pharaohʼs.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and yisroel settled in eretz mitzrayim, in eretz goshen; and they acquired property therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and ya'akov lived in eretz mitzrayim seventeen shanah; so the whole age of ya'akov was a hundred forty and seven shanah.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and the time drew near that yisroel must die; and he called bno yosef, and said unto him, if now i have found chen in thy sight, put, now, thy yad under my thigh, and do chesed and emes with me; bury me not, now, in mitzrayim;
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but i will lie with my avot, and thou shalt carry me out of mitzrayim, and bury me in their kever. and he said, i will do as thou hast said.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and he said, swear unto me. and he swore unto him. and yisroel prostrated toward the rosh hamittah.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and it came to pass after these things, that one told yosef, hinei, avicha is choleh ill; and he took with him his two banim, menasheh and ephrayim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and one told ya'akov, and said, hinei, the ben of thee yosef cometh unto thee; and yisroel strengthened himself, and sat up upon the mittah bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and ya'akov said unto yosef, el shaddai appeared unto me at luz in eretz kena'an, and made on me a brocha,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and said unto me, hineni, i will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and i will make of thee a kehal of ammim; and will give haaretz hazot to thy zera after thee for an achuzzat olam everlasting possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now thy two banim, ephrayim and menasheh, which were born unto thee in eretz mitzrayim before i came unto thee into mitzrayim, are mine; like reuven and shim'on, they shall be mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: and thy moledet, which are born to thee after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the shem of their achim in their nachalah.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: and as for me, when i came from paddan, rachel died by me in eretz kena'an in the way, when there was yet but a space of land to go unto ephratah; and i buried her there by the derech ephrat; the same is beit-lechem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: and yisroel beheld bnei yosef, and said, who are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and yosef said unto aviv, they are my banim, whom elohim hath given me in this place. and he said, bring them, now, unto me, and i will make upon them a brocha.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: now the eyes of yisroel were dim from age, so that he could not see. and he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and yisroel said unto yosef, i never expected to see thy face; and, hinei, elohim hath showed me also thy zera.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and yosef brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the ground.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and yosef took them both, ephrayim in his yamin toward smol yisroel, and menasheh on his smol toward yamin yisroel, and brought them near unto him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: and yisroel stretched out his yamin, and laid it upon rosh ephrayim, who was the younger, and his smol upon rosh menasheh, guiding his hands intentionally; for menasheh was the bechor.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and he made on yosef a brocha, and said, haelohim, before whom my avot avraham and yitzchak did walk, haelohim who was roeh to me all my life long unto this day,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the malach which redeemed me from kol rah, may he make a brocha on the ne'arim, and let my shem be named on them, and the shem of my avot avraham and yitzchak; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of ha'aretz.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: and when yosef saw that aviv laid his yamin upon the rosh ephrayim, it displeased him; and he took hold of yad aviv, to remove it from rosh ephrayim unto rosh menasheh.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and yosef said unto aviv, not so, avi; for this is the bechor; put thy yamin upon his rosh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: and aviv refused, and said, i know it, beni my son, i know it; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly achiv hakaton shall be greater than he, and his zera shall become a multitude of goyim.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and he made a brocha on them that day, saying, in thee shall yisroel bless, saying, elohim make thee like ephrayim and like menasheh; and he set ephrayim before menasheh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: and yosef made the bnei yisroel take an oath, saying, elohim will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my atzmot from hence.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: so yosef died, being in age one hundred and ten shanim; and they embalmed him, and he was placed in an aron in mitzrayim.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.
